### [1] [IDSPACE: A Novel Document Generator for Reliable Evaluation of Digital Identity Verification Systems [Extended Technical Report]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03052)
*Lulu Xie,Yancheng Wang,Kanchan Chowdhury,Rolando Garcia,Yingzhen Yang,Jia Zou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出IDSpace系统，扩展合成身份文档生成研究，通过模型引导的贝叶斯优化、解耦元数据与控制参数、以及支持多种采集场景（扫描与移动拍摄），实现仅需少量真实样本即可提升合成身份文档在欺诈检测评估中的一致性。实验表明IDSpace在评估一致性上比基线提升15-45%，训练准确率最高提升9%，SSIM相似度提升10%，并发布了包含359,240张高质量合成文档的新数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着服务线上化，银行、贷方和政府等信任机构需要远程验证用户身份，但身份文档属于敏感数据，样本稀缺，导致欺诈检测工具的评估和调优困难。合成数据生成是解决路径，且此前工作在社区中下载量已超过11,000次，说明需求明确。

Method: IDSpace在三个方向扩展先前工作：(1) 提出模型引导的贝叶斯优化，在仅给定目标域少量样本的情况下，自动调整生成参数以最大化与目标域模型的视觉相似性和预测一致性；(2) 将用户指定的元数据（人口统计、欺诈模式、采集设备）与自动调优的控制参数（字体样式、噪声水平、图像质量）解耦，使用户无需底层专业知识即可配置评估；(3) 将生成能力从模板图像扩展到扫描件和移动拍摄文档。

Result: 实验表明，IDSpace相比CycleGAN、扩散修复（diffusion inpainting）和非引导优化等基线，仅使用少量真实样本就将评估一致性提升15-45%；训练准确率最高提升9%；与目标域的SSIM相似度提升10%。此外，发布了包含359,240张覆盖十种欧洲身份证件类型的高质量合成文档数据集。

Conclusion: IDSpace通过模型引导的优化策略和用户友好的参数解耦设计，有效解决了身份文档数据稀缺导致的欺诈检测评估难题，在评估一致性、训练效果和视觉保真度上均显著优于现有基线方法，并提供了大规模公开数据集以促进行业进一步研究。

Abstract: As services move online, trust institutions such as banks, lenders, and governments must verify the identity of remote users. Fraud detection tools are widely available, but evaluating and fine-tuning them remains difficult because identity documents are sensitive and therefore scarce. Synthetic data generation offers a path forward, and demand is clear: our prior work in this area has been downloaded over $11{,}000$ times (aggregated from eight parts). We introduce IDSpace, extending this line of research in three directions. First, we propose model-guided Bayesian optimization, which tunes generation parameters to maximize both visual similarity and prediction consistency with target-domain models given only a few samples from a target domain. Second, we decouple user-specified metadata (demographics, fraud patterns, capture device) from automatically tuned control parameters (font styles, noise levels, image quality), allowing users to configure evaluations without low-level expertise. Third, we expand beyond template images to support scanned and mobile-captured documents. Experiments show IDSpace improves evaluation consistency by $15-45\%$ over baselines including CycleGAN, diffusion inpainting, and non-guided optimization, using only a few real samples, while improving training accuracy by up to $9\%$ and SSIM similarity with the target domain by $10\%$. We also released a new dataset consisting of $359{,}240$ high-quality synthetic documents across ten European ID types.

</details>


### [2] [Position: Unlabeled IS NOT Equal to No Human Supervision in Visual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03077)
*Dong Lao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本篇立场论文指出，视觉学习中"无标签"并不等于"无人类监督"，当前的"无监督"伞形术语掩盖了不同数据策展方案和训练目标中嵌入的多样化人类先验。作者呼吁社区识别并披露监督来源，通过标准化的先验披露规范来提升学术交流、保证公平比较并维护方法论多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来许多计算机视觉方法基于大规模无标签数据学习表征，都被归入"无监督"这个伞形术语之下。然而，不同的数据策展方式和训练目标嵌入了截然不同的人类先验，现有术语无法捕捉这些关键差异。这种模糊性导致在不同假设下进行的无监督学习研究难以比较，且自2021年以来CV领域以"无监督"命名的论文数量急剧下降，但该领域仍在持续增长，术语混乱对学术交流和研究评估产生了负面影响。

Method: 本文采用立场论述的方式：首先分析了"无监督"术语的模糊性问题及其在学术界的表现（如相关论文标题数量的下降趋势），然后提出社区层面的改进方案——鼓励作者在论文中披露数据选择和训练目标中嵌入的先验，明确指出学习流水线中哪些组件依赖哪些假设，并推广标准化的披露实践。

Result: 论文提出的主要成果是：(1) 指出"无监督"标签与实际监督来源之间的逻辑断层；(2) 揭示了术语模糊与2021后CV顶会上"无监督"标题论文数量下降之间的关联；(3) 提出一套标准化披露规范的建议框架，要求作者披露数据选择与学习目标中的人类先验，以及学习流水线中各组件对应的假设依赖。

Conclusion: 作者完全支持预训练作为现代计算机视觉的坚实基础，但主张社区需要更大的概念清晰度。通过标准化的先验披露实践，可以改善学术沟通、确保方法间的公平比较，并保护无监督学习领域的方法论多样性。该立场呼吁研究者更自觉地审视和声明方法论中隐含的人类监督成分。

Abstract: This position paper argues that the absence of labels does not imply the absence of human supervision in visual learning, and urges the research community to identify sources of supervision more explicitly. Many recent methods in computer vision build upon representations learned from large-scale unlabeled data, and are therefore grouped under the same umbrella term ``unsupervised.'' However, different data curation schemes and training objectives embed substantially different human priors on which models rely, and we argue that one ``unsupervised'' umbrella term is no longer capturing these distinctions. This ambiguity makes it harder to compare unsupervised learning research conducted under different assumptions, coinciding with a sharp decline in papers titled with ``unsupervised'' in flagship computer vision conferences since 2021, despite continued growth of the field. While we fully embrace pre-training as a strong foundation for modern computer vision, we advocate for a community-level effort toward greater conceptual clarity: authors are encouraged to disclose priors in data selection and learning objectives, and to specify which components of a learning pipeline depend on which assumptions. Standardized disclosure practices can improve academic communication, ensure fairer comparisons, and preserve methodological diversity in unsupervised learning.

</details>


### [3] [Tensor-based Brain Surface Modeling and Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03302)
*Moo K. Chung,Keith J. Worsley,Steve Robbins,Alan C. Evans*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的计算框架，用于基于MRI的脑表面形状差异的张量形态测量，结合了表面建模、表面数据平滑和统计分析，并通过Laplace-Beltrami算子扩散平滑提高信噪比，应用于儿童灰质生长与损失的区域定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同临床群体之间的脑皮层（2D高度卷曲的片状结构）在局部表面积和曲率上可能存在差异，且这种差异并非均匀分布在整个皮层上。需要一种方法将形态差异最大的区域定位出来，以检测脑结构变化。

Method: 提出一种统一的张量表面形态测量方法，将表面建模、表面数据平滑和统计分析整合到一个连贯的数学框架中。通过计算皮层局部表面积和曲率等表面度量来量化形状差异，并基于Laplace-Beltrami算子的显式估计开发扩散平滑技术以降低噪声并提高信噪比。

Result: 以儿童纵向采集的脑图像为例，该方法成功定位了灰质组织生长与损失的皮层区域，验证了该框架在张量表面形态测量中的实用性。

Conclusion: 该统一框架有效结合了表面建模、光滑化和统计推断，能够通过扩散平滑增强信噪比，并在皮层表面上定位结构性差异最显著的脑区。

Abstract: We present a unified computational approach to tensor-based morphometry in detecting the brain surface shape differences between two clinical groups based on magnetic resonance images. Our approach is novel in a sense that we combined surface modeling, surface data smoothing and statistical analysis in a coherent unified mathematical framework. The cerebral cortex has the topology of a 2D highly convoluted sheet. Between two different clinical groups, the local surface area and curvature of the cortex may differ. It is highly likely that such surface shape differences are not uniform over the whole cortex. By computing how such surface metrics differ, the regions of the most rapid structural differences can be localized. To increase the signal to noise ratio, diffusion smoothing based on the explicit estimation of Laplace-Beltrami operator has been developed and applied to the surface metrics. As an illustration, we demonstrate how this new tensor-based surface morphometry can be applied in localizing the cortical regions of the gray matter tissue growth and loss in the brain images longitudinally collected in the group of children.

</details>


### [4] [Exemplar: Classical Priors Complement Frozen Features for Few-Shot Microscopy Segmentation at Native Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03080)
*Michal Průšek,Adam Novozámský,Filip Šroubek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Exemplar，一个少样本医学图像分割器，将冻结的DINOv3骨干与经典原生分辨率滤波器响应固定库在轻量级头中融合，仅用支持掩码拟合。在11个生物医学数据集上，融合达到0.782，优于单独使用经典库(0.693)或冻结特征(0.672)，并在55项方法-数据集比较中领先54项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新生物医学数据集的分割通常需要领域特定模型的大量标注，或依赖推理时引导的基础模型。作者旨在探索在极少掩码(少样本)和原生分辨率场景下，经典的图像先验能否与冻结的自监督特征互补，从而免去大量标注或领域适配。

Method: Exemplar包含三个部分：冻结的DINOv3骨干提取自监督特征，固定的经典原生分辨率滤波器响应库提供传统视觉先验，以及一个轻量级融合头仅从支持掩码中拟合。两路特征被拼接后由一个轻量头处理，单一固定配置横跨11个生物医学数据集无需调整。

Result: 经典库单独达到0.693，冻结特征单独为0.672（按前景IoU或中心线Dice评分）；经典库在11个数据集中的7个上领先。融合后达到0.782。与5种前向传递少样本方法对比，Exemplar在55个方法-数据集对比中领先54个，其中52个经Holm校正后显著。单张标注掩码可达0.703，胜过在同一掩码上从头训练nnU-Net的0.682。8张掩码时nnU-Net在面板均值上反超（主要在中心线一致性），但拟合耗时长达16-77倍。

Conclusion: 在极少掩码和原生分辨率场景下，经典滤波器先验与冻结自监督特征是互补的，融合后产生强大的零领域适配少样本分割器。Exemplar在极低标注预算下优于现有少样本方法和从零训练的nnU-Net，尽管在标注数量增长后nnU-Net在部分指标上可以反超，但计算代价显著更高。

Abstract: Segmenting a new biomedical dataset usually means a domain-specific model trained on substantial annotation, or a foundation model steered at inference time. We present Exemplar, a few-shot segmenter that fuses a frozen DINOv3 backbone with a fixed bank of classical native-resolution filter responses in one lightweight head, fitted from the support masks alone. In the few-mask, native-resolution regime, classical priors and frozen self-supervised features are complementary: fused in one head, a single fixed configuration spans eleven biomedical imaging datasets. Under the same head, the classical bank alone reaches 0.693 on the eleven-dataset panel, scored by foreground intersection-over-union or centreline Dice, and the frozen features alone 0.672; the bank leads on seven of the eleven and the features on the rest, and fused they reach 0.782. Against five forward-pass few-shot methods, Exemplar leads in 54 of 55 method-dataset comparisons, 52 of them significant after Holm correction. From a single annotated mask it reaches 0.703 on the same panel, against 0.682 for a from-scratch nnU-Net trained on that same mask. At eight masks nnU-Net overtakes it on the panel mean, chiefly on centreline agreement, but takes 16-77x longer to fit.

</details>


### [5] [Solving the Needle-in-a-Haystack Problem in Mammography Vision-Language Model with Differentiable Subset Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03085)
*Young Seok Jeon,Beatrice Brown-Mulry,Rohan Satya Isaac,Anjana Dissanayaka,Theo Dapamede,Mohammadreza Chavoshi,Judy Gichoya,Hari Trivedi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TopKSigLIP，一种针对乳腺X线摄影的CLIP式视觉-语言预训练模型。针对乳腺X线影像的高分辨率和放射学报告同质化两大特点，设计了TopK-Patch模块（从高分辨率图像中采样稀疏的病灶相关补丁，规避分辨率与batch size的权衡）和Sup-sigmoid损失函数（用结构化数据生成的软标签扩展SigLIP的sigmoid损失，替代会错误排斥语义相似对的对比损失）。在密度评估、BI-RADS分类、发现亚型及癌症预测等零样本任务上超越现有开源乳腺影像及通用医学VLM，TopK-Patch还能实现优于Grad-CAM的病灶定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准CLIP架构与训练目标用于乳腺X线摄影预训练时，在癌症检测、发现类型和BI-RADS预测等临床重要任务上零样本性能有限。作者认为原因在于忽视了乳腺影像数据的两大特性：(1)高分辨率特性；(2)放射学报告的高度同质性（主要由阴性/良性发现的报告主导），导致现有方法表现欠佳。

Method: TopKSigLIP通过两方面改进：(1)架构上引入TopK-Patch模块，学习从高分辨率乳腺影像中采样包含病灶的稀疏高分辨率补丁，从而解决VLM训练中分辨率与batch size的权衡问题，且补丁位置可直接作为内置定位工具；(2)学习目标上用Sup-sigmoid损失替代对比损失——对比损失会错误地推开语义相似的样本对，Sup-sigmoid损失将SigLIP的sigmoid损失扩展为使用源自结构化数据的软标签版本。

Result: 在内部和外部基准上，TopKSigLIP在密度评估、BI-RADS分类、发现亚型分类和癌症预测的零样本评估中均优于现有开源乳腺影像VLM和通用医学VLM。在线性探测下虽然使用显著更小的视觉编码器和更小的训练batch，仍保持竞争力。TopK-Patch模块的病灶定位性能优于事后Grad-CAM。

Conclusion: 针对乳腺X线摄影数据特性的定制化架构（TopK-Patch稀疏高分辨率采样）与定制化损失（Sup-sigmoid软标签损失）能有效提升VLM在该领域的零样本临床任务性能，并额外提供病灶定位能力。代码与权重已开源。

Abstract: There is growing interest in adopting CLIP-style vision--language model (VLM) pretraining for mammography. However, models that directly employ the standard CLIP architecture and training objective exhibit limited zero-shot performance in clinically important tasks such as cancer, finding-type, and BI-RADS predictions. We argue that this underwhelming performance is due to neglecting two characteristics of mammography data: (1) its high-res nature, and (2) homogeneity of radiology reports, largely driven by a predominance of negative/benign findings on examinations. We propose TopKSigLIP, a VLM designed to address these two limitations through a novel architecture and learning objectives. Instead of downscaling high-res mammography images to satisfy GPU memory constraints, TopKSigLIP introduces TopK-Patch module that learns to sample a sparse set of high-res patches likely to contain lesions, sidestepping the resolution--batch size tradeoff of VLM training. The sampled patch locations additionally serve as a built-in localization tool. To address report homogeneity, we replace the contrastive loss, which falsely repels semantically similar pairs, with a Sup-sigmoid loss. Sup-sigmoid loss extends the sigmoid loss from SigLIP with soft labels derived from structured data. TopKSigLIP outperforms existing open-source mammography and general medical VLMs on both internal and external benchmarks on density assessment, BI-RADS classification, finding subtyping, and cancer prediction under zero-shot evaluation. TopKSigLIP remains competitive under linear probing despite using a significantly smaller vision encoder and smaller training batches than baselines. The TopK-Patch module additionally achieves superior lesion localization over post-hoc Grad-CAM. Code and weights are made public:https://github.com/Youngseok0001/TopKSigLIP.

</details>


### [6] [WireSeg-32K: A Physics-Grounded Synthetic Dataset for Wire Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03102)
*Zilin Dai,Lehong Wang,Yi Yang,Xiang Fei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出WireSeg-32k，一个包含32,000张RGB图像、实例掩码和深度图的合成线缆实例分割数据集，以及配套的真实世界测试集。通过开发DeformX协同仿真管线（将Cosserat-rod动力学与Isaac Sim逼真渲染耦合），生成物理可信、接触一致的线缆形状和场景。基线实验表明，在WireSeg-32k上仅用LoRA微调SAM3，即可在真实世界mAP@75上较开箱即用模型提升10.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形线性物体（如电线、线缆）由于细长、高度变形且频繁自遮挡而难以分割，同时真实场景中的大规模实例级标注成本高昂。现有资源要么局限于受约束条件下的线缆追踪或语义分割，要么生成视觉上合理但缺乏物理真实线缆变形的图像，缺少物理可信的大规模标注数据。

Method: 构建DeformX协同仿真管线，将Cosserat-rod动力学模型与逼真的Isaac Sim渲染引擎耦合，生成物理合理、接触一致的线缆形状；利用CAD线缆资产和多样化视觉场景生成数据；在此基础上构建WireSeg-32k合成数据集，包含RGB图像、实例掩码和深度图，并以LoRA微调SAM3作为简单基线验证数据有效性。

Result: WireSeg-32k包含32,000张合成RGB图像及对应实例掩码和深度图，另配有带标注的真实世界测试集。使用LoRA在WireSeg-32k上微调SAM3，真实世界mAP@75较现成模型提升10.2%。

Conclusion: 物理可信的合成数据能够有效迁移到真实线缆感知任务中，WireSeg-32k和DeformX为线缆实例分割提供了新的基准与数据生成范式。

Abstract: Deformable linear objects such as wires and cables are difficult to segment because they are thin, highly deformable, and frequently self-occluded, while large-scale instance-level annotations are expensive to obtain in real scenes. Existing resources either focus on cable tracing or semantic segmentation under constrained settings, or generate visually plausible images without physically grounded wire deformation. We present WireSeg-32k, a synthetic dataset for wire instance segmentation with 32,000 RGB images, instance masks, depth maps, and a complementary real-world test set with annotations. To generate this dataset, we develop DeformX, a co-simulation pipeline that couples Cosserat-rod dynamics with photorealistic Isaac Sim rendering, enabling physically plausible, contact-consistent wire shapes, CAD-based wire assets, and diverse visually grounded scenes. As a simple baseline, LoRA fine-tuning SAM3 on WireSeg-32k alone improves real-world mAP@75 by 10.2% over the off-the-shelf model, showing that physically grounded synthetic data can transfer to real wire perception.

</details>


### [7] [SLIDEFORGE: An LLM Agent for Controllable Editing of Slides as Structured Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03109)
*Haozhen Zheng,Fulin Wang,Tianhu Xiong,Yingjie Yu,Shengyi Qian,Hanchao Yu,Alex Schwing,Klara Nahrstedt,Mingyuan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SLIDEFORGE是一个面向可控幻灯片编辑的agentic框架，通过构建可执行的Deck State Graph（图谱），连接视觉分解、原生pptx对象结构和感知组织，实现保留布局、样式和原生可编辑性的幻灯片编辑。论文还提出了联合评估组件恢复、保持、重风格一致性、视觉质量和原生可编辑性的评价范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AI代理虽然能描述幻灯片，但在幻灯片编辑任务中表现不佳——许多代理基于截图或弱文档表示操作，导致视觉单元被割裂、可编辑内容被栅格化、布局被破坏。可控幻灯片编辑不仅需要"理解"，还要求输出保留布局、样式、组件结构和原生可编辑性。

Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are increasingly deployed in real-world vision systems, yet their predictions can be covertly manipulated by backdoor attacks, in which malicious triggers cause targeted misclassification while preserving high clean accuracy.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Visual fluency in generated video does not imply physical reliability, and a scalar quality score alone is incapable of indicating the obligation a clip violates or the moment it fails. Abstract: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of vision-language models (VLMs), but most methods only ask which tokens to keep. Abstract: Robot learning increasingly depends on broad and diverse demonstrations, yet collecting robot data remains expensive and poorly suited to covering the long tail of real-world tasks. To address this bottleneck, we introduce RoboTok, an internet-scale data engine that, given a query human manipulation video, retrieves manipulation-relevant human demonstrations from web videos for training dexterous robot policies. Abstract: Using a zoom-in tool is an important foundational part of modern visual agents, because it allows to efficiently handle tasks involving high-resolution images. Our InfoNCE-style reward uses a curriculum of increasingly hard negative tool calls as a contrastive training signal. Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) typically process every image using a fixed input resolution and model width, even though many images can be classified with substantially less computation.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗多模态多选题中，正确答案可能并非源自预期的图像推理，而是由基准中残留的非预期线索（如选项措辞、非视觉文本、图像内文字等）支撑。现有以最终分数为唯一指标的基准无法区分"正确答案"与"正确推理路径"，导致对模型真实图像推理能力的过高估计。

Abstract: A key bottleneck in 3D Gaussian Splatting training is the continual growth of Gaussian primitives, which increases optimization cost and slows convergence, especially at high resolutions. *Ming Hu,Jianfu Yin,Mingyu Dou,Miaomiao Zhang,Yao Wang,Cong Hu,Bingliang Hu,Quan Wang*

Abstract: Recent years have witnessed growing interest in continual anomaly detection for industrial visual inspection.   <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 提出"answer-key-free"（无答案标注）协议：不为编辑后的答案做任何标注，仅对逻辑上答案可确定的编辑进行评分，并通过反转每个可评分的选择（逆向编辑）实现协议自身的自审计。协议在token层面执行三类操作，分三块度量：响应开启条件（比较显式编辑教学与普通VQA训练）、响应支配因素（token清洁度与密度，含可部署检测器+分割器token对比oracle）、图像无关的token通路的可读性（与patch-token基线对比自由文本VQA能力并验证答案对token的依赖性）。

Conclusion: 对象级token编辑为冻结VLM回答what-if问题提供了可行的表征级替代路径，但能否响应取决于训练范式（显式编辑教学），其质量受token质量与稀疏性约束，且与基础VQA阅读能力解耦。作者发布了探针生成器、记录、评测日志和代码以供复现与扩展。

</details>

Abstract: Preprocessing-based defenses are the standard first-line response to adversarial attacks on edge vision systems, requiring no retraining, no architectural changes, and widely recommended as model-agnostic mitigations. Abstract: Infrared-visible object detection (IVOD) integrates complementary evidence from visible and infrared sensors for reliable perception in challenging scenes. Abstract: Action-conditioned video models require large-scale visual data paired with control signals that are temporally aligned with the resulting scene transitions. Abstract: Understanding the composition of large-scale autonomous driving datasets is essential for safety, robustness, and reliable operation across domains. Abstract: We present FlashRender, a few-step generative rendering framework that retakes a source video along a target camera trajectory in seconds. This directly encodes the geometric transformation within the source-video stream, enabling sampling-step-consistent camera control. We then fine-tune the model with the MeanFlow objective on the lower-curvature denoising trajectory induced by RETA, allowing the model to more effectively address discretization error. Finally, we apply on-policy flow map distillation to correct self-rollout errors under fixed few-step sampling. Extensive experiments show that RETA, MeanFlow, and on-policy flow map distillation play complementary roles in few-step generative rendering. Together, they enable our approach to match multi-step baselines in video quality and geometric consistency at 25x lower sampling cost while achieving superior camera controllability, even under out-of-distribution target camera trajectories.

Abstract: World models offer a promising paradigm for autonomous driving by predicting how traffic scenes may evolve and using such predictions to support action generation. Abstract: Verifying that manufactured batches of milling tools or carbide rotary burrs conform to production order sheets remains a largely manual and error-prone quality assurance task. Abstract: Vector-quantization based image compression has achieved strong rate--distortion performance, yet most of them still produce a separate compressed representation for each target bitrate. Tree-VQ organizes discrete codewords as a hierarchical binary tree and represents each latent token by a routed root-to-leaf path. Crucially, every prefix of this path corresponds to a valid quantized representation, so shallow internal nodes serve as coarse reconstruction codes and deeper nodes provide successive refinements. This allows a compressed image to be decoded from an early prefix and progressively improved as more branch symbols are received, rather than being re-encoded for different target rates. We further use rate-aware refinement scheduling to decide which spatial blocks should receive additional tree bits under a given prefix budget, and hierarchical prefix supervision to ensure that internal nodes are directly decodable at low rates. Experiments show that Tree-VQ achieves a superior performance--efficiency trade-off, delivering the best perceptual compression results with much fewer parameters and lower latency than competing methods.

</details>

Abstract: Background. Beyond Intuition ranked highest on both datasets, at median coverage 0.789 and SaCo 0.837 on Static level 3 against 0.826 and 0.917 on UBFC-rPPG; lower ranks differed. Across the eight scenarios only Beyond Intuition's coverage followed the three performance measures, at $ρ=-0.43$, $+0.57$, and $+0.43$, while the attention-only methods' SaCo ran opposite to each. It failed at 40 lux alone, its median coverage falling to 0.180 and its median SaCo to $-0.178$, whereas motion degraded the estimates far more without such a drop. Conclusions.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Video generators build long videos by composing shorter parts, either by generating segments one after another or by autoregressively extending chunks. Each new part usually depends on memories of historical observations, such as recent frames, selected key frames, memory banks, or cached features. These memories preserve visible evidence from the past, but current generators do not reliably turn such evidence into a world-state interface: what holds in the video world after previous actions and how it should change under the next prompt. A past frame remains valid history, but it may not describe the state needed by the next segment; some states must instead be inferred from occluded or implicit changes rather than copied from a directly observed frame. We further propose Stateagent, which explicitly maintains an entity-state representation, updates it under the new prompt, grounds the predicted post-action state as a future end frame, and renders the next video.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Streaming video understanding requires Vision Language Models (VLLMs) to process growing video streams and answer user questions under tight latency constraints. Consequently, downstream token pruning alone cannot substantially reduce end-to-end latency because the expensive frame encoding cost has already been incurred. CoFiE introduces Novelty-Guided Frame Filtering to retain visually distinctive candidate frames and Query-Specific Evidence Refinement to select the frames most relevant to the user query. This design removes substantial redundancy before frame encoding while preserving query-specific refinement once semantic information becomes available. Experiments show that CoFiE establishes a new state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off across multiple video understanding benchmarks, reaching 78.86% accuracy on StreamingBench and 68.72% on OvO-Bench, with improvements of up to 3.15% over prior methods.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理亚型分类依赖对特征组织模式的识别，这些模式常跨越不规则形状的组织区域（称为语义单元），可能体现为单个组织结构的形态或多种结构的空间分布与共现。然而，传统基于patch的表示方法会切碎这些语义单元，无法显式保留其内部空间组织；同时，高效建模大量空间分离单元之间的相互关系仍然具有挑战性。

Abstract: Histopathological subtyping relies on the recognition of characteristic histological patterns. These patterns may be expressed by individual tissue structures or by the spatial distribution and co-occurrence of multiple structures, and they often span irregularly shaped tissue regions, termed semantic units in this work. However, conventional patch-based representations may fragment such units and fail to explicitly preserve their internal spatial organization, while efficiently modeling relationships among numerous spatially separated units remains challenging. Conclusion: 该框架为核医学中的多模态表示学习和全身整合推理建立了坚实基础，有助于推动3D全身PET/CT的交互式临床诊断与推理能力发展。

Abstract: The joint interpretation of metabolic function and anatomical structure is essential for clinical diagnosis in whole-body PET/CT. To facilitate interactive reasoning, we further developed MetaStructVQA, a standardized 3D grounded visual question-answering benchmark containing 100,565 QA pairs. This framework explicitly links diagnostic queries to visual evidence across modalities, encompassing anatomical, morphological, and metabolic characteristics. Finally, we evaluate state-of-the-art 3D medical VLMs on MetaStructVQA, establishing a robust foundation for multimodal representation learning and integrated whole-body reasoning in nuclear medicine.

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种后验的、以观测为条件的隐能量先验（observation-conditioned latent energy prior），用于冻结的隐式神经表示（INR）解码器。该方法通过在稀疏离网格SDF样本条件下对标准化潜在编码进行能量评分，并将其作为残差专家与L2潜在先验结合，在细胞核和MedShapeNet SDF补全任务上优于L2和GMM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自解码器（autodecoder）风格的INR模型在测试时冻结解码器并仅优化新的潜在编码，但当稀疏观测样本欠约束时，潜在编码会漂移到拟合观测但解码出不可信的未见几何结构的区域。现有L2先验等简单约束不足以防止这种不合理的漂移。

Method: 提出一种事后（post-hoc）的观测条件潜在能量先验：能量函数对标准化潜在编码在稀疏观测集的置换不变编码条件下进行评分，作为残差专家与验证集上选择的L2潜在先验结合使用。在受控细胞核SDF数据集和MedShapeNet衍生的SDF补全数据集上，采用L2目标加上条件能量增强进行训练。

Result: 在细胞核SDF数据最稀疏场景下，L2目标结合条件能量一致优于验证集选择的L2基线；在MedShapeNet上，该方法在所有报告指标上均优于L2和六分量GMM潜在密度先验。洗牌上下文消融实验一致弱于匹配上下文，验证了观测特异性贡献。

Conclusion: 轻量级条件能量可以使预训练INR解码器在无需重新训练的情况下更具观测感知能力（observation-aware），为冻结INR解码器的测试时推理提供了有效的约束手段。

Abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) can model continuous 3D shapes with a shared coordinate decoder and per-instance latent codes. At test time, autodecoder-style models commonly freeze the decoder and optimize a new latent code from sparse off-grid SDF samples. When these samples underconstrain inference, the latent can drift toward regions that fit the observations but decode implausible unobserved geometry. </details>

Conclusion: SignSeek通过显著性引导的发音器官掩蔽实现了可泛化到开放集跨签署人手语检索的表征，展现了强大的跨语料和跨语言泛化能力，为该领域设立了新的性能基准。

Abstract: Sign language dictionaries are essential resources for sign language learners, yet automatically retrieving a sign from a dictionary, given only a query video, remains a challenging problem due to the natural variability between signers. This drives two complementary objectives, a masked contrastive alignment (MAC) loss that sees the sign through a single articulator and a masked prediction (MAP) loss that reconstructs it in latent space from the surrounding spatio-temporal context. Pretrained on 266K samples ($\sim$5,700 glosses) across multiple sign languages, \textbf{SignSeek} sets a new state-of-the-art performance in cross-corpus retrieval on ASL-Citizen, WLASL, and NMFs-CSL without any downstream fine-tuning. Strikingly, it achieves zero-shot generalisation to an entirely unseen British Sign Language (BSL), surpassing methods explicitly trained on BSL, and transfers seamlessly to isolated sign recognition and subtitle alignment, outperforming prior skeleton-based methods.

</details>


### [64] [Unfold The World: Factorize 4D Properties in Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03729)
*Yijun Yang,Shenghe Zheng,Wenbo Li,Jianhui Liu,Haoze Sun,Yanbing Zhang,Jiaxiu Jiang,Lin Song,Haoyang Huang,Nan Duan,Lei Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出FactoSR框架，通过将视觉语言模型的空间推理任务分解为三个正交的几何子目标（平面对应XY、深度一致性Z、时间可逆性T），采用因子化强化学习方法将病态的2D投影恢复问题转化为可验证的推理步骤，在3D和4D推理基准上分别获得5.9%（VSI-Bench）和4.5%（All-Angles-Bench）的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然VLM在通用多模态任务上表现出色，但其物理世界推理能力本质上是"扁平"的。根本原因在于维度不匹配：VLM被训练于解释2D投影，而真正的空间推理需要恢复潜在的3D几何和时间连续性。这种由视觉投影导致的维度坍缩是空间推理瓶颈的核心。

Method: 提出"分而治之"的因子化强化学习框架FactoSR，将世界一致性推理这一整体问题分解为三个正交的几何子目标：平面对应（XY）、深度一致性（Z）和时间可逆性（T），并在统一的策略学习机制中优化这些可验证约束，将不适定的投影恢复问题转化为一系列可操作的推理步骤。

Result: 在VSI-Bench上获得5.9%的提升，在All-Angles-Bench上获得4.5%的提升，表明该分解方法在3D和4D推理任务中带来显著性能增益。

Conclusion: 强化显式、因子化的4D一致性是推动VLM进化为稳健世界感知推理者的关键步骤。

Abstract: Despite the remarkable prowess of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in general multimodal tasks, they remain fundamentally ``flat'' when reasoning about the physical world. We argue that this spatial bottleneck stems from a profound dimensional mismatch: while VLMs are trained to interpret 2D projections, true spatial reasoning demands the recovery of latent 3D geometry and temporal continuity. To conquer this high-dimensional complexity, we advocate a shift from monolithic learning to a ``divide and conquer'' paradigm. We present FactoSR, a factorized reinforcement learning framework that explicitly interpret the dimensions collapsed by visual projection. At its core, FactoSR decomposes the monolithic problem of world-consistent reasoning into three orthogonal, geometric sub-objectives: planar correspondence ($XY$), depth consistency ($Z$), and temporal reversibility ($T$). By optimizing these verifiable constraints within a unified policy learning mechanism, we effectively transform an ill-posed projection recovery problem into a series of tangible reasoning steps. Extensive evaluations on multi-view and video benchmarks demonstrate that this elegant decomposition yields substantial gains in 3D and 4D reasoning, achieving a 5.9% boost on VSI-Bench and 4.5% on All-Angles-Bench. Our findings suggest that reinforcing explicit, factorized 4D consistency is a critical step toward evolving VLMs into robust, world-aware reasoners.

</details>


### [65] [Fill My Mirror: Geometry-Constrained Mirror Inpainting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03740)
*Ofek Basson,Shimon Vainer,Yacov Hel-Or,Ohad Fried*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需训练的镜像修复方法，通过估计场景几何结构并将可见内容投影到镜像区域，结合双掩码扩散策略，在保持几何约束的同时利用生成模型的先验知识，实现几何一致的镜子反射生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实图像中的镜子在生成时难以保持几何一致性，因为镜子的外观依赖于场景几何和视点，仅靠学习到的外观先验难以合成。本文聚焦于镜像修复场景，旨在利用场景几何约束而非完全凭模型幻觉来生成反射内容。

Method: 关键流程为：(1) 估计场景几何；(2) 将可见场景内容投影到镜子区域以恢复由几何决定的反射区域；(3) 采用双掩码扩散策略生成镜子区域，在平衡几何约束与模型学习先验之间权衡，以减少投影伪影并提升反射一致性。该方法无需训练。

Result: 在MirrorBench-V2（合成数据集）和真实图像上进行了评估，使用标准指标和几何感知指标，结果表明显式利用场景几何可以提升反射的一致性。

Conclusion: 显式利用场景几何进行镜像修复能有效提升反射的几何一致性，且该方法无需训练，可适用于复杂的真实世界场景。

Abstract: Mirrors are common in real-world images, yet producing geometrically consistent reflections with generative models remains challenging. Unlike most objects, mirror appearance depends on scene geometry and viewpoint, making it hard to synthesize using learned appearance priors alone. We address this in the mirror inpainting setting, where the scene is fixed and only the mirror region is generated. Our key insight is that much mirror content is geometrically constrained by the visible scene and need not be hallucinated. We estimate scene geometry and project visible content into the mirror to recover reflection regions determined by geometry. A generative model then completes the mirror region via a two-mask diffusion strategy balancing geometric constraints with the model's learned priors, reducing projection artifacts and improving reflection consistency. The method is training-free and applicable to complex real-world scenes. We evaluate on MirrorBench-V2 (synthetic) and real images. Using standard and geometry-aware metrics, we show that explicitly using scene geometry improves consistency.

</details>


### [66] [KnowVis: Knowledge-Centric Visual Summarization for Video Lectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03742)
*Yi Xu,Yifan Hou,Xiaoyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出KnowVis框架，将线性视频讲座转化为基于教育学理论的视觉叙事。它从多模态视频内容中提取概念图以识别阈值概念，构建结构化知识单元，并合成视觉摘要。通过125个教育视频数据集和人类研究验证，KnowVis相比基线方法生成了更准确清晰的视觉内容，显著降低了认知负荷并提升了学习效果与知识保留率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频讲座虽是宝贵教育资源，但线性、冗长的格式使新手学习者不堪重负。根本原因在于教育学层面的错配：视频是线性传递瞬时信息，而人类学习需要构建相互关联的认知网络，缺乏先验知识的新手容易产生严重的认知过载。现有视频摘要方法仅生成文字密集的线性压缩内容，未能解决这一根本矛盾。

Method: KnowVis包含三个核心步骤：首先从多模态视频内容中提取详细的概念图，识别重要且具挑战性的阈值概念；然后基于概念图构建结构化的知识单元；最后合成引人入胜的视觉摘要。同时构建了一个包含10个学科、125个教育视频及1,079个生成的视觉摘要的策划数据集。

Result: 大规模自动化评估和人类研究表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，KnowVis生成的视觉内容更加准确和清晰，能够有效降低认知负荷，并显著提升学生的学习效果和知识保留能力。

Conclusion: KnowVis通过教育学指导的设计思路，成功弥合了视频讲座线性呈现与人类认知网络构建之间的鸿沟，为解决视频学习中新手认知过载问题提供了可行且有效的框架方案。

Abstract: Video lectures are valuable educational resources, but their dense and lengthy formats often overwhelm novice learners. This difficulty stems from a fundamental pedagogical mismatch: while videos deliver transient information linearly, human learning requires constructing interconnected cognitive networks, a task that induces severe cognitive overload for novice learners lacking prior domain knowledge. Existing video summarization methods fail to resolve this mismatch, as they primarily produce text-heavy, linear condensations that still demand high cognitive effort. To bridge this gap, we propose KnowVis, a framework that transforms linear video lectures into pedagogically grounded visual narratives. KnowVis first extracts a detailed concept map from multimodal video content to identify important and challenging threshold concepts, then constructs structured knowledge units, and finally synthesizes engaging visual summaries. Alongside the framework, we introduce a curated dataset of 125 educational videos across 10 academic disciplines, paired with 1,079 generated visual summaries. Extensive automated evaluations and a human study demonstrate that, compared to state-of-the-art baselines, KnowVis generates more accurate and clear visuals that successfully reduce cognitive load and significantly improve student learning effectiveness and knowledge retention.

</details>


### [67] [ENEAS: Embedding-guided Neural Ensemble for Adaptive Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03756)
*Javier del Pino,Salvador Rodríguez,Alejandro Garabito,Javier Álvarez,Chema Garabito*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ENEAS是一个统一的可文本提示的实例追踪与语义发现方法，解决了SAM等分割模型在视频中的时间幻觉、空间碎片化和语义误分类问题，同时支持精确的实例追踪和开放概念的实例发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本可提示分割模型（如SAM 3）在视频场景中存在三大缺陷：1) 当目标离开视野时无法报告其消失（时间幻觉）；2) 极端特写镜头下仅分割局部纹理而非完整物体（空间碎片化）；3) 视觉上相似但本体不同的物体（如雕像、绘画、倒影）被错误分割为目标实体（语义误分类）。此外，3D重建场景中一个误分类的干扰项就会破坏整个资产，迫切需要高可靠性的语义追踪与分割方法。

Method: ENEAS从单一方法出发实现两种功能：(1) 精确追踪与高质量分割唯一实例——扩展几何稳健的SeC架构（原仅支持点交互）加入文本提示适配器，利用其时间记忆使目标在消失时保持追踪不漂移，充满整个视野时仍保持完整；(2) 开放概念发现——通过语义验证层，结合高速视觉嵌入匹配与条件VLM精炼，仅对模糊候选触发语义推理，过滤纯视觉模型无法区分的本体错误同时保持低延迟。设计面向3D重建，适用于视频、广泛库及时序或空间无序的数据集合。

Result: ENEAS实现了高质量语义追踪与分割，解决时间幻觉、空间碎片化和语义误分类问题，能够区分真实实例与其"相似但非同一"的doppelgangers（如视觉相似的雕像、绘画、反射），同时通过条件VLM策略将语义推理开销限制在模糊候选上以保持低延迟。

Conclusion: ENEAS是为3D重建而设计的统一框架，解锁了对视频、大规模数据库以及时间或空间无序数据集合的高质量语义追踪与分割能力，并通过语义验证层提供了区分真实实例与视觉相似干扰物的判别力。代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: We present ENEAS, a unified, text-promptable method for instance tracking and semantic discovery. Text-promptable segmentation models, including the latest foundation models such as SAM 3, still suffer from temporal hallucinations, spatial fragmentation, and semantic misclassification: they fail to report target absence when an object leaves the field of view, segment local textures instead of the complete object during extreme close-ups, and prioritize visual features over ontological reality, so that visually similar artifacts such as statues, paintings, or reflections are segmented as target entities.
  ENEAS works two ways from a single method: precise tracking and high-quality segmentation of a unique instance, and open-concept discovery of every instance a text query names, resolved by a semantic verification layer. For tracking, we extend the geometrically robust SeC architecture, previously limited to point interactions, with a text-prompting adapter and leverage its temporal memory, so that the target is held through disappearance without drifting to distractors and kept whole even when it fills the entire view. For discovery, the verification layer combines high-speed visual embedding matching with conditional VLM refinement, invoking semantic reasoning only for ambiguous candidates, which filters out the ontological errors that visual-only models cannot distinguish while keeping latency low. Designed with 3D reconstruction in mind, where a single misclassified distractor corrupts the asset, ENEAS unlocks high-quality semantic tracking and segmentation of video, of broad libraries, and of collections of temporally or spatially unordered data, together with the discrimination to tell true instances from their doppelgangers: things that look alike but are not the same. The code and models are available at https://github.com/speridlabs/eneas

</details>


### [68] [RealCADBench: Benchmarking Parametric CAD Modeling from Industrial Design Intents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03773)
*JoyIndustrial VisCAD Team,Linxin Cai,Qiuhe Hong,Zhichao Huang,Guanlin Li,Zongzhen Li,Hongsen Liu,Yichen Long,Wei Wang,Yuchen Wang,Dongyue Yang,Huimu Yu,Xianwen Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RealCADBench，一个面向真实工业设计意图的CAD建模基准，包含12,632个任务（19个工厂自动化类别），涵盖文本描述、2D工程图纸、真实产品图片和渲染图像等多种输入模态，用于Part和Assembly建模评估。论文在1,770个任务的评估切片上，使用可执行性、Solid IoU、Surface IoU以及基于评分规则的视觉语义身份Judge四个指标评估了前沿大模型的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CAD基准多侧重于合成或CAD原生设定、输入模态有限，或仅依赖可执行性和IoU进行评估，无法全面评估参数化CAD建模的真实能力。需要引入真实工业设计意图驱动的多模态基准和更全面的评估框架。

Method: 构建RealCADBench数据集，包含从19个工厂自动化类别搜集的12,632个任务，涵盖Part建模（4种输入模态：文本、2D工程图、真实图片、渲染图像）和Assembly建模；每个方法生成FreeCAD API Python代码，在共享运行时中执行并导出3D模型；使用可执行性、Solid IoU、Surface IoU和rubric-based视觉语义Judge四个指标进行评估。

Result: 九个独立前沿大模型中无一能在四个指标上全部领先。六个前沿规模大模型的可执行性范围为0.565-0.812，Solid IoU为0.2841-0.5379，Surface IoU为0.112-0.217。在RCB-Assm25上，Codex与GPT-5.5的组合提升了可执行性和IoU指标但Judge分数下降6.98个百分点。论文还识别出反复出现的失败模式：细结构缺失、部件身份丢失和装配位置错误。

Conclusion: 仅凭执行能力不足以刻画真实CAD建模性能，前沿模型在可执行性、IoU和视觉语义身份等不同维度上差异显著，需要综合多维度指标进行评估。

Abstract: Parametric computer-aided design (CAD) modeling is difficult to evaluate with a single metric. Existing CAD benchmarks often emphasize synthetic or CAD-native settings, limited input modalities, or executability and IoUs alone. We introduce RealCADBench, a benchmark for intent-to-program CAD modeling from real industrial design intents. It contains 12,632 tasks from 19 factory-automation categories and spans text descriptions, 2D engineering drawings, real product pictures, and rendered images for both Part and Assembly modeling. We report results on a 1,770-task evaluation slice: 1,745 Part tasks across four input regimes and RCB-Assm25, a 25-task assembly study used in every reported assembly comparison. Each method generates FreeCAD API Python, which a shared runtime executes to export the 3D model. We evaluate the exported model using executability, Solid IoU, Surface IoU, and a rubric-based visual-semantic identity Judge. Among the nine standalone frontier large models evaluated, no model leads all four metrics. Across six frontier-scale large models, executability ranges from 0.565 to 0.812, Solid IoU from 0.2841 to 0.5379, and Surface IoU from 0.112 to 0.217 across the four Part regimes. The highest regime-balanced composite comes from a different model than the leaders on the four component metrics. On RCB-Assm25, Codex with GPT-5.5 improves executability and both IoU metrics over standalone GPT-5.5, but lowers the Judge score by 6.98 percentage points, leaving GPT-5.5 as the Judge leader. We also observe recurring failure modes, most notably missing fine structures, loss of part identity, and incorrect assembly placement. These results show that execution alone is insufficient to characterize realistic CAD modeling and that frontier models and agents differ substantially across executability, IoUs, and visual-semantic identity.

</details>


### [69] [A Reverse Sign Language Dictionary: Open-Vocabulary Sign Recognition from Continuous Signing via Video Captioning and Description Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03788)
*Santiago Poveda-Gutiérrez,Hideki Nakayama,Mayumi Bono*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于描述而非词汇标签的孤立手语识别方法：用视觉-语言模型将手语片段标注为自由形式的程序化描述，再通过多语言句子编码器在目标描述词汇表中检索最近邻条目，实现无需词汇监督的开放词汇手语反向词典。在日语手语对话语料的1,300个片段上，微调后可见类top-10检索从4.5%提升至49%，不可见类从11.5%提升至21.0%，证明了该方法在开放词汇场景的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统孤立手语识别被设定为封闭集词汇分类问题，无法泛化到训练中未见的手语词汇，且每次部署都依赖带词汇标注的词典。这严重限制了系统在实际连续手语场景中的实用性。

Method: 采用两阶段流水线：(1) 用开放权重视觉-语言模型将手语片段改写为自由形式的程序化动作描述；(2) 用多语言句子编码器将生成的描述与目标描述词汇库进行最近邻检索匹配，实现开放词汇的手语检索，全程无需词汇级监督。

Result: 在日语手语对话语料的1,300个手语片段上（目标词汇表503项，随机基线top-10仅2%）：语言与视觉分支联合微调将可见类top-10检索从4.5%提升至49%，在三个测试集中的两个上与标准监督式封闭集分类器（I3D）统计上无显著差异；不可见类检索也显著提升（11.5%→21.0%，p=0.0094），这是封闭集分类器无法参与的设定。匹配端上界分析显示句子编码器已能恢复接近100%的改写黄金描述，表明瓶颈在于描述生成质量。

Conclusion: 这是首个无需词汇监督、基于描述的开放词汇连续手语检索方法，也是首个面向日语手语的方法。实验证明在可见类上可与监督式封闭集分类器匹敌，在不可见类上具备封闭集方法无法企及的开放词汇能力。未来工作重点在于提升描述生成质量，因为检索端已接近上限。

Abstract: Isolated Sign Language Recognition (ISLR) is conventionally cast as closed-set classification over gloss labels, which cannot generalize to signs unseen in training and ties every deployment to a gloss-annotated lexicon. We instead recognize signs extracted from continuous signing by (1) captioning a sign-level clip into a free-form procedural description of the articulation with an open-weight vision-language model, and (2) retrieving the closest entry from a vocabulary of target descriptions with a multilingual sentence encoder: a reverse sign language dictionary that needs no gloss supervision and admits an open vocabulary. On 1,300 sign-level segments from a Japanese Sign Language (JSL) dialogue corpus annotated with procedural descriptions (against a 2% top-10 chance floor over the 503-entry target vocabulary), fine-tuning the captioner substantially improves seen-class retrieval: language and vision tower fine-tuning raises top-10 retrieval on seen classes from 4.5% (untrained) to 49%, becoming statistically indistinguishable from a standard supervised closed-set classifier (I3D) on two of the three test sets where a closed-set classifier can be evaluated at all. More importantly, unseen-class retrieval also improves significantly over the untrained pipeline (11.5% -> 21.0% top-10, p=0.0094), a regime in which the closed-set classifier cannot participate. A matcher-side empirical upper-bound analysis shows the sentence encoder already recovers close to 100% of paraphrased gold descriptions, locating a gap in captioning quality that we aim to address in future work. To our knowledge this is the first description-based, open-vocabulary sign lookup from continuous signing without gloss supervision, and the first for JSL.

</details>

*Chuyan Chen,Haoxing Chen,Kun Chen,Zhenglin Cheng,Long Cui,Ruishan Fang,Zhangxuan Gu,Zhicheng Huang,Zhenzhong Lan,Yuanting Lei,Haoquan Li,Jianguo Li,Rongchuan Li,Sidu Li,Tao Lin,Deyuan Liu,Jiacheng Liu,Lin Liu,Yuxuan Lou,Zhisheng Lu,Yuxin Ma,Shuheng Shen,Peng Sun,Chaoyang Wang,Hongjun Wang,Xiaomei Wang,Yongxin Wang,Chengzhang Wu,Hongru Wu,Jun Xie*

Abstract: We introduce LLaDA-Image, a unified framework that pairs a 6B Diffusion Transformer (DiT) trained from scratch with a frozen vision-language understanding module built on the LLaDA2.0-Mini diffusion language model backbone. Instead of relying heavily on paired image-text data from the beginning, we first build a strong visual generative prior through image-only pre-training and mid-training. The generation pipeline comprises 220M samples, 98 of which are real images. For efficient and scalable optimization, we use parameter-free RMSNorm throughout the DiT together with the Muon optimizer. The resulting unified model produces highly photorealistic images while accurately following fine-grained editing instructions. We further distill LLaDA-Image into LLaDA-Image-Turbo, enabling fast inference in 2-4 sampling steps. On Qwen-Image-Bench, LLaDA-Image achieves overall scores of 53.53 and 53.38 on the English and Chinese tracks, respectively, setting a new state-of-the-art among open-source models on both tracks. To support further research on capable and efficient generative models, we release our model weights, training code, and detailed recipes.

</details>

Conclusion: 该研究提供了可复现的城区级封闭社区识别基准与先进多模态方法，为城市形态与公平性量化分析提供了新工具和数据资源。

Abstract: Communities are fundamental spatial units that shape urban form and social life. Whether a residential compound is spatially open or enclosed affects mobility, access to public services, and equity, yet studies of Chinese fengbi xiaoqu remain largely qualitative or small-scale, limiting reproducible city-scale analysis. We address this gap by introducing GBA-GCs, a metropolitan-scale multimodal benchmark for locally grounded gated/open community recognition in China's Greater Bay Area, covering 37,444 residential compounds with aligned boundary polygons, high-resolution satellite imagery, Chinese metadata, and structured attributes, together with expert-verified labels, inter-annotator reliability, and official evaluation splits. Built on this benchmark, we present Multimodal Classifier for Gated Community (MCGC), a vision-centric multimodal framework based on DINOv3-SAT that fuses imagery, text, and structured cues via modality-aware cross-attention and adaptive gating to mitigate modality imbalance. MCGC consistently outperforms strong unimodal and multimodal baselines. Finally, we apply the validated model to metropolitan-scale mapping and report equity-oriented findings including spatial clustering of GCs, privatized green space, and reduced pedestrian connectivity. The benchmark, code, and release documentation are available at https://github.com/MinweiZhao/GBA-GCs.

</details>


### [72] [VisCAD: A Foundation Model Suite with Multimodal Industrial CAD Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03811)
*JoyIndustrial VisCAD Team,Linxin Cai,Qiuhe Hong,Zhichao Huang,Guanlin Li,Hongsen Liu,Ziqi Liu,Yichen Long,Luya Wang,Yuchen Wang,Wenxiang Wu,Huimu Yu,Ning Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VisCAD是一个面向工业产品CAD设计的AI基础模型套件，包含27B参数的VisCAD-M1核心模型，用于零件级设计生成，通过中期训练和后训练实现跨多种输入模态（渲染图、文本、2D图纸、真实照片）的广泛泛化，并在PubCADBench和RealCADBench基准上达到最优零件级性能；同时提供利用前沿模型处理复杂装配生成的领域专用框架，在定量和定性评估中均优于通用方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有专业CAD模型通常训练在狭窄的输入域（如仅渲染图或文本），泛化能力差；而通用前沿模型虽能覆盖更广输入但跨CAD域表现不稳定。工业产品的CAD设计包含零件级生成和装配级生成两大挑战性阶段，需要同时具备广泛泛化能力和强大CAD专业能力的解决方案。

Method: VisCAD包含两个关键组件：(1) VisCAD-M1，一个27B参数的基础模型，通过中期训练（mid-training）和后训练（post-training）两阶段进行训练，处理零件级设计生成，将多种形式的用户意图（渲染图、文本、2D图纸、真实照片）映射为CAD领域特定语言中的可执行程序；(2) 领域专用harness框架，利用前沿模型处理装配级生成，管理零件间的交互、规划配合关系、估计位姿并正确放置所有零件。此外，VisCAD-M1还可复用为测试时验证器来进一步提升性能。

Result: 在PubCADBench和RealCADBench基准上，VisCAD-M1在零件级生成绩效中取得所有评估模型中的最高平均分0.5540，超过最强前沿模型的0.5496；将VisCAD-M1复用为测试时验证器可将分数进一步提升至0.5797，相对此前最优结果提升约5%。VisCAD的领域专用harness在装配级生成中，定量和定性评估均优于通用harness方案。

Conclusion: VisCAD证明了一条兼顾广泛输入模态泛化与专业CAD能力的技术路径：通过构建大型专用基础模型并结合领域定制化的测试时验证和装配处理框架，能够同时超越通用前沿模型和专业窄域CAD模型，为工业产品的AI辅助CAD设计提供了更强的解决方案。

Abstract: AI-assisted computer-aided design (CAD) for industrial products involves two challenging phases. Part-level generation maps diverse forms of user intent, including renders, text descriptions, 2D drawings, and real photographs, to executable programs in a CAD domain-specific language. Assembly-level generation must additionally handle interacting parts, plan mating relations, estimate poses, and place all parts correctly. Existing specialized CAD models are commonly trained on narrow input domains, such as renders or texts, and often generalize poorly, while general-purpose frontier models cover broader inputs but perform inconsistently across CAD domains. We present VisCAD, a foundation model suite designed to provide both broad generalization and strong CAD capability for realistic industrial products. At its core is VisCAD-M1, a 27B model trained through mid-training and post-training for part-level design generation. On PubCADBench and RealCADBench, VisCAD-M1 achieves the highest average part-level score among the evaluated models, reaching 0.5540 compared with 0.5496 for the strongest frontier model. Reusing VisCAD-M1 as a test-time verifier can further raise the score to 0.5797, an approximately 5 percent relative improvement over the previous state of the art. VisCAD also includes a domain-specific harness that leverages frontier models for complex assembly generation and demonstrates advantages over general-purpose harnesses in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

</details>


### [73] [SPARK: Input-Conditioned Sparse Activation Modulation for Frozen DiT-based Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03813)
*Federico Putamorsi,Leonardo Zini,Marcella Cornia,Lorenzo Baraldi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SPARK，一种轻量级输入条件控制器，仅对冻结的DiT超分模型中少数"主导通道"做有界仿射变换，即可同时提升保真度和感知质量，无需微调主网络或附加适配器。在三种DiT骨干、三个数据集上仅调制每流每块8个通道即取得一致增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前真实图像超分辨越来越多依赖Diffusion Transformer骨干，但其内部激活常被少量大规模通道主导。现有提升感知质量的方法仍需要微调网络或添加适配器，忽略了这种结构化激活空间作为适应接口的潜力。本文希望探索能否利用主导通道作为一个紧凑的适应接口来改进冻结的DiT超分模型。

Method: SPARK包含：(1) 通过在线激活排序流程识别主导通道；(2) 仅对选中的通道预测有界逐通道仿射变换的轻量输入条件控制器；(3) 控制器以低分辨率VAE潜变量为条件进行优化；(4) 保持超分主干和VAE完全冻结。

Result: 在三种DiT超分骨干上的DIV2K、RealSR和DRealSR数据集中，仅调制每流每块8个通道即可在保真度和感知质量上取得一致提升。控制对比实验表明这些增益不能仅由参数预算或选通道权限解释。

Conclusion: 主导通道可作为一种紧凑而有效的适应接口，在不访问主干参数更新的前提下显著改善DiT超分模型的输出质量，为冻结模型的后端适配提供了新方向。

Abstract: Real-world image super-resolution (SR) increasingly relies on Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbones, whose internal activations can be dominated by a small number of massive channels. Yet improving perceptual quality in these models still typically requires fine-tuning the network or attaching additional adapters, leaving this structured activation space largely unexplored for adaptation. We investigate whether dominant channels can instead serve as a compact adaptation interface for frozen DiT-based SR models. We first characterize their behavior in pretrained SR backbones and show through controlled interventions that they strongly affect reconstruction quality. Building on this observation, we introduce SPARK, a lightweight input-conditioned controller that predicts bounded per-channel affine transformations for only the selected channels, while keeping the SR backbone and VAE frozen. Dominant channels are identified through an online activation-ranking procedure, and only a small predictor conditioned on the low-resolution VAE latent is optimized. Experiments on three DiT-based SR backbones across DIV2K, RealSR, and DRealSR show consistent gains in both fidelity and perceptual quality while modulating only eight channels per stream and block. Controlled comparisons further show that these gains cannot be explained by parameter budget or access to the selected channels alone.

</details>


### [74] [Select, Compress, Reinvest: A Controlled Study of Visual-Token Allocation in Long-Video MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03820)
*Prakhar Khatri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了长视频语言模型中的帧选择问题，发现帧选择是比空间压缩更强的性能杠杆，且将压缩节省的token再投资到更多压缩帧上可进一步提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频语言模型只能处理固定数量的一小部分帧，而哪些帧被保留通常被视为预处理细节被忽略。由于已发表的帧选择器同时在帧评分器、提示边界、分辨率策略和答题模型等多个维度上不同，导致跨论文比较极为困难，因此需要在一个受控框架内逐一隔离各决策因素进行研究。

Method: 在受控评测框架中，固定其他因素而每次只变化一个决策，分别研究帧选择、空间压缩以及节省token的再投资三个维度。使用六种无需训练的帧选择规则、三个长视频基准和两个答题模型进行系统比较。帧选择规则包括基于查询的选择和Orthogonal Matching Pursuit等稀疏近似算法。

Result: 帧选择是最大的单一性能杠杆：在LongVideoBench小时级区间上，8个查询选择的帧比16个均匀间隔的帧高出6.9分。Orthogonal Matching Pursuit这个未修改的几十年历史的稀疏近似算法在三个基准上均与所有专用选择器相当或接近。压缩几乎无损，空间预算减半最多只损失0.44分。将节省的token再投资于两倍数量的压缩帧可额外获得2-3分，压缩只有在节省被这样使用时才有价值。此外，发现AKS基线自身的实现错误以及同一规则在不同测试框架下0.07到3.74分的差异，说明了受控评测的必要性。

Conclusion: 帧选择策略应被视为长视频语言模型的一个重要设计维度而非预处理细节；压缩+再投资策略是有效的提升手段；跨论文比较这些方法具有误导性，必须在一个统一的受控评测框架内进行。

Abstract: Long-video language models cannot look at every frame: an hour sampled once per second is 3,600 images, and a system keeps only a small fixed slice of that pool. Which frames survive that slice is usually treated as a preprocessing detail; we test whether it should be. Published selectors make the comparison hard because they change the frame scorer, the prompt boundary, the resolution policy, and the answering model all at once. We hold each fixed and vary one decision at a time: selection, spatial compression, and reinvestment of the savings, across six training-free selection rules, three long-video benchmarks, and two answering models. Selection is the largest single lever: on LongVideoBench's hour-long bin, eight query-selected frames beat sixteen uniformly spaced ones by 6.9 points, and Orthogonal Matching Pursuit, an unmodified decades-old sparse-approximation algorithm, matches or comes within a point of every purpose-built selector we compare it against, across all three benchmarks. Compression is close to free: halving each frame's spatial budget at fixed timestamps costs at most 0.44 points. Reinvestment is where that budget turns back into accuracy: spending the freed tokens on twice as many compressed frames, at a measured cost no higher than the original eight, returns a further two to three points; compression only pays off once its savings are spent this way. Along the way, an implementation bug in our own AKS baseline and a 0.07 to 3.74 point gap between two harnesses running the same published rules at the same budget show why these comparisons need to happen inside one controlled harness rather than across papers.

</details>

Abstract: 3D foundation models (3DFMs) excel at predicting camera poses and dense depth from multiple views of a scene, showcasing strong zero-shot generalization. Inertial measurement units (IMUs), present in most devices, naturally complement monocular cameras by observing scaled motion. VI3 initializes and preintegrates the IMU to obtain a metric motion reference, which is then used to recover the scale of the 3DFM outputs. Abstract: Few-shot fine-grained image classification (FSFGIC) aims to classify similar images with limited labeled examples. ### [78] [OctWorld: Long-Range World-Consistent Video Generation with Octree-Based 3D Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03919)

TL;DR: 提出OctWorld，一个视频扩散框架，通过引入OctMap——基于动态稀疏八叉树和TSDF融合的持久3D记忆——实现沿相机轨迹的长程、世界一致且高保真的场景生成。

Abstract: We present OctWorld, a video diffusion framework with persistent 3D memory for generating explorable, world-consistent, and high-fidelity visual scenes. Given a single image, OctWorld performs stable autoregressive world generation along user-specified camera trajectories. We focus on long-range generation, characterized by extended camera paths and wide viewpoint coverage, where preserving spatial consistency is particularly challenging when previously generated regions are revisited. To address this problem, we introduce OctMap, an extensible and spatially adaptive 3D memory that progressively fuses generated visual observations and their corresponding depth maps into a global representation. OctMap employs TSDF fusion within a dynamic sparse octree whose spatial resolution adapts to image evidence. This design preserves geometric and appearance details across diverse scene scales while maintaining low memory overhead. Experiments demonstrate that OctWorld generates long-range, spatially consistent videos and outperforms prior methods on both existing benchmarks and challenging long-range generation settings. OctMap also provides clear advantages over point-based caches and fixed-resolution TSDF volumes. Project page: https://maxtirerror.github.io/octworldpage/

</details>


### [79] [Sparse auto-regressive modeling for scene generation from multi-view images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03931)
*Thomas Lucas,Maxime Pietrantoni,Philippe Weinzaepfel,Wonjune Cho,Bardienus Pieter Duisterhof,Vincent Leroy,Jerome Revaud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SPAR3S，一种基于稀疏体素对齐3D潜空间的生成模型，用于从不完整的多视角图像中进行条件场景补全，无需真实3D标注，通过可微3D高斯泼溅和掩码自回归Transformer实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏、无约束的视角生成完整3D场景是3D视觉中的基础挑战。现有前馈重建方法受限于输入图像中可见内容，而3D生成建模受高计算成本和大规模3D监督稀缺的制约。

Method: SPAR3S采用稀疏体素对齐的3D潜空间，仅表示被占据的体素以降低计算复杂度。通过可微3D高斯泼溅从多视角图像中以光度监督方式学习该稀疏潜空间，无需3D真值。随后使用掩码自回归Transformer联合建模体素占据状态与潜token值，实现场景补全。
