The resulting low-dimensional representation simultaneously preserves structural similarity and encodes energy-related deviations, enabling the identification of potentially inefficient sites through peer-relative comparison. The derived anomaly scores provide a practical mechanism for prioritising field investigations, allowing mobile network operators to focus engineering resources on sites most likely to yield energy savings. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms conventional anomaly detection baselines and provides a robust foundation for large-scale energy-efficiency optimisation in mobile networks.

</details>


### [246] [Witnesses Explain Anomalies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03826)
*Lamine Diop*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WAND是一种可解释的、无监督的表格异常检测器，通过单位球上的方向组织计算，将检测分数与特征归因一体化，在不牺牲ROC-AUC精度的前提下（在47个ADBench数据集上达到最佳平均Friedman排名），其原生解释比SHAP/LIME后验解释更准确、更忠实且查询成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流无监督异常检测器仅给出异常分数，却无法说明是哪些特征导致了该异常。现有做法是事后用SHAP或LIME进行解释，但这些方法需要反复查询检测器数千次且仅是近似解，效率低且不准确。作者希望设计一个"天然可解释"的检测器，使解释不是事后附加而是算法的固有输出。

Method: WAND围绕单位球面上的方向组织计算。每个点通过其投影距离亚高斯极值基线（sub-Gaussian extreme-value baseline）的远近来打分。关键创新在于：标记一个点为异常的"见证方向"（witness directions）本身就是特征空间中的向量，天然构成了逐特征归因解释，因此解释在打分过程中零成本获得；又因分数可微，也可通过梯度恢复解释。算法在样本量上呈线性复杂度，并具有探针效率界（probe-efficiency bound），保证每个异常都能被某个方向捕获从而获得解释。

Result: 在47个ADBench数据集上，WAND在16个无监督基线中取得了最佳平均Friedman排名，且ROC-AUC与此前方法相当，即在不损失精度的前提下获得了可解释性。其原生解释在准确性和忠实度上优于SHAP/LIME后验解释及ECOD，而查询开销仅为它们的一小部分。

Conclusion: WAND提供了一个实用且可解释的解决方案，表明在无监督异常检测中，准确性与可解释性可以同时兼得，打破了"先用黑箱检测再事后解释"的范式。

Abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection scores each point of an unlabelled, contaminated sample in a single pass, and increasingly must also explain why a point is flagged. Yet the dominant detectors give a score with no account of which features drive it, and explanations are bolted on post-hoc with SHAP or LIME, which re-query the detector thousands of times per point and only approximate it. We introduce WAND, an unsupervised tabular anomaly detector that is explainable by design. WAND organises its computation around directions on the unit sphere, scoring each point by how far its projection escapes a sub-Gaussian extreme-value baseline. The originality of our approach is that the witness directions that flag a point, being vectors in feature space, are its explanation, a per-feature attribution obtained at no cost over scoring and, since the score is differentiable, recoverable by gradients. Scoring is linear in the sample size, and a probe-efficiency bound guarantees every anomaly a witness, hence an explanation. Across 47 ADBench datasets WAND attains the best mean Friedman rank at ROC-AUC parity with 16 unsupervised baselines, so the gain is interpretability at no accuracy cost; its native explanations are more accurate and faithful than post-hoc SHAP/LIME and ECOD at a fraction of the query cost. WAND is thus a practical, interpretable solution for explainable anomaly detection.

</details>


### [247] [Multi-step Proximal Policy Improvement in Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03842)
*Soohyun Choi,Seonvin Cho,Songnam Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种离线强化学习的几何视角，将策略视为概率流形上的点，并基于此提出多步近端策略改进（MPI）机制，通过在数据集支持范围外进行受控的渐进式策略改进，提升了TD3+BC、ReBRAC和IQL等强基线的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线RL面临两难困境：策略更新需贴近数据集支持的動作以保持价值估计可靠，但显著的性能提升往往需要超越行为分布。现有方法缺乏对此张力进行系统性处理的理论框架。

Method: 本文将策略建模为带度量几何的概率流形，证明一类广泛的离线actor目标可被解释为单步近端策略改进（SPI），即由critic定义能量诱导的流形梯度流的隐式离散化。在此基础上提出多步近端策略改进（MPI），通过序列组合重定心的近端步骤实现受控的、逐步超越数据集支持的策略改进，并支持多种策略几何（确定性策略和对角高斯策略）。

Result: 在D4RL基准测试中，少量MPI精炼步骤即可在多个任务上提升TD3+BC、ReBRAC和IQL等强离线基线。消融诊断进一步区分了重定心精炼与固定目标更新调度的区别，并刻画了critic误差下的局限性。

Conclusion: MPI提供了一种即插即用的策略精炼机制，能在保持近端控制的同时实现受控的分布外探索，为离线RL中安全策略改进提供了新的几何理论框架和实用算法。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) must reconcile two competing requirements: policy updates should stay near dataset-supported actions to keep value estimates reliable, yet meaningful gains often require moving beyond the behavior distribution. We develop a geometric view of offline actor updates by modeling policies as a probability manifold endowed with a chosen metric geometry. Under this lens, a broad class of offline actor objectives can be interpreted as a single proximal policy improvement step (SPI), i.e., an implicit discretization of a manifold gradient flow induced by a critic-defined energy. Building on this insight, we propose multi-step proximal policy improvement (MPI), a plug-in refinement mechanism that composes sequential re-centered proximal steps. MPI enables controlled policy improvement beyond dataset support while retaining proximal control at each refinement. The framework accommodates multiple policy geometries and admits practical instantiations for deterministic and diagonal-Gaussian policies. Experiments on D4RL benchmarks show that small numbers of MPI refinements improve strong offline baselines, including TD3+BC, ReBRAC, and IQL, on many tasks. Focused diagnostics further distinguish re-centered refinement from fixed-objective update scheduling and characterize limitations under critic error.

</details>


### [248] [Pushing the (Decision) Boundaries: Dynamically Calibrating Differentially Private Noise to Explainability in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03851)
*Michael Khavkin,Kichang Lee,Jaeho Jin,JeongGil Ko,Eran Toch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出XCal-FL，一种闭环可解释性驱动的联邦学习本地训练算法，通过三种互补信号（预测logit变化、反事实边际、显著性集中度）动态校准差分隐私噪声，在保持正式DP保证的同时提升模型准确性和解释保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带差分隐私的联邦学习虽广泛用于保护数据机密性，但DP噪声会扭曲学习表征并降低解释保真度，限制了需要可信解释的DP-FL场景（如辅助临床诊断）。现有方法仅将DP噪声适配静态特征重要性信号，将可解释性限制于事后分析，无法在训练过程中根据解释质量校准噪声。可解释性作为隐私权衡中独立于效用的维度，需要专门的动态噪声校准机制。

Method: 提出XCal-FL闭环训练算法，从三个信号动态校准DP噪声：(1)预测logit变化量——衡量对模型置信度的因果影响；(2)反事实边际——捕捉决策边界敏感性；(3)显著性集中度——量化模型注意力空间连贯性。通过自适应隐私核算强制执行形式化DP保证，在跨孤岛（cross-silo）联邦学习的图像分类任务中实现本地训练的闭环可解释性驱动噪声校准。

Result: 在三个医学影像数据集及多种联邦学习配置下，XCal-FL相比静态噪声FL提升预测性能超过10%、解释保真度最高达5倍，并在保真度上优于最先进的自适应DP方法。XCal-FL实现更高的隐私预算效率，将每个单位的累计隐私损失转化为更大的准确率和解释保真度增益。分析发现预测性能随隐私损失近似线性增长，而解释保真度呈现非线性动态。

Conclusion: 可解释性是隐私权衡中独立于效用的维度，不能仅从效用推断。该发现对决策关键型应用中训练及隐私预算分配具有重要意义，XCal-FL为DP-FL中需要可信解释的场景提供了更优的范式。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) with Differential Privacy (DP) is increasingly adopted to preserve data confidentiality in distributed machine learning. However, DP noise distorts learned representations and degrades explanation fidelity, limiting differentially private FL where trustworthy explanations are required, such as assistive clinical diagnosis. Prior work adapted DP noise with static feature-importance signals, restricting explainability to post hoc analysis and precluding noise calibration to explanation quality during training. We propose XCal-FL, a closed-loop, explainability-driven local training algorithm for image classification in cross-silo FL that dynamically calibrates DP noise from three complementary signals: (1) prediction logit variations, measuring causal influence on model confidence, (2) counterfactual margins, capturing decision-boundary sensitivity, and (3) saliency concentration, quantifying spatial coherence of model attention, while enforcing formal DP guarantees via adaptive privacy accounting. Experiments on three medical imaging datasets across varying FL configurations show that XCal-FL yields more accurate and interpretable global models, improving predictive performance by over 10\% and explanation fidelity by up to 5$\times$ over static-noise FL, and outperforming state-of-the-art adaptive DP methods in fidelity. XCal-FL also achieves higher privacy-budget efficiency, turning each unit of cumulative privacy loss into larger gains in both accuracy and explanation fidelity. Our analysis further reveals that, unlike predictive performance, which scales roughly linearly with privacy loss, explanation fidelity exhibits non-linear dynamics. These findings suggest explainability is a distinct dimension of the privacy trade-off that cannot be inferred from utility alone, with implications for training and privacy-budget allocation in decision-critical applications.

</details>


### [249] [High-Dimensional Learning Dynamics of Attention-Indexed Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03858)
*Yizhou Xu,Margarita Sagitova,Lenka Zdeborová,Florent Krzakala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究注意力机制的训练动力学，提出了注意力索引模型框架。在高温（高维）极限下，群体损失景观由有限个迹阶参数刻画；而在线SGD则由无限矩阵矩层级控制，但其可被有限截断系统指数级近似。文章揭示了注意力参数化本身可作为架构隐式偏置：直接优化S矩阵会陷入无信息状态，而绑定注意力(WW^T)自动引发对称性破缺并在Θ(d²log d)样本内弱恢复，非绑定注意力(UV^T)则展现出快慢动力学机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力机制是现代基础模型的核心，但其训练动力学——特别是当注意力矩阵具有高秩时——仍缺乏理论理解。作者旨在建立统一的数学框架来分析多层和多头注意力架构的训练动态。

Method: 提出注意力索引模型（attention-indexed models）这一广泛框架。在合适的高维极限下，利用迹阶参数（trace order parameters）的有限集合刻画群体损失景观；针对在线SGD，证明其由无限矩阵矩（matrix moments）层级主导，而这些矩可被有限截断系统指数级近似。随后分析三种注意力参数化方式（直接S、绑定WW^T、非绑定UV^T）下的梯度动力学特性。

Result: (1) 群体损失景观在高维极限下由有限组迹阶参数完全刻画；(2) 在线SGD的无限矩层级可通过有限截断系统指数逼近；(3) 直接优化注意力矩阵S会陷入无信息状态；(4) 绑定注意力(S=WW^T)自动产生对称性破缺机制，在Θ(d²log d)样本内实现弱恢复；(5) 非绑定注意力(S=UV^T)呈现快慢动力学：预激活均值在快时间尺度演化，而重叠在慢时间尺度演化，弱恢复发生在快动力学选择的状态打破初始对称性时。

Conclusion: 注意力参数化的选择本质上是一种架构隐式偏置，显著影响训练动力学和样本效率。绑定与解绑注意力分别通过对称性破缺和快慢机制实现弱恢复，这一理论框架为理解常见注意力架构（多层、多头）的训练行为提供了统一视角。

Abstract: Attention mechanisms are central to modern foundation models, yet their training dynamics remain poorly understood, especially when the attention matrices have extensive rank. In this work, we study attention-indexed models, a broad framework that can represent multi-layer and multi-head attention architectures. First, we show that, in a suitable high-dimensional limit, the population-loss landscape is characterized by a finite set of trace order parameters. In contrast, online stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is governed by an infinite hierarchy of matrix moments, which we show can be exponentially well-approximated by a finite truncated system. Second, this framework reveals that attention parameterization itself can act as an architectural implicit bias. Direct optimization of an attention matrix $S\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$ can remain trapped in an uninformative state. Tied attention ($S=WW^\top$) induces an automatic symmetry-breaking mechanism and yields weak recovery in $Θ(d^2\log d)$ samples. For untied attention, $S=UV^\top$, we uncover a fast-slow mechanism: the pre-activation mean first evolves on a fast timescale, while the overlaps evolve on a slower one. Weak recovery on the $Θ(d^2\log d)$ scale occurs when the state selected by the fast dynamics breaks the initial symmetry.

</details>


### [250] [Differentiable Interval Bottlenecks for Interpretable Anomaly Detection in Numerical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03878)
*Lamine Diop,Marc Plantevit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DIFFINT，一种可解释的基于重构的异常检测器，其潜变量瓶颈结构化为软轴对齐区间成员，端到端学习无需离散化，在48个ADBench基准上取得最佳平均排名（ROC-AUC 4.10, AUPR 4.16），且是唯一具有可解释性的领先方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于重构的异常检测器（如深度自编码器）准确但黑箱：它们能标记异常样本，却无法告诉从业人员哪些特征范围导致样本异常，缺乏可审计的内部可解释结构。

Method: DIFFINT将自编码器的潜变量瓶颈结构化为一组软的、轴对齐的区间成员，直接从原始数值数据端到端学习。每个潜变量单元对应特征空间中一个人可读的超矩形；用Lipschitz约束解码器提供认证的重构误差下界；提供闭式无需标签的重要性评分来排序（单元，特征）对。

Result: 在48个ADBench基准上对比22个基线（统一[-1,1]归一化协议），DIFFINT在两个指标上均取得最佳平均排名（ROC-AUC 4.10, AUPR 4.16）；在仅内点训练检测器中明显领先，与最强受污染数据检测器竞争相当。它是统计上并列领先的七个方法中唯一的可解释检测器。

Conclusion: DIFFINT证明了在保持可微表示学习能力的同时，可以暴露可检查的内部结构，实现准确性与可解释性的兼顾，为异常检测提供可审计的候选约束，无需任何异常标签。

Abstract: Reconstruction-based anomaly detectors are accurate but opaque: a deep autoencoder flags a sample without telling a practitioner which feature ranges made it anomalous. We propose DIFFINT, an autoencoder whose latent bottleneck is structured as a set of soft, axis-aligned interval memberships learned end-to-end directly from raw numerical data, without any discretization or binarization. Each latent unit corresponds to a human-readable hyper-rectangle in feature space; an instance is encoded by how strongly it falls inside each interval relative to the other units, and its reconstruction error is the anomaly score. This keeps the power of differentiable representation learning while exposing an inspectable internal structure. We make the inductive bias precise: a certified reconstruction-error lower bound for points that fall outside every active coordinate of the learned support (with a Lipschitz-enforced decoder), and a graded, empirically verified suppression mechanism for the usual case in which only a few features are abnormal; and we provide a closed-form, label-free importance that ranks each (unit, feature) pair from quantities the model already maintains, turning trained intervals into auditable candidate constraints without ever seeing an anomaly label. On 48 ADBench benchmarks against 22 baselines under a common [-1, 1]-normalized protocol, DIFFINT attains the best mean rank overall on both metrics (4.10 on ROC-AUC, 4.16 on AUPR); among inlier-only detectors it leads its regime clearly, and it is competitive with the strongest contaminated-data detectors (see the stratified and complete-case analyses). It is the only interpretable detector in the statistically-tied leading cluster of seven methods.

</details>


### [251] [Beyond Endpoint Scores: Time- and Capacity-Conditioned Evaluation of Continual Knowledge Updating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03900)
*Heejin Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现持续知识更新（continual knowledge updating）方法在不同评估时间点和不同回放LoRA秩（rank）条件下，胜者排名会发生反转。基于单点checkpoint和单一适配器秩的评价方式不足以识别真正的更优操作点。作者提出应报告轨迹和容量扫描，并仅当排序在评估区域内稳定时才宣布稳健胜者，否则应报告胜者区域及保留-稳定性-成本前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续知识更新方法常以单一最终checkpoint和单一常规适配器秩来宣称方法优越性，作者认为这种评估可能不够充分，因为方法优劣可能随评估时间和基线适配容量变化而改变，导致不公平或误导性的结论。

Method: 在固定周期性层级结构（periodic hierarchy）的前提下，作者将其与累计回放（cumulative replay）在24个月Wikidata数据流上进行对比，同时变化三个维度：评估月份、回放LoRA秩、查询表述方式。实验在Qwen2.5-1.5B和Llama-3.2-1B上验证，并包含持有出去的改写查询（held-out paraphrases）测试。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B上，层级结构相对于rank-8回放有5.0分优势，但相对rank-72回放则变为11.6分的劣势；在高秩条件下，若只看对齐后的最终端点可能得出平局的结论，而时间平均回放实际领先9-13分。同样的随秩反转现象在Llama-3.2-1B和held-out改写上也重复出现。

Conclusion: 持续更新中的方法排名可能同时依赖于性能测量时间和回放侧适配容量。应报告评估轨迹和容量扫描，仅当排序在评估区域内稳定时才可宣称稳健胜者；否则需报告胜者区域及保留-稳定性-成本前沿。按此协议，周期性层级结构是一个更低更新成本的操作点，而非质量上的胜者。

Abstract: Continual knowledge-updating methods are often declared superior from one final checkpoint and one conventional adapter rank. We show that this can be insufficient to identify the better operating point. Holding a periodic hierarchy fixed, we compare it with cumulative replay over a 24-month Wikidata stream while varying evaluation month, replay LoRA rank, and query formulation. The apparent winner changes across this region: on Qwen2.5-1.5B, the hierarchy's 5.0-point advantage over rank-8 replay becomes an 11.6-point deficit against rank-72 replay, and at high ranks a consolidation-aligned endpoint can suggest a tie while time-averaged replay leads by 9-13 points. The same rank-conditioned reversal appears on Llama-3.2-1B and held-out paraphrases.
  These results show that method ranking in continual updating can depend jointly on when performance is measured and how much replay-side adaptation capacity the baseline receives. We therefore propose reporting trajectories and capacity sweeps, and declaring a robust winner only when the ordering is stable across the evaluation region; otherwise, comparisons should report winner regions and retention-stability-cost frontiers. Under this protocol, the periodic hierarchy is a lower-update-cost operating point, not a quality winner.

</details>


### [252] [RATL: Learning from Retrieved Residuals for Robust Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03937)
*Yuchen He,Yueyang Cang,Zhiyuan Ning,Ningyu Wang,Li Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RATL是一种用于多元时间序列预测的即插即用残差检索与反馈校正方法：冻结基础预测器，将历史预测残差构建为仅训练内存，推理时依据因果约束检索相似历史残差轨迹，并通过集合感知路由器进行选择与组合，从而在不修改基础模型的情况下提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG思想对连续输出回归虽有吸引力，但直接复用检索到的目标值在输出水平、数值尺度或局部动态不一致时不够鲁棒；传统预测流程虽然用残差做优化与误差诊断，但并未将历史残差样例作为推理时可访问的记忆保留下来。

Method: RATL包含三个核心环节：(1) 冻结基础预测器以构造检索键，将历史预测残差转化为该基础模型特定的仅训练内存；(2) 推理时在因果可用性约束下，从相似历史上下文中检索残差轨迹；(3) 使用覆盖预测块和变量的集合感知路由器来选择并组合这些残差轨迹，并通过验证集进行校正强度选择以限制残差过度注入。

Result: 实验表明历史残差在上下文匹配时包含可复用的预测信息；RATL在大多数实验设置下提升了冻结基础预测器的性能；消融实验证明学习路由强化了原始残差反馈，验证驱动的校正强度选择限制了残差过度注入。在真实世界基准上以iTransformer为主要冻结基础预测器，RATL在多数设置下进一步提升了基础模型性能，并展示了跨骨干网络的迁移能力。

Conclusion: RATL将检索对象从历史目标值转变为基础模型特定的历史预测误差，为连续输出预测提供了一种即插即用、基于残差记忆的学习式反馈校正范式，证明了历史残差中蕴含的可复用预测信息能够有效增强冻结基础预测器。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) complements parametric models with retrieved external evidence. The same idea is attractive for continuous-output regression, but directly reusing retrieved target values is often not robust when samples differ in output level, numerical scale, or local dynamics. Moreover, conventional forecasting pipelines generally use residuals for model optimization and error diagnosis, but do not retain individual historical residual examples as memory that can be accessed at inference time.For multivariate time-series forecasting, we propose RATL, a plug-in residual-retrieval and feedback-correction method. RATL freezes a base forecaster to construct retrieval keys and turns its historical forecast residuals into a train-only memory specific to that base model. At inference time, RATL retrieves residual trajectories from similar historical contexts subject to causal availability constraints, then uses a set-aware router operating over forecast blocks and variables to select and combine these trajectories. Experiments show that historical residuals matched to the current context contain reusable forecasting information and that RATL improves frozen base forecasters in most experimental settings. Ablations further show that learned routing strengthens raw residual feedback, while validation-based correction-strength selection limits residual over-injection.On real-world benchmarks, we use iTransformer as the primary frozen base forecaster, compare against multiple strong forecasting baselines, and test transferability across backbones. The results show that RATL can further improve base-forecaster performance in most settings.Overall, RATL shifts the retrieved object from historical target values to base-model-specific historical forecast errors, providing a plug-in, residual-memory-based paradigm for learned feedback correction in continuous-output forecasting.

</details>


### [253] [Headroom-Drift Replay: A Primitive for Principled Replay Control in GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03941)
*Hyun Bin Park,Du-Seong Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Headroom-Drift Replay，一种仅通过重放选择即可提升RL后训练效率的GRPO控制原语，将回放决策拆分为"Headroom"（按剩余学习价值排序）与"Drift"（按当前策略兼容性门控）两个环节，在不添加辅助生成或训练机制、保持在线策略流不变的前提下，在数学推理、多模态推理和Agentic Search基准上优于朴素回放并匹敌或超越更复杂的重放方法，同时显著降低Agentic Search的墙钟时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL中基于重放的推理模型后训练正受到反复生成新轨迹的瓶颈制约，尤其在Agentic场景下环境交互主导墙钟成本。现有重放方法通常嵌入在包含探索、经验重构或混合策略优化的更大训练管线中，难以单独评估重放本身的贡献。作者希望聚焦回答一个更纯粹的问题：仅靠原则性的重放选择能做到多好。

Method: 提出Headroom-Drift Replay，将其作为GRPO的组级重放控制原语。它将轨迹复用决策拆分为两个互补机制：Headroom负责对存储的轨迹组按"剩余学习价值"进行排序，Drift则按"与当前策略的兼容性"对组进行门控筛选。原始在线策略流保持不变，不引入任何额外的生成器或训练机制，从而实现了对重放贡献的干净隔离。

Result: 在数学推理、多模态推理和Agentic Search基准上，仅此单一干预即可胜过朴素重放，并在Avg Mean@32指标上匹敌或超越更复杂的重放方法。在环境交互主导成本的Agentic Search场景中，该方法在保证质量相当的同时实现了可观的墙钟时间下降。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，经过精心设计的重放选择本身就可以是高效且有效的——无需复杂的探索、经验重构或混合策略基础设施，仅靠Headroom-Drift这一原则性的组级重放控制，就能在多种推理基准上取得具有竞争力的性能，并在Agentic场景中显著节省墙钟成本。

Abstract: RL-based post-training for reasoning models is increasingly bottlenecked by repeated fresh rollout generation, particularly in agentic settings where environment interaction dominates wall-clock cost. Replay can reduce this burden by reusing past trajectories, but existing methods typically embed it within larger training pipelines involving exploration, experience restructuring, or mixed-policy optimization. This makes replay's own contribution difficult to isolate. We ask a focused question: how far can principled replay selection alone go? We introduce Headroom-Drift Replay, a group-level replay control primitive for GRPO that separates reuse into two decisions. Headroom ranks stored groups by remaining learning value, while Drift gates them by compatibility with the current policy. The fresh on-policy stream remains unchanged, and the method adds no auxiliary generation or training machinery. Across mathematical reasoning, multimodal reasoning, and Agentic Search benchmarks, this single intervention outperforms naive replay and matches or exceeds broader replay methods on Avg Mean@32. In Agentic Search, where environment interaction dominates cost, it delivers comparable quality at materially lower wall-clock time.

</details>


### [254] [VestigeKV: The NoPE-MLA KV Cache Carries Its Own Eviction Signal in a Vestigial Branch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03949)
*WenJie Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出VestigeKV方法，利用NoPE模型的解耦分支（RoPE残留通道被重用作显著性信号）实现免查询的KV缓存压缩。无需训练、量化或修改权重/内核，通过将非重要行归档到GPU驻留的位精确存档区（而非删除），在无需获取query前即可完成压缩，检索性能在8x-32x压缩比下保持近乎完美。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长生命周期KV缓存必须在读取它的query出现之前完成压缩，而现有基于观测注意力进行token选择的方法（如H2O、SnapKV）在这种情况下失效（NoPE MLA模型上needle检索得分为0.00-0.33），因为token的重要性尚未被观测到。需要一种query无关的压缩信号。

Method: VestigeKV利用Kimi Linear缓存中已存在的64维解耦分支作为query无关显著性信号。读取每行的11%内容，将缓存分为两层：top-m行保留在参与注意力（attended）层，其余行被精确移动（而非删除）到GPU驻留的archive，每个step可通过认证触发器访问。该操作仅在NoPE（无旋转位置编码）架构下有效，因为RoPE条件下query无关显著性和精确合并被证明不可能。

Result: 在8x压缩下检索保持1.00，32x下为0.92（8k至65k上下文），与全行选择无差距。32x时attended层仅占Kimi Linear每token缓存（8.1KB）的0.25KB；标准recall层配置在128x时仍保持1.00。相同算子在RoPE MLA模型上性能崩塌至0.08。所有阈值在数据之前冻结，附带20个归档验证结果和8条封闭路线。

Conclusion: VestigeKV证明在NoPE架构中，解耦分支可被训练过程自发重做成一个有效的query无关显著性通道，使得在query出现前即可进行无损且检索保持的KV缓存压缩。该方法对Kimi Linear有效，并可能扩展到使用NoPE Gated-MLA的Kimi K3（若缓存布局匹配），但作者声明不对被测模型之外做任何推广性声称。RoPE架构从根本上不支持此类query无关的精确压缩。

Abstract: The problem. A long-lived KV cache must be compressed before the queries that will read it exist; selection by observed attention (H2O, SnapKV) collapses there (0.00-0.33 needle retrieval on a NoPE MLA model), because a token's importance has not yet been observed. The method. On Kimi Linear, VestigeKV evicts by a query-independent signal the cache already carries: the 64-dimensional decoupled branch, a vestige of RoPE that NoPE training repurposes into a salience channel. Reading 11% of each row, it partitions the cache: the top-m rows stay in the attended tier; every other row moves -- exactly, never deleted -- to a GPU-resident archive reachable per step by a certified trigger. No training, no quantization, no weight or kernel change. Cost. Nothing measurable: retrieval holds at 1.00 under 8x and 0.92 under 32x from 8k to 65k context, zero gap to full-row selection. The attended tier is 0.25 KB of Kimi Linear's 8.1 KB per-token cache at 32x; the archive stays bit-exact and GPU-resident, with host offload as the VRAM-reclaiming variant. The recall tier -- the standard configuration -- holds 128x at 1.00. Kimi K3 is reported to use a NoPE Gated-MLA variant; if its cache layout matches, the method plausibly extends there -- we make no claim beyond the measured model. NoPE exclusivity. The identical operator on a RoPE MLA collapses to 0.08 (plain eviction: 0.42); query-independent salience itself exists only without rotation (top-1 targets span 2.3-6.7% of tokens vs. 10.2-46.8%), and query-universal exact merging is provably impossible under RoPE. All thresholds were frozen before data; 20 archived verdicts and 8 closed routes accompany the paper.

</details>


### [255] [OSR: Output Space Redistribution for Adaptive Label Removal in Classification Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03972)
*Minyi Peng,Darian Gunamardi,Ivan Tjuawinata,Yongsen Zheng,Kwok-Yan Lam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于输出空间统计重分配的类别标签移除方法，作为一种模块化输出过滤器，无需访问原始数据、特征空间调整或损失函数收敛，即可近似重训练模型移除标签后的置信度向量，兼具计算效率与隐私保护优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分类系统（taxonomy）动态演化的场景中，类别标签频繁被移除，分类模型须相应更新。现有方案（重训练法与特征空间调整法）虽形式各异，但均存在依赖原始数据、计算与存储开销大、结果不一致、可扩展性差以及模型效用下降等共同缺陷。

Method: 提出在输出空间进行统计重分配（statistical redistribution）的方法，用于近似重训练模型移除类别后的置信度向量。该方法可作为模块化输出过滤器使用，仅需现有标签及先前的输出置信度信息，避免了特征空间调整或损失函数收敛的负担，从而缓解可扩展性限制并降低隐私风险。

Result: 在多种分类任务上的大量实验表明，该方法在性能上与完全重训练具有竞争力，同时在计算效率和隐私保护方面具有显著优势。

Conclusion: 该方法通过绕过数据依赖与特征空间操作，为类别标签移除场景提供了一种高效、可扩展且隐私友好的解决方案，其性能可与完全重训练相媲美。

Abstract: Label removal occurs frequently in classification systems with evolving taxonomies, where categories must be dynamically updated or eliminated. To accommodate such changes, classification models must adapt accordingly. Existing solutions, broadly categorized as retraining-based and feature-space-adjustment-based, share common limitations despite their variations, including reliance on access to original data, substantial computational and storage costs, inconsistent results, poor scalability, and degradation of model utility. To address this, we propose a novel approach that leverages statistical redistribution in the output space to approximate the post-removal confidence vectors of a retrained model. Applicable as a modular output filter, our method bypasses the burden of feature-space adjustments or loss-function convergence, alleviating scalability limitations. Furthermore, by requiring only existing labels and prior output confidences, the method potentially mitigates privacy concerns inherent to data-dependent solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance against full retraining, with improvements in computational efficiency and privacy preservation across several classification tasks.

</details>


### [256] [RobustSeiz: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking the Robustness of EEG Seizure Detection Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04007)
*Mohammad Mohammadi,Alireza Zarei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RobustSeiz是一个开源的、模型无关的框架，用于在临床相关的分布偏移下对癫痫发作检测器进行标准化压力测试和比较，支持跨四个公开头皮EEG数据集（CHB-MIT、TUSZ、Siena、SeizeIT1）的鲁棒性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癫痫发作检测器在独立测试数据上表现良好，但在真实世界的采集变异性、伪迹和对抗性输入下可能失效。现有研究缺乏标准化的、可复现的协议来在部署前对检测器进行临床激励下的鲁棒性压力测试。

Method: 将四个公共头皮EEG语料库标准化为BIDS-EEG树结构；在独立于受试者的留出划分上评估检测器；对环境、噪声和对抗性变换在预定义超参数网格上进行扫描；每个运行记录样本级和事件级的灵敏度、精度、F1、每24小时假阳性、发作起止延迟以及蒙特卡洛dropout预测一致性；提供Docker化GPU流水线、实验注册表以及完整评估和研究子集两种模式。

Result: 用当代癫痫检测器在TUSZ数据集的完整转换网格上演示了框架；AWGN分析说明了扰动严重程度如何改变检测质量、发作起始时序和预测一致性。

Conclusion: RobustSeiz为在真实临床压力源下评估癫痫检测器的鲁棒性提供了一个共享基准标准，将部署前评估从仅依赖干净数据准确率扩展到更全面的鲁棒性测试。

Abstract: Despite strong performance on held-out electroencephalography (EEG) data, seizure detectors may fail under real-world acquisition variability, artifacts, and adversarial inputs. We introduce RobustSeiz, an open-source, model-agnostic framework that provides a standardized, reproducible protocol for stress-testing and comparing seizure detectors under controlled, clinically motivated distribution shifts before deployment. We standardize four public scalp-EEG corpora (CHB-MIT, TUSZ, Siena, and SeizeIT1) into BIDS-EEG trees and evaluate subject-independent detectors on held-out splits. Environment, noise, and adversarial transforms are swept over predefined hyperparameter grids. Each run reports sample- and event-level sensitivity, precision, F1, false positives per 24 h, Lead and Lag onset timing, and Monte Carlo dropout predictive agreement. RobustSeiz includes a Dockerized GPU pipeline, experiment registry, and full-evaluation and research-subset modes. We demonstrate the framework with a contemporary seizure detector on TUSZ across the complete implemented shift grid; an AWGN analysis illustrates how perturbation severity changes detection quality, onset timing, and predictive agreement. RobustSeiz provides a shared benchmarking standard for evaluating seizure-detector robustness under realistic clinical stressors, extending pre-deployment assessment beyond clean-data accuracy.

</details>


### [257] [Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04010)
*Subham Sekhar Sahoo,Lingjie Chen,Khiem Pham,Jonathan Geuter,Chaitanya Dwivedi,Varad Pimpalkhute,Yash Akhauri,Alexander Moreno,Mikhail Yurochkin,Zhenting Wang,Mostafa Elhoushi,Nolan Dey,Shane Bergsma,Joel Hestness,John Thickstun,Eric Xing,Zhengzhong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Uno，一种扩散增强的大语言模型，通过将AR参数与轻量扩散参数解耦，实现并行多token生成，突破自回归解码的序列瓶颈。Uno无需独立草稿模型即可实现无损加速，最高获得3倍速度提升，且在8B规模下超越更大规模的开源专有diffusion LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的成功依赖next-token prediction，但自回归结构要求逐token顺序生成，导致推理速度瓶颈。已有方案中，投机解码需要额外草稿模型且质量受限；纯diffusion LLM则牺牲底层AR模型质量。因此需要一种既能保持AR模型性能又具备并行生成能力的架构。

Method: 1) 提出diffusion-augmented LLMs：将模型参数解耦为AR权重（用标准NTP目标训练）和轻量diffusion权重（用Diffusion Distillation阶段训练以并行生成多个token）；2) 引入Ψ-Spec采样器家族，在固定上下文长度内实现无损加速和推理时扩展；3) Uno模型可从零训练或通过增强已有开源权重AR LLM构建。

Result: Uno在每种评估批次大小下吞吐量均高于领先的投机解码方法；相对基础AR模型获得最高3倍加速（包括设备支持的最大批次）；8B Uno在agentic工具使用、编码和长上下文推理的所有评估基准上超越26B DiffusionGemma和专有的Mercury 2。

Conclusion: Uno成功结合AR模型的生成质量与diffusion的并行加速优势，证明通过轻量diffusion权重的扩增即可在不依赖草稿模型且不牺牲AR质量的前提下实现显著推理加速，且小规模模型具备超越大规模diffusion LLM的实际能力。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) owe much of their success to next-token prediction (NTP), but their autoregressive (AR) structure requires slow, sequential token generation. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce diffusion-augmented LLMs, a new class of models that defines an AR model distribution while using diffusion to draw multiple tokens in parallel from that distribution. We decouple the parameters of these models into two sets: AR weights, trained using the standard NTP objective, and lightweight diffusion weights, trained to generate multiple tokens simultaneously. The diffusion weights are learned through a simple Diffusion Distillation phase that adds negligible overhead to existing LLM training pipelines. We also introduce $Ψ$-Spec, a family of samplers that enables lossless acceleration and inference-time scaling at a fixed context length. Unlike speculative decoding, our method requires no separate draft model. Unlike diffusion LLMs (d-LLMs), it accelerates generation without sacrificing the quality of the underlying AR model. The resulting models, called Uno, can be trained from scratch or built by augmenting existing open-weight AR LLMs. Uno achieves higher throughput than leading speculative-decoding methods at every evaluated batch size and delivers up to $3\times$ speedups over the base AR model, including at the largest batch size supported by the device. Notably, our 8B Uno model outperforms the leading open d-LLM, the 26B DiffusionGemma, and the proprietary Mercury 2 across all evaluated benchmarks in agentic tool use, coding, and long-context reasoning. We release code and checkpoints at: https://s-sahoo.github.io/uno/

</details>


### [258] [A location-invariant estimator of extremal quantile treatment effects for heavy-tailed distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04018)
*Xin Yu,Shuwei Huang,Jicheng Liu,Jielin Tang,Bolin Wang,Yunxiao Zhang,Tian Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在重尾分布下具有位置不变性的极端分位数处理效应（QTE）估计方法。针对现有极端QTE估计器在潜在结果分布发生共同位置平移时不再不变的问题，作者提出两步解决方案：首先将位置不变的Fraga极值指数（EVI）估计器通过逆倾向得分加权适配到因果框架；其次用一种差分方案替代原始外推公式，使分位数差值中的位置参数相互抵消。最终得到的QTE估计器具有位置不变性，并证明了其一致性和渐近正态性，提供了相合方差估计器，并通过模拟研究验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在极端分位数水平上估计处理效应（QTE）对于超出数据范围的目标分位数至关重要。对于重尾潜在结果，现有极端QTE估计器依赖外推结合因果极值指数（EVI）估计，但该估计器在潜在结果分布发生共同位置平移时不再具有不变性，而总体QTE本身是位置不变的。这一不一致性是本文试图解决的核心问题。

Method: 本文分两步解决位置不变性问题：(1) 将位置不变的Fraga EVI估计器通过逆倾向得分加权（IPSW）适配到因果设定中；(2) 用基于差分的方案替换原始外推公式，使位置参数在计算分位数差值时相互抵消。作者随后建立了所提极端QTE估计器的一致性、渐近正态性，并给出相合方差估计器以实现渐近有效的推断。

Result: 模拟研究证实了所提方法具备位置不变性，对阈值选择具有稳定性，且覆盖概率良好。理论结果上，估计器具有一致性和渐近正态性，并提供相合的方差估计器以支撑渐近有效的统计推断。

Conclusion: 通过将位置不变的Fraga极值指数估计器融入因果框架并采用差分式外推方案，本文成功构建了重尾潜在结果下位置不变的极端QTE估计器，解决了现有方法在极端分位数处理效应估计中的位置不变性缺陷，在理论上和数值上均验证了其有效性和可靠性。

Abstract: Quantile treatment effects (QTEs) measure the effect of a treatment on the distribution of an outcome, and their estimation at extreme quantile levels is of central interest in applications where the target quantiles lie far beyond the range of the data. For heavy-tailed potential outcomes, existing extremal QTE estimators rely on extrapolation combined with a causal extreme value index (EVI) estimator, but the resulting estimator is not invariant under a common location shift of the potential outcome distributions, even though the population QTE is. We address this issue in two steps. First, we adapt the location-invariant Fraga estimator of the EVI to the causal setting using inverse propensity score weighting. Second, we replace the original extrapolation formula with a difference-based scheme, under which the location parameter cancels when quantile differences are taken. The resulting QTE estimator is therefore location invariant. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed extremal QTE estimators, and provide a consistent variance estimator, leading to asymptotically valid inference. A simulation study confirms the location invariance, the stability with respect to the threshold, and the coverage of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [259] [Conditioning Degenerate Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04090)
*Uğur Aydın,Tamer Başar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用因果最优传输来替代传统的score函数引导机制，为条件生成模型在奇异扩散系数且密度不存在或不光滑的情况下定义近似损失函数，从而以最小假设识别最小熵控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件生成模型在训练过程中严重依赖score函数进行引导，但当扩散过程具有奇异扩散系数且底层条件密度不存在或不光滑时，基于score函数的方法失效。作者希望通过因果最优传输来解决这一局限。

Method: 利用因果最优传输及其通过（条件）扩散过程的鞅问题适定性的可预测表示性质（à la Üstünel）来刻画问题，定义近似的损失函数以识别最小熵控制作为引导。

Result: 在最小假设下成功定义了可用的近似损失函数，能够为奇异扩散系数及非光滑或不存在条件密度的场景提供最小熵控制引导方案。

Conclusion: 因果最优传输为条件生成模型提供了一种不依赖score函数假设的引导框架，扩展了方法在更一般扩散场景下的适用性。

Abstract: Current conditioned generative models heavily rely on score functions for guidance during training. When the generative model is a diffusion process with a singular diffusion coefficient and the underlying (conditional) densities either do not exist or are not smooth, we use causal optimal transport to define \emph{approximate} loss functions that identify a minimum-entropy control for guidance under minimal assumptions. Our approach relies on causal optimal transport and its characterization through the predictable representation property of (conditioned) diffusion processes whose associated martingale problem is well posed, à la Üstünel.

</details>


### [260] [Hardware-Aware FP4 FlashAttention-4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04105)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Direct-P方法，通过将softmax概率直接量化为FP4格式并使用因果路径直接在反向传播中使用前向量化，解决了FP4张量核心在注意力计算中因softmax转换和片上依赖导致的性能瓶颈，在NVIDIA GB200上实现最高2.13倍BF16前向吞吐提升，以及单GPU 8B参数更新最高1.14倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Blackwell的FP4张量核心虽然具有巨大的算力优势，但由于矩阵乘积缩小后softmax转换和片上依赖成为瓶颈，注意力计算并不能自动获得加速。因此需要专门的算法设计来充分利用FP4的低精度硬件能力。

Method: 提出两种路径：(1) Direct-P用于非因果推理，将scores直接映射为FP4概率；(2) 因果路径将前向量化直接传入反向传播，从保存的量化查询和键重建概率，使用FP8梯度操作数。训练时保留FP8概率和值格式。

Result: 在NVIDIA GB200上，Direct-P达到最高2.13倍于BF16的前向吞吐；因果路径使完整单GPU 8B参数更新加速最高1.14倍。对比实验显示所有测试的MXFP4概率/值训练轨迹均发散，而匹配的分布式训练保持收敛。

Conclusion: FP4张量核心需要配合定制的量化和梯度处理策略才能有效加速注意力计算产生实用效果；通过直接FP4概率映射和FP8梯度操作数，在保持训练稳定性的同时实现了显著的推理和训练加速。

Abstract: Blackwell's 4-bit floating-point (FP4) tensor cores do not automatically make attention faster because softmax conversion and on-chip dependencies dominate once its matrix products shrink. We address this with \emph{Direct-P} for noncausal inference and a causal path that passes the forward quantization directly into backward. Direct-P maps scores directly to FP4 probabilities and reaches up to 2.13$\times$ the bfloat16 (BF16) forward throughput on an NVIDIA GB200. The causal path reconstructs probabilities from saved quantized queries and keys and uses 8-bit floating-point (FP8) gradient operands, accelerating a complete single-GPU 8-billion-parameter update by up to 1.14$\times$. Matched distributed training retains FP8 probabilities and values; every tested MXFP4 probability/value training trajectory diverges.

</details>


### [261] [Constant regret in general games via higher-order optimism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04113)
*Omar Abbadi,Rida Laraki,Panayotis Mertikopoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种解耦学习算法HOOD（带折扣的高阶乐观算法），在任意N人有限博弈中为所有玩家在任意时间范围内保证O(N³log²K)的个体遗憾，相比已有最优方法首次实现常数级遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在一般博弈中实现常数（无时间依赖）个体遗憾此前一直是未解决的难题。先前尝试的关键障碍在于无法有效控制博弈中induced解序列的大幅振荡。作者希望设计一种不依赖玩家之间通信的解耦算法，在一般N人博弈中突破遗憾随时间增长的限制。

Method: HOOD算法是乐观正则化追随者（OptFTRL）的变体，其核心创新包括：（1）使用折扣的(N+1)阶预测器；（2）在博弈策略空间的适当"提升"上引入熵正则化。这两个设计要素的目的是以受控方式抑制induced play序列的大幅振荡，从而消除此前实现常数遗憾的主要障碍。

Result: 该算法为所有玩家在任意N人、每人至多K个动作的一般正规形博弈中，实现了均匀于时间范围的O(N³log²K)个体遗憾界。该结果优于并类似同期独立工作中Liu、Farina和Ozdaglar通过高阶乐观与指数移动平均估计器得到的O(N²¹log⁴K)遗憾界。

Conclusion: HOOD通过高阶乐观预测与折扣相结合、并配合策略空间"提升"上的熵正则化，成功解决了博弈学习中序列振荡控制的难题，首次在一般解耦设定下实现了多项式依赖N和K的常数遗憾界。

Abstract: We introduce an uncoupled learning algorithm which, when employed by all players of an arbitrary $N$-player normal form game with up to $K$ actions per player, guarantees $O(N^3\log^2 K)$ individual regret, uniformly over the horizon of play. The proposed algorithm - which we call higher-order optimism with discounting (HOOD) is a variant of optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader (OptFTRL) that combines a discounted $(N+1)$-th order predictor with entropic regularization over a suitable "lifting" of the game's strategy space. This combination of ingredients is purposefully designed to dampen large oscillations of the induced sequence of play in a controlled manner, removing in this way a key stumbling block of previous attempts to achieve constant regret in general games. Our approach bears several striking similarities to the concurrent - and completely independent - work of Liu, Farina, and Ozdaglar (arXiv:2608.31166), who very recently derived an $O(N^{21}\log^{4} K)$ regret bound through the use of higher-order optimism and an exponential moving average estimator.

</details>


### [262] [Robust PAC Learning of Concurrent Stochastic Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04189)
*Angel Y. He,David Parker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个针对一般和并发随机博弈（CSG）且具有转移不确定性的PAC学习框架，通过数据驱动的L1置信集和鲁棒CSG求解，返回社交福利最优的ε-近似纳什均衡或证明不存在精确NE，采样复杂度为多项式级别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一般和并发随机博弈中的纳什均衡求解面临两大核心挑战：一是转移核未知导致需要在不确定性下学习；二是纳什均衡可能不存在，现有学习框架缺乏对均衡存在性的原则性推理机制。本文旨在同时解决这两个问题，建立第一个具有PAC保证的CSG学习框架。

Method: 算法维护数据驱动的L1置信集来刻画转移核的不确定性，通过求解鲁棒CSG来获得社交福利最优的ε-近似纳什均衡；利用基于鲁棒MDP的探索机制促进联合状态-动作覆盖；创新性地引入Nash margin刻画来实现对均衡存在性的原则性推理——框架要么返回ε-近似NE且社交福利值与最优值ε-接近，要么提供精确NE不存在的可靠证书。

Result: 在最小可达性条件p_reach>0下，算法在多项式数量的轨迹样本后终止，采样复杂度为Õ(R_max² H⁴ |S|² |A| / (p_reach ε²))。基准CSG上的实验展示了接近最优的性能、对均衡存在/不存在的正确处理，以及与理论一致的采样复杂度。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将PAC学习框架拓展到一般和CSG，并通过Nash margin刻画统一了"近似均衡的存在性验证"与"精确均衡不存在性证明"两个维度，为不确定性下博弈论学习的理论完备性提供了新范式。

Abstract: We introduce the first Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning framework for general-sum concurrent stochastic games (CSGs) with transition uncertainty, while addressing the challenge of Nash equilibrium (NE) existence. Our algorithm maintains data-driven $L^1$ confidence sets over transition kernels and solves a robust CSG to compute a social-welfare optimal $\varepsilon$-NE, using a robust MDP-based exploration mechanism to drive joint state-action coverage. Crucially, we introduce a Nash margin characterisation that enables principled reasoning about equilibrium existence: the framework either returns an $\varepsilon$-approximate NE whose social-welfare value is $\varepsilon$-close to optimal, or provides a sound certificate that no exact NE exists. Under a minimum reachability condition $p_{\mathrm{reach}}>0$ over relevant state-action pairs, the algorithm terminates after a polynomial number of trajectory samples, with sample complexity $\widetilde{O}\left( {R_{\max}^2 H^4 |S|^2 |A| / (p_{\mathrm{reach}} \varepsilon^2)} \right)$. Empirical results on benchmark CSGs demonstrate near-optimal performance, correct handling of equilibrium (non-)existence, and sample complexity consistent with theory.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [263] [Seeing Less Is Not Seeing Safely: Privacy Leakage from Task-Scoped Robot Perception Exports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03055)
*Yuqiao Xu,Erman Ayday*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出任务功能感知蒸馏（TFPD）框架，用于在保持丰富感知本地化的同时，按照任务效用和多种推理风险对下游导出的结构化表征进行配置与评估。在AI2-THOR和ProcTHOR场景上的实验表明，任务等价性与隐私不等价性可同时存在，且不存在通用的隐私排序，需针对具体任务进行多风险评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家庭机器人依赖丰富的感知能力在私人住宅中运行，但即使原始传感器数据保留在本地，导出的结构化表征（如语义、几何、空间结构和任务目标）仍可能通过多种途径泄露家庭信息。现有方法缺乏对下游导出表征进行系统化、任务范围内隐私风险评估的方法。

Method: 提出TFPD框架，包含三个核心要素：（1）保持丰富感知本地化，仅导出任务范围内的表征；（2）按任务效用、直接暴露及多种残余推理风险对导出表征进行画像；（3）在120个AI2-THOR场景中采用场景不相交的划分、冻结攻击者选择及表征感知的留出攻击进行评估，并在ProcTHOR上进行复制验证。

Result: 三种导航导出在任务上完全等价（成功率均为1.000，平均路径比为0.898），但表征级可链接性范围从0.532到0.970不等；将显式目标标签替换为目标区域可将目标类别macro-F1从1.000降至0.077而任务成功率仅损失0.005；几何粗化可降低物体类别macro-F1但带来可测的碰撞效用成本。ProcTHOR复制验证了任务等价与隐私不等价共存的发现，但归一化与拓扑导出的相对排序发生变化。

Conclusion: 研究证明既不存在单一字段移除或更强抽象能保证通用隐私保护，也不存在通用的隐私排序，因此必须对完整的公开表征进行任务特定、多维度的风险评估。TFPD为此提供了系统性评估框架。

Abstract: Domestic robots rely on rich perception to operate in private homes, but privacy risk persists even when raw sensor data remain local. Structured representations exported to downstream planners, cloud services, logs, or learning pipelines can still reveal household information through semantics, geometry, spatial structure, and task targets. We introduce Task-Functional Perception Distillation (TFPD), a task-scoped representation-export framework that keeps rich perception local and profiles downstream exports according to task utility, direct exposure, and multiple residual inference risks. Using 120 AI2-THOR scenes with scene-disjoint train/validation/test splits, frozen attacker selection, and representation-aware held-out attacks, we evaluate navigation, collision checking, and object-goal execution. Three navigation exports achieve identical success (1.000) and mean path ratio (0.898), yet representation-level linkability ranges from 0.532 to 0.970. Replacing an explicit target label with a target region reduces target-category macro-F1 from 1.000 to 0.077 while preserving success at 0.995, while geometric coarsening reduces object-category macro-F1 from 0.704 to 0.556 at a measurable collision-utility cost. A ProcTHOR replication preserves the navigation task-equivalence/privacy-inequivalence finding while changing the relative ordering of normalized and topological exports. These results show that neither field removal nor stronger abstraction induces a universal privacy ordering and motivate task-specific, multi-risk evaluation of the complete public representation.

</details>


### [264] [GPU-Accelerated Astrodynamics World Models for Spacecraft Rendezvous and Proximity Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03067)
*Duncan Eddy,Isaac R. Ward,Grace Ra Kim,Mykel J. Kochenderfer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文首次将世界模型（World Model）范式应用于航天器交会对接与近距操作任务。作者构建了一个基于JAX的、支持GPU并行仿真的ISS（国际空间站）对接环境用于生成训练数据，并提出了Out-of-This-World-Model——一种基于Transformer的世界模型，融合相对运动学状态与相机图像编码为潜在状态，通过单步流匹配预测状态演化。该模型在胶囊自主对接ISS任务中，较强化学习基线显著提升了样本效率与任务成功率（53%对29%），在未见过的停靠口上展现出更好的分布外泛化能力（40%对17%），并能以98%的准确率检测接近过程中的异常物体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型在机器人与游戏环境中的表现已十分出色，但尚未被应用于太空领域。航天器交会对接与近距操作（如卫星服务、空间站对接）需要多步规划和不确定性估计，而这正是世界模型的优势所在，因此作者希望将这一新兴范式引入太空场景，以提升自主对接的性能与安全性。

Method: 本文方法包含三部分：(1) 构建基于JAX的ISS对接仿真环境，支持GPU并行模拟轨道与姿态动力学，生成大量状态-动作转移数据；(2) 提出Out-of-This-World-Model，一种基于Transformer的世界模型，将相对运动学状态与相机图像编码为潜在表征，利用单步流匹配（one-step flow matching）预测潜在状态在外部推力/力矩指令下的演化，输出未来观测的分布以捕捉随机动力学与逐时间步不确定性；(3) 将上述模型应用于带禁飞区约束的胶囊自主对接任务中，并与DreamerV3风格的后验修正基线及强化学习基线进行对比。

Result: 在ISS对接任务中，所提方法取得了53%的对接成功率（强化学习基线仅29%）；在未见过的停靠口上，世界模型将基线成功率提升一倍以上（40%对17%），展现出更好的分布外泛化能力；在异常物体检测上达到98%的分类准确率。同时，该模型以更少的可训练参数和超参数超越了DreamerV3风格的后验修正基线。

Conclusion: 本文验证了世界模型在太空领域（尤其是航天器自主交会对接）的有效性与可行性，展现出优于强化学习的样本效率、任务表现和分布外泛化能力，并开源了仿真环境与模型架构以促进该范式的进一步研究。

Abstract: World models are an emerging paradigm in representation learning in which an agent jointly learns state-action dynamics and observation models from offline trajectory data, enabling multi-step planning and trajectory prediction with uncertainty estimates. They have shown strong results in robotics and game environments, but, to the best of our knowledge, have not previously been applied to the space domain. This paper introduces a world model-based approach to cooperative and non-cooperative spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations. First, we introduce an open-source, JAX-based International Space Station (ISS) docking environment supporting parallel GPU simulation of spacecraft orbit and attitude dynamics, generating the thousands of state-action transitions that world model training requires. Second, we introduce Out-of-this-World-Model, a transformer-based world model that encodes relative kinematic states and body-fixed camera imagery into a latent state and predicts its evolution under commanded thrusts and torques using one-step flow matching. It produces a distribution over future observations, capturing stochastic dynamics and per-timestep uncertainty, and outperforms DreamerV3-style posterior-correction baselines with fewer trainable parameters and hyperparameters. Third, we apply the approach to a capsule autonomously docking with the ISS under keep-out-zone constraints, demonstrating improved sample efficiency and task performance over reinforcement learning baselines (53% versus 29% docking success across ports), better out-of-distribution generalization (on held-out ports the world model more than doubles baseline success, 40% versus 17%), and detection of anomalous objects encountered during approach with 98% classification accuracy. We open-source the simulation environment and model architecture to enable further study of this paradigm.

</details>


### [265] [Sensing Which Modality Matters: Evidence-Gated Regularization for Robust VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03142)
*Yue Yang,Diego Romeres,Chiori Hori,Gedas Bertasius,Daniel Szafir,Siddarth Jain*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出证据门控正则化(EGR)方法，解决视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略中的模态纠缠问题——即训练数据中传感器间的虚假相关性导致策略对干扰和不完整传感输入的脆弱性。EGR通过逐帧逐传感器的任务相关性信号门控两种状态条件一致性目标，零推理开销地提升VLA在遮挡和干扰下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略在多模态数据上训练时，由于机器人演示数据有限且同质，模型容易学习传感器间的虚假相关信号（称为模态纠缠），而非任务相关的真实信号。这导致在真实世界中遇到遮挡或多余传感器损坏时，策略对无关传感器信息的扰动表现出过度敏感（nuisance sensitivity），而当仅剩一个有效传感器时又无法仅凭该模态完成任务（单模态不足）。现有方法缺乏针对该问题的系统性解决手段。

Method: 提出Evidence-Gated Regularization (EGR)，一种模态无关的训练目标，零推理开销。EGR计算每个时间帧和每个传感器的任务相关性证据信号，以此门控两种状态条件一致性目标：对低证据传感器施加不变性约束，对高证据传感器施加单传感器充分性约束。构建了基于BEHAVIOR-1K的基准，包含快速推理诊断套件和47个基于rollout的技能任务。

Result: 在模拟中：全模态成功率从12.5%提升至16.4% (+31%)，信息不足传感器受腐蚀场景从9.4%提升至16.5% (+75%)，单传感器回退场景从2.8%提升至6.1% (+120%)。在真实机器人上：双臂Kinova+三RGB相机设置中，物理物体干扰下成功率从30%提升至85% (+183%)；单臂MELFA ASSISTA配合GelSight触觉设置中，从55%提升至70% (+27%)。

Conclusion: EGR有效缓解了VLA策略的模态纠缠问题，在模拟和真实机器人（不同形态构型、不同模态组合）上均验证了其泛化性和有效性，且不引入任何推理时开销，为多模态机器人策略的鲁棒训练提供了实用的正则化方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies fuse multimodal sensory inputs, but training on limited and homogeneous robot demonstrations encourages spurious inter-sensor correlations rather than task-relevant signal, a failure we term modality entanglement. Under real-world occlusions and distractors, this manifests as nuisance sensitivity to corruption of uninformative sensors and single-modality insufficiency when only one informative sensor remains intact. We propose Evidence-Gated Regularization (EGR), a modality-agnostic training objective that introduces zero inference-time overhead. EGR derives a per-frame and per-sensor task-relevance signal to gate two state-conditional consistency objectives: invariance on low-evidence sensors, and single-sensor sufficiency on high-evidence ones. We introduce a benchmark based on BEHAVIOR-1K, comprising a fast inference-only diagnostic suite and 47 rollout-based skills targeting modality entanglement. We validate EGR on this benchmark and on two real-robot setups with fundamentally different embodiments: a bi-manual setup with two Kinova arms and three RGB cameras, and a single-arm MELFA ASSISTA setup combining vision and GelSight tactile sensors. EGR improves simulation success rates (SR) from 12.5% to 16.4% under full modalities (+31%), from 9.4% to 16.5% under uninformative-sensor corruption (+75%), and from 2.8% to 6.1% under single-sensor fallback (+120%). Under physical-object distractors, EGR boosts SR from 30% to 85% on the bi-manual setup (+183%) and from 55% to 70% on the tactile setup (+27%).

</details>


### [266] [Real-Time Shape Control of Multi-Segment Soft Robotic Arms Using Koopman Operators with Global and Local Observables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03175)
*Jiahe Wang,Eron Ristich,Sultan Haidar Ali,Eric weissman,Lei Zhang,Wanxin Jin,Yi Ren,Jiefeng Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Koopman模型预测控制的框架，通过结合全局和局部可观测性实现多段软体机器人臂的实时形状控制，并在数值仿真（最多10段）和物理实验（3段和5段，最高末端速度0.6 m/s）中验证了其可扩展性、鲁棒性和动态性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多段软体机器人臂的形状控制对于受限空间任务至关重要，但由于连续体变形的高维性和非线性动力学特性，这一任务极具挑战性。现有方法仅以全局坐标系的形状误差作为控制目标，在多段软体臂中由于段间耦合、重力载荷和惯性效应的影响而不足，且这种困难随段数增加而加剧。

Method: 提出Koopman-based模型预测控制（MPC）框架，结合全局和局部可观测量作为控制目标与状态表征，实现对多段软体机器人臂的实时形状控制。

Result: 数值实验在最多10个独立驱动段的机器人上验证了控制器的可扩展性；物理实验表明：控制器能对3段和5段机器人臂实现最高0.6 m/s末端速度的实时形状控制；无需重训练即可实现对400 g远端载荷和7 N侧向扰动的鲁棒跟踪；并通过受限空间演示展示了未来检测应用的潜力。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了多段软体机器人臂动态、可扩展且精确的实时形状控制。

Abstract: Multi-segment soft robotic arms can continuously reconfigure their body shapes for safe interaction, but tip control alone is insufficient for constrained-space tasks. Therefore, shape control is a more important task for multi-segment soft arms than tip control, but remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and nonlinear dynamics of continuum deformation. In existing work, shape control accuracy is defined by the error in the global frame (global shape error). For multi-segment soft arms, using only global shape error as the control objective is insufficient, as segment coupling, gravity-induced loading, and inertial effects become more significant. This difficulty increases with the number of segments. In this paper, we present a Koopman-based model predictive control framework that combines global and local observables, enabling real-time shape control on multi-segment soft robotic arms. The framework is evaluated through numerical and physical experiments. Numerical experiments demonstrate the scalability of the proposed controller by achieving shape control on robots with up to 10 independently actuated segments. The physical experiments demonstrate that the controller is capable of (1) real-time shape control of 3- and 5-segment robotic arms with tip speeds up to 0.6 m/s, (2) robust tracking without retraining, including distal payloads up to 400~g and recovery from a 7~N lateral disturbance, and (3) the potential for future inspection applications through a confined-space demonstration. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework enables dynamic, scalable, and accurate real-time shape control on multi-segment soft robotic arms.

</details>


### [267] [Following a Unique Path: A Fast Certifier Applied to Outlier-Robust Pose Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03222)
*Connor Holmes,Abhishek Goudar,Timothy D. Barfoot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CP-Cert（中心路径认证器），一种专为处理具有特定简并性的非凸优化问题而设计的可认证方法。该方法以候选解为起点，寻找可行空间附近可快速获取有效证书的中心路径区域，通过间接线性代数、稀疏性和并行性保持高效。应用于矩阵加权位姿注册和点云数据关联，比现有最优直接求解器快最多三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可认证方法（如先局部求解再认证）在许多机器人学问题中因松弛的简并性（degeneracy）而失效，迫使只能依赖代价高昂的凸SDP松弛优化。需要一种能够针对此类简并性问题进行高效认证的新方法。

Method: CP-Cert以候选解为起点，在可行空间中寻找中心路径附近可快速获取有效证书的区域；利用间接线性代数技术、问题稀疏结构和并行计算保持效率；并提出了新的点云数据关联SDP松弛（独立贡献）。

Result: 在模拟实验中，CP-Cert在矩阵加权位姿注册和点云数据关联问题上的运行时间比最先进的直接求解器快最多三个数量级，速度快且可扩展；结合这些贡献构建了可认证、鲁棒离群点的位姿估计流水线并在真实数据上验证。

Conclusion: CP-Cert有效解决了简并性松弛下的认证难题，显著提升了此类问题的认证效率，且其新提出的数据关联SDP松弛和完整位姿估计流水线具有独立的研究与应用价值。

Abstract: Certifiable methods have arisen as a means to guarantee global optimality of solutions to non-convex problems using convex semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxations. The most performant of these methods use a local solver to obtain the candidate solution, and then certify its optimality using efficient linear algebra techniques. However, for many problems of interest in robotics, this local-solve-then-certify approach is impeded by a form of degeneracy in the relaxation, leaving a costly optimization of the relaxation as the only recourse. In this paper, we introduce our Central-Path Certifier (CP-Cert), a certifiable method explicitly tailored to certify candidate optima to problems that exhibit this form of degeneracy. Using a candidate as a starting point, our approach seeks a nearby region of the feasible space -- known as the central path -- where a valid certificate can be readily obtained. The approach is kept efficient by exploiting indirect linear algebra techniques, problem sparsity, and parallelism. We apply CP-Cert to both matrix-weighted pose registration and pointcloud data association, whose novel SDP relaxation is of independent interest. On simulated examples, we explore the properties of this novel relaxation and show that CP-Cert is fast and scalable, achieving runtimes that are up to three orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art direct solvers. Finally, we combine these contributions into a certifiable, outlier-robust pose-estimation pipeline, which we apply to real-world data.

</details>


### [268] [Long-Horizon Consistent and Interaction-Aware World Models for Multi-Style End-to-End Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03225)
*Yuxuan Han,Kunyuan Wu,Liyunong Yang,Zilu Wang,Cansen Jiang,Yi Xiao,Liang Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: StyleDrive是一个基于世界模型的端到端自动驾驶学习框架，通过时间一致性正则化、显式状态解耦和群体相对策略优化，分别解决长时域想象rollout的时间不一致性、自车与环境交互建模不足以及多驾驶风格适应性有限的问题。在Bench2Drive基准上，驾驶分数达到88.44（较此前最佳世界模型方法提升17.08），成功率66.82（提升16.58），并在真实AGV平台上验证了sim-to-real迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的强化学习框架虽然通过想象rollout提升学习效率，但存在三大关键局限：长时域想象rollout中的时间不一致性导致误差累积；自车与环境的交互状态建模不充分，缺乏可解释性；对多样化驾驶风格的适应性有限，难以在不重新训练的情况下支持不同驾驶行为偏好。

Method: StyleDrive提出三个核心模块：(1) 时间一致性正则化模块，通过门控交叉注意力整合历史隐状态，稳定长时域想象rollout并缓解误差累积；(2) 显式状态解缠模块，将交互状态分离为自车相关与自车无关两部分，提升复杂交通场景中决策的可解释性和效率；(3) 通过群体相对策略优化（GRPO）以轨迹级相对优势替代逐步奖励优化，降低奖励方差，实现无需重训练的多风格驾驶行为支持。

Result: 在Bench2Drive闭环驾驶基准上，StyleDrive的驾驶分数达到88.44，较之前最佳世界模型方法提升17.08；成功率达66.82，提升16.58。此外，在实际自动导引车（AGV）平台上完成部署，在动态驾驶场景中展示了良好的sim-to-real迁移性能。

Conclusion: StyleDrive通过统一学习范式联合解决长时域一致性、交互状态解缠和多风格策略优化三大挑战，在闭环基准和真实平台部署上均取得了显著优于现有世界模型方法的性能，验证了其有效性和实际部署可行性。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has increasingly adopted world model-based reinforcement learning frameworks to improve learning efficiency through \textit{imagined rollouts}. However, existing world models suffer from three key limitations: temporal inconsistency in long-horizon imagined rollouts, inadequate modeling of ego-environment interactions, and limited adaptability to diverse driving styles. To address these challenges, we propose \textit{StyleDrive}, a world-model-based learning framework that jointly enforces long-horizon consistency, explicitly disentangles interactive traffic states, and supports multi-style policy optimization within a unified learning paradigm. First, we introduce a temporal consistency regularization that integrates historical latent states through gated cross-attention, stabilizing long-horizon imagined rollouts and mitigating error accumulation. Second, we design an explicit state disentanglement module that separates ego-relevant from ego-irrelevant interactive states, enabling more interpretable and efficient decision-making in complex traffic scenarios. Third, we enable multi-style driving behaviors through Group Relative Policy Optimization, which replaces per-step reward optimization with trajectory-wise relative advantages, reducing reward variance and supporting diverse driving styles without retraining. We evaluate StyleDrive on the Bench2Drive closed-loop driving benchmark, achieving a driving score of 88.44 (+17.08 over the previous best world model-based method) and a success rate of 66.82 (+16.58). Furthermore, we deploy StyleDrive on a real automated guided vehicle platform and demonstrate promising sim-to-real transfer capability in dynamic driving scenarios.

</details>


### [269] [Establishing a Dynamic Multimodal HRI Dataset for Engagement Analysis with a Humanoid Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03255)
*Buwan Kim,Wonse Jo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种构建多模态数据集的实验设计，用于分析人机交互（HRI）中的用户参与度。该数据集整合了可穿戴生理信号、行为数据和自我报告的测量指标，覆盖不同任务复杂度的条件。




<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究主要依赖可观察的行为线索来分析HRI中的用户参与度，缺乏整合生理信号的框架，因此需要一种更全面的结构化数据采集协议来弥补这一空白。

Method: 设计了一种结构化的数据采集协议，用于构建多模态数据集，包括：可穿戴生理信号、行为数据以及自我报告测量，并在实验中定义了不同水平的任务复杂度作为实验条件。

Result: 本文为实验设计方案，尚未在摘要中呈现具体的实验结果，主要贡献在于提出了数据采集协议和多模态数据集构建框架。

Conclusion: 通过将生理信号与行为及自我报告数据相结合的结构化数据采集协议，为HRI领域更全面地分析用户参与度提供了可行的实验设计基础。

Abstract: This paper presents an experimental design for constructing a multimodal dataset to analyze user engagement in human-robot interaction (HRI). Prior studies have mainly relied on observable behavioral cues, with limited frameworks integrating physiological signals. We therefore propose a structured data-collection protocol to build a multimodal dataset that includes wearable physiological signals, behavioral data, and self-report measures under different levels of task complexity defined in this experiment.

</details>


### [270] [R2S-Eval: Robot Evaluation with Real-to-Sim Calibration via Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03276)
*Yidi Wang,Feixiang Ruan,Ruoqu Chen,Jie Yin,Yang Yu,Mengdi Xu,Kaifeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出R2S-Eval评估管道，结合真实到仿真（real-to-sim）标定与视觉语言模型（VLM）偏好评估，自动生成仿真rollout视频并由VLM对执行质量进行成对偏好比较，进而聚合出策略排名，实现对机器人操作策略的自动化、统计稳定且质量感知评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统真实世界机器人评估存在劳动密集、不稳定且信息量不足的问题：需要重复硬件试验、手动场景重置和持续人工监控；重复评估可能导致策略排名不一致；且主要依赖成功率指标，无法充分反映执行质量。而人类是通过观察和比较完整行为来评估机器人性能，而非仅仅依赖二元的成功结果。

Method: 提出R2S-Eval评估管道，由两部分组成：(1) real-to-sim标定组件，在标定到真实世界评估环境的仿真器中高效生成rollout视频，减少重复硬件试验需求；(2) VLM评估器，对rollout视频的执行质量进行成对偏好评估，并将偏好结果聚合成策略排名。文中还引入了用于验证该评估管道能否产生可靠策略结论的评估协议。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界实验均表明：R2S-Eval能产生可靠稳定的策略结论，与人类偏好达成一致，大幅减少重复硬件操作开销，并能揭示二元成功标签无法捕捉的行为质量差异。

Conclusion: R2S-Eval将机器人评估从手动成功计数推进到自动化、统计稳定且质量感知的行为评估范式。

Abstract: Evaluating robot manipulation policies is becoming increasingly important as generalist models, particularly vision-language-action (VLA) models, are deployed on physical robots. However, conventional real-world evaluation remains labor-intensive, unstable, and insufficiently informative. It requires repeated hardware trials, manual scene resets, and continuous operator monitoring, may produce different policy rankings across repeated evaluations, and primarily relies on success-rate metrics that provide limited information about execution quality. In contrast, humans assess robot performance by observing and comparing complete behaviors rather than relying solely on binary success outcomes. To this end, we propose R2S-Eval, an evaluation pipeline that combines real-to-sim calibration with vision-language model (VLM) preference evaluation. The real-to-sim component efficiently generates rollout videos in a simulator calibrated to the real-world evaluation setting, thereby reducing the need for repeated hardware trials. The VLM evaluator assesses the execution quality of rollout videos and produces pairwise preferences, which are subsequently aggregated into policy rankings. We further introduce a protocol to assess whether the proposed evaluation pipeline yields validated policy conclusions while mitigating the key challenges of conventional real-world evaluation. Experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that R2S-Eval produces reliable and stable policy conclusions, achieves agreement with human preferences, substantially reduces repeated hardware-operation effort, and reveals behavior-quality differences that are not captured by binary success labels. In general, R2S-Eval advances robot evaluation from manual success counting toward automated, statistically stable, and quality-aware evaluation of robot behavior. Project page: https://r2s-eval.github.io.

</details>


### [271] [ARTiS: An Adaptive Robotic Gripper for Enhanced Tool Manipulation in Disassembly Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03362)
*Roman Mykhailyshyn,Domae Yukiyasu,Harada Kensuke*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种名为ARTiS的新型自适应机械爪，专为拆装系统中的工具抓取与操作而设计，通过结合软体爪的柔顺性、拟人手的灵巧性和刚性机构的鲁棒性，实现了多种拆装工具的稳定握持与灵巧操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人和人类在使用工具（尤其是拆装过程中的工具）时，握持与操作存在巨大挑战。现有机器人抓取技术难以在操作过程中既保持对工具的可靠固定，又具备足够的适应性和灵巧性，存在显著局限。

Method: 提出的ARTiS抓爪采用独特组合设计：软体掌心配备主动堵塞（active jamming）机制以增强握持适应性，指尖采用鳍条（fin-ray）仿生结构，同时通过七自由度设计实现高手指灵巧性，使指尖能够面向任意表面，兼顾自动化与协作任务需求。

Result: 使用多种常规拆装工具进行了综合评估，验证了所设计抓爪在顺应性、耐用性和功能多样性方面的表现。实验结果表明该设计能在各种情形下牢固握持工具。

Conclusion: ARTiS通过融合软体抓取、拟人灵巧操作与刚性机构的优势，为拆装系统中的工具握持提供了一种兼具适应性、灵巧性和鲁棒性的有效解决方案。

Abstract: Grasping and holding tools while using them presents a considerable challenge not only for robots but also for humans. Such a challenge is particularly noticeable in processes involving assembly and disassembly, where efficiency and consistency depend on performing rapidly adaptive tasks. Nonetheless, contemporary robotic grasping technologies that can securely manipulate tools during operation frequently have significant constraints. In this paper, introduce ARTiS (Adaptive Robotic Tool Gripper in Disassembly Systems), a novel gripper that combines the adaptability of soft grippers, the dexterity of anthropomorphic hands, and the robustness of rigid mechanisms with a soft palm and fingertips. This unique combination makes it possible to hold tools securely in a variety of situations through using active jamming in the palm and fin-ray adaptation in fingertips. Furthermore, high finger dexterity is achieved through the seven degrees of freedom design, which enables the fingertips to orient to any surface, both for automated solutions and collaborative tasks. A comprehensive evaluation was conducted using a range of conventional disassembly tools to assess the gripper's compliance, durability, and functional versatility. More information, hardware instructions, and videos at https://romanmykhailyshyn.github.io/artis/

</details>


### [272] [Programming and execution of skill-based human-robot-crane collaborative tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03392)
*Taneli Lohi,Markku Suomalainen,Roope Mellanen,Tapio Heikkilä*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于CAD模型的编程与执行系统，用于参数化机器人技能和技能监视器。执行控制结构采用改进的行为树，仅使用事件驱动通信，实现动态参数化控制。通过人-机器人-天车协作的插入任务作为测试案例验证了系统性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变的生产制造场景对机器人制造和室内物流提出了敏捷性、灵活性和鲁棒性的新需求。传统固定流程难以适应生产集合的高度变化，需要一种能够灵活应对不同参数任务的执行机制。

Method: 提出基于CAD模型的编程与执行系统，将机器人技能（集成运动、工具操作与传感感知）参数化；执行控制采用改进的行为树结构，仅使用基于事件的通信方式，实现控制结构的动态化与参数化。

Result: 通过一个人类-机器人-起重机协作技能测试实例验证系统：人类操作员指示天车和机械臂，将天车支撑的重型物体在机械臂导引下插入目标位置。

Conclusion: 该系统展示了基于参数化技能与事件驱动行为树的有效人机协作执行方案，能够应对产出高度多变的生产环境，为柔性制造和物流场景提供了可行的技术途径。

Abstract: Highly varying production sets increasing challenges for robotic manufacturing and indoor logistics. New capabilities for agility, flexibility, and robustness are needed. Robot skills, integrating motions, tool operations, and sensor perceptions consistently provide an execution mechanism for a versatile set of tasks with varying parameters. In this paper, easy-to-use CAD-model based programming and execution system for parametrized skills and skill monitors is showcased. The execution control structure is dynamic and parametrized, based on a modified Behavior Tree, where only event based communication is used. A human-robot-crane collaborative skill is shown as a test example, where a human instructs an overhead crane and a manipulator in inserting a heavy object supported by the crane, and guided by the manipulator, into the goal.

</details>


### [273] [Air-Ground Collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation via Shared Bird's-Eye Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03483)
*Shuning Zhang,Liang Li,Yunheng Wang,Tao Wang,Yihang Kang,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AGC-VLN，首个用于空-地协同视觉语言导航（VLN）的免训练基线方法，通过将VLN分解为基于VLM的语义推理和确定性几何执行，利用无人机全局视角覆盖地面机器人位姿与目标标记形成共享鸟瞰图，配合3D-SPF空间搜索算法，在CARLA-Air的100个闭环场景中达到77.0%联合成功率，比最弱个体Agent提升27个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空地协同VLN场景（无人机提供鸟瞰全局视角，无人车提供第一视角）虽具有天然互补性，但现有免训练方法仅解决单Agent任务，缺乏协作机制；最近的CARLA-Air评测显示五种SOTA视觉语言动作模型均未表现出稳定的协作行为，且朴素的语义通信或双向耦合反而降低性能。因此需要一种有效的免训练协同导航基线。

Method: 核心洞察：免训练方法可将VLN分解为VLM驱动的语义推理与确定性的几何执行两部分，二者之间暴露出协作接口。具体地：无人机在全局鸟瞰视角上渲染无人车报告的位姿及VLM锚定的目标（以CAR/GOAL标记及距离标签呈现），构建共享鸟瞰地图；无人车据此获取其第一视角无法提供的全局空间上下文，利用冻结的VLM规划沿路行驶路径并在闭环控制下执行；与此同时，无人机运行3D-SPF（SPF的空间搜索升级版），在朝下视角中定位目标并飞向其所在区域。

Result: 在CARLA-Air Town10HD场景的100个闭环测试片段中，AGC-VLN联合成功率高达77.0%，相比较弱的单个Agent（无人机，50.0%）获得+27.0%的协作增益，并超过最强已发表单Agent基线（Travel UAV，53.0%）24个百分点，验证了无人机全局视野与无人车沿路执行之间的互补性。

Conclusion: 通过构建以VLM语义推理与几何执行为接口的空-地共享鸟瞰图，免训练方法也能实现有效且稳定的空地协同VLN，无人机全局感知与地面机器人路径执行的互补性是成功的关键所在。

Abstract: Air-ground collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) pairs an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with a global bird's-eye view and an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) with a local first-person view, yet the setting remains largely unexplored: existing training-free methods solve single-agent tasks but offer no collaboration mechanism, and a recent CARLA-Air evaluation found no stable cooperative behavior across five state-of-the-art VLA models; naive semantic communication or bidirectional coupling even degrades performance. We establish AGC-VLN (Air-Ground Collaborative VLN), the first training-free baseline for air-ground collaborative VLN. The key insight is that training-free methods decompose navigation into VLM-based semantic reasoning and deterministic geometric execution, exposing a collaboration interface: the UAV's global view, over which it renders the UGV's reported pose and the VLM-anchored target as CAR/GOAL markers with distance labels, yielding a shared bird's-eye map. From this map, the UGV acquires global spatial context its first-person view cannot provide, plans a road-following path with a frozen VLM, and executes it under closed-loop control; in parallel, the UAV runs 3D-SPF, a spatial-search upgrade of SPF that localizes the target in the downward view and flies toward it. On 100 closed-loop episodes in CARLA-Air's Town10HD scene, AGC-VLN reaches a 77.0% joint success rate, a collaboration gain of +27.0% over the weaker individual agent (the UAV, 50.0%), and exceeds the strongest published single-agent baseline (Travel UAV, 53.0%) by 24.0 points, stemming from the complementarity of the UAV's global view and the UGV's road-following execution. Project page: https://github.com/ZSN2024/AGC-VLN.

</details>


### [274] [BRIDGE: An Open-Source Humanoid Platform via Morphology-Control Co-Design for Physical AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03497)
*Jianren Wang,Letian Qian,Zikai Wang,Weiwei Wu,Junjie Zong,Abhinav Gupta,Deepak Pathak*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的形态-控制协同设计框架，用于优化类人机器人的形态以实现类人运动。通过一个新的指标联合考虑运动学重定向保真度和动态跟踪性能来量化形态保真度，并实现了SOTA性能。最终落地为开源88cm高的Bridge人形机器人平台及其控制策略，展示了在基础行走、平衡和高度动态动作上的优秀表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统人形机器人开发采用硬件设计与全身控制相分离的范式，导致系统次优，难以实现类人般的流畅性和敏捷性。作者认为利用人类行为数据来发展通用具身智能至关重要，需要弥合硬件形态设计与全身控制之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出一个数据驱动的形态-控制协同设计框架，将人类动作数据引入人形机器人形态优化过程。同时提出一个新的量化指标，联合考虑运动学重定向保真度（即形态对人类动作的复现能力）与动态跟踪性能，以指导形态优化。

Result: 相比基线人形机器人（Bumi、K1和Toddlerbot），该框架在所有指标上取得了SOTA性能。实际设计出的Bridge平台（88cm高，开源发布）能以更高保真度捕捉人类运动数据，在基础行走、鲁棒平衡以及高度动态的运动操作等任务中表现出色。

Conclusion: 形态与控制协同设计的思路可行且有效，能够显著提升机器人的类人运动质量，Bridge平台及开源材料为后续人形机器人的数据驱动设计和控制研究提供了有力基础。

Abstract: Developing humanoid robots capable of leveraging human behavioral data is essential for general-purpose embodiment, yet conventional development remains bottlenecked by a decoupled paradigm that isolates hardware design from whole-body control. This approach leads to suboptimal systems that compromise human-like fluidity and agility. To bridge this gap, we introduce a data-driven morphology-control co-design framework that optimizes humanoid morphology for human-like movement. To quantify morphological fidelity, we also introduce a novel metric that jointly considers kinematic retargeting fidelity to human motion and dynamic tracking performance. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across all metrics compared to baseline humanoids (Bumi, K1, and Toddlerbot). Finally, we realize this design in Bridge, an open-source, 88cm-tall humanoid platform released alongside its control policy. We demonstrate that Bridge captures human motion data with superior fidelity, exhibiting exceptional performance across foundational locomotion, robust balance, and highly dynamic maneuvers. Videos and open-source materials: https://sites.google.com/view/bridgerobot.

</details>


### [275] [TRaIL-Odom: Tightly Coupled Continuous Time Radar-IMU-LiDAR Odometry with Adaptive Doppler Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03561)
*Chiyun Noh,Turcan Tuna,William Talbot,Marco Hutter,Laurent Kneip,Ayoung Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种紧耦合的雷达-IMU-激光雷达里程计框架TRaIL-Odom，内含两个退化解感知的多普勒重加权模块（逐点雷达重加权与扫描级雷达增益调度），根据几何退化方向自适应分配雷达权重，在退化场景中显著优于固定权重基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有雷达-激光雷达融合方法使用固定的残差权重，但雷达多普勒信息和激光雷达几何信息的信息量随扫描和方向变化，导致均匀的雷达权重会在各平移方向上错误分配多普勒信息，尤其在几何退化场景中无法充分发挥雷达的补偿作用。

Method: 提出两个退化解感知的雷达多普勒重加权模块：(1) 逐点雷达重加权——基于激光雷达几何识别弱平移方向（几何退化是方向相关的），根据每个雷达多普勒约束与弱子空间的对齐程度重新分配权重；(2) 扫描级雷达增益调度——利用激光雷达几何各向异性调整整体雷达贡献，在激光雷达可观测性差时增强雷达、在约束可靠时抑制雷达。两者嵌入紧耦合的Radar-IMU-LiDAR里程计框架TRaIL-Odom中。

Result: 在13个评估序列上达到最先进的整体性能，在几何退化场景中优势明显。在3个退化序列的消融实验中，结合两个自适应加权模块相比固定权重基线，RMSE ATE和RTE分别降低了86.0%和78.5%。代码和配套数据集公开。

Conclusion: 方向自适应的雷达多普勒重加权能有效弥补固定权重融合策略在几何退化场景中的缺陷，通过利用退化几何的方向性信息，实现更合理的多传感器信息分配，显著提升退化环境中的定位精度。

Abstract: Existing radar-LiDAR fusion methods rely on fixed residual weights, even though the informativeness of radar Doppler and LiDAR geometry is scan- and direction-dependent, leading to uniform radar weighting that misallocates Doppler information across translational directions. To address this limitation, we propose two degeneracy-aware Doppler reweighting modules within a tightly coupled Radar-IMU-LiDAR odometry framework: per-point radar reweighting and scan-wise radar gain scheduling. Since geometric degeneracy is directional, we first identify weak translational directions from the LiDAR geometry and reweight individual radar Doppler constraints based on their alignment with the weak subspace. We further adjust the overall radar contribution using LiDAR geometric anisotropy such that radar is emphasized when LiDAR observability is poor and suppressed when LiDAR constraints are already reliable. Across 13 evaluated sequences, TRaIL-Odom achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, with clear advantages in geometrically degenerate scenes. In ablation experiments on three degenerate sequences, combining the two adaptive weighting modules reduces RMSE ATE and RTE by 86.0% and 78.5% relative to the fixed-weight baseline. We make our code and an accompanying dataset publicly available at https://github.com/ChiyunNoh/TRaIL-Odom.

</details>


### [276] [Toward Physically Grounded JEPA World Models for Goal-Conditioned Robotic Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03565)
*Muyuan Liu,Yue Huang,Zheng Liang,Xiang Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端的JEPA世界模型，通过结合逆动力学（IDM）与状态对齐（SA）增强潜在预测表征的机器人控制相关性，在多个基准任务上取得最优或相当的成功率，验证了状态对齐作为逆动力学补充的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于动作条件的JEPA世界模型虽然无需重建未来像素即可实现目标导向规划，但纯潜在预测并未显式鼓励所学表征保留对机器人控制有用的信息，导致潜在表征可能与实际物理状态和动作脱节。

Method: 提出端到端JEPA世界模型，在潜在预测基础上额外引入两类辅助监督：逆动力学（IDM）——通过从连续潜在状态推断产生它们之间转换的动作，抑制潜在表征崩溃并使潜在转换对动作信息保持敏感；状态对齐（SA）——将连续的表征与对应的物理构型与运动进行对齐，使表征具有物理含义。两者共同训练形成规划世界模型。

Result: 在四个基准任务中，模型在TwoRoom（100%）、PushT（98%）和OGBench-Cube（87%）上取得最高成功率，在Reacher上与LeWorldModel性能相当。消融实验表明，加入状态对齐在所有四个任务上均一致提升了IDM单独使用的规划成功率。虽然LeWorldModel在OGBench-Cube上平均直线化（straightening）指标更高，但转换子空间分析显示其转换能量集中在显著更低维的子空间中，而所提模型具有更高的有效转换维度。

Conclusion: 状态对齐能有效补充逆动力学，使潜在转换保留更多有效信息维度、提升规划表现，是面向机器人控制的JEPA世界模型的一种有效增强方式。

Abstract: Action-conditioned JEPA world models enable planning toward visually specified goals without reconstructing future pixels, yet latent prediction alone does not explicitly encourage the learned representations to retain information relevant to robotic control. We introduce an end-to-end JEPA world model that augments latent prediction with inverse dynamics (IDM) and state alignment (SA). While inverse dynamics discourages latent collapse and makes latent transitions informative of the actions that produced them, state alignment grounds consecutive representations in their associated physical configuration and motion. Across four benchmark tasks, our model attains the highest success rates on TwoRoom (100%), PushT (98%), and OGBench-Cube (87%), while performing comparably to LeWorldModel on Reacher. Our ablation further shows that adding state alignment consistently improves planning success over IDM alone across all four tasks. Although LeWorldModel, our primary baseline, attains higher average straightening on OGBench-Cube, transition-subspace analysis shows that its transition energy is concentrated in a substantially lower-dimensional subspace. Our state-aligned model exhibits a higher effective transition dimension than LeWorldModel and improves planning over IDM alone, supporting state alignment as an effective complement to inverse dynamics for robotic planning.

</details>


### [277] [Scaling Bimanual Household Manipulation from 1,500 hours of Demonstrations to On-Policy Corrections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03591)
*Jiafeng Xu,Qi Li,Yan Shen,Yiyu Ren,Travis Davies,Shaowen He,Ze Wang,Yifan Yang,Ran Cheng,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文发布了一个包含1,500小时双臂操作演示的数据集（涵盖日常家务任务），并基于该数据集训练了XR-2视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。通过高吞吐数据管道和多阶段训练范式，XR-2在系统实验中展现出较强的操作性能、训练效率和数据利用率。作者还研究了数据规模和DAgger纠正数据两个缩放轴，发现任务成功率均随数据量增加而稳定提升，呈现一致的数据缩放趋势。数据集已开源以支持双臂机器人操作学习的可复现研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习通用双臂操作策略的瓶颈在于高质量大规模人类演示数据的稀缺性。现有公开数据集的规模和质量不足以支撑强大VLA模型的训练。

Method: 构建1,500小时多样化的双臂操作演示数据集（覆盖日常家务），设计高吞吐量数据采集管道，采用精心设计的多阶段训练范式训练XR-2 VLA模型，并研究两条缩放轴：专家演示数据量和基于DAgger纠正数据的后训练。

Result: XR-2在系统实验中取得强的操作性能，同时保持有利的训练效率和高数据利用率。在两条数据缩放轴上，任务成功率均随数据量增加而持续改善，展现出当前数据尺度下清晰一致的数据缩放趋势。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了XR-2的学习能力以及所发布数据集具有有前景的缩放特性，数据集已开源供社区研究。

Abstract: Learning generalist policies for robust bimanual manipulation is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high quality large scale human demonstration data. In this work, we release 1,500 hours of diverse bimanual manipulation demonstrations covering everyday household tasks, and use this comprehensive corpus to train XR-2, a powerful vision-language-action (VLA) model. Enabled by a purpose built high throughput data pipeline and a carefully designed multi stage training paradigm, XR-2 attains strong manipulation performance in our systematic experiments while retaining favorable training efficiency and high data utilization. We further study two critical scaling axes: varying the amount of expert demonstration data, and post training on DAgger correction data from real time human interventions. In both settings, task success rate improves steadily over the data ranges we probe, exhibiting a clear consistent scaling trend at our current data scale. These results validate both the learning capacity of XR-2 and the promising scaling properties of the released dataset, which we open source to support reproducible research on bimanual robot manipulation learning.

</details>


### [278] [FailBench: How Reliable are VLMs at Judging Robot Task Success?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03611)
*Zaruhi Navasardyan,Tatul Danielyan,Hrant Davtyan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了FailBench，一个跨领域的机器人故障检测基准，包含来自14个公开数据源的2,197个操作尝试。评估13个VLM检测器后发现，最佳模型仅达到0.77平均平衡准确率；针对故障检测微调的模型反而比通用VLM和预训练基线表现更差；任务性能高度依赖所需视觉证据类型，接触密集型装配任务中性能降至接近随机水平；模型存在在模糊证据下偏向预测成功的系统性偏差；通过输入级别的空间裁剪干预可在无需额外训练的情况下将最佳检测器提升2.4个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLMs虽然越来越多地被用于评估机器人操作结果，但已有基准缺乏对跨领域泛化能力的充分证据。为了可靠地评估VLM在机器人故障检测中的真实能力，需要一个包含多样化真实世界和模拟来源的、涵盖自然发生故障的综合性基准。

Method: 构建了FailBench基准，包含2,197次操作尝试，覆盖14个公开来源（12个真实世界+2个模拟），其中75%的故障是自然发生的，6个真实世界来源来自非故障检测数据集。评估了13种基于VLM的检测器，并进行了错误分析和输入级干预（空间定位和裁剪结果相关区域）实验。

Result: 最佳模型平均平衡准确率仅0.77；针对故障检测微调的模型持续劣于通用VLM及其自身预训练基线；模型在依赖可观察物体运动的结果上接近饱和性能，但在接触密集型装配任务上性能降至随机水平以下（<0.60）；错误分析显示模型存在系统性偏向预测成功的偏差；输入级空间裁剪干预将最佳检测器提升2.4个百分点。

Conclusion: VLM在机器人故障检测上存在明显的领域泛化瓶颈：专门微调的模型与通用模型相比没有优势，模型在需要接触级推理的任务上严重退化，且存在利好偏向。但通过简单的输入级干预（裁剪结果相关区域）可以无训练地提升性能，提示未来的改进方向在于更好地利用空间信息而非仅增加推理努力。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate robot manipulation outcomes, but existing benchmarks offer limited evidence of cross-domain generalization. We introduce FailBench, a benchmark for robot failure detection comprising 2,197 manipulation attempts across 14 public sources (12 real-world, 2 simulated). In FailBench, 75% of failures occur naturally, and six real-world sources come from non-failure-detection datasets. Evaluating 13 VLM-based detectors, we find the best model achieves only 0.77 mean balanced accuracy. Notably, models fine-tuned for failure detection consistently underperform general-purpose VLMs and their own pretrained baselines. Performance depends heavily on required visual evidence: models approach saturation when outcomes depend on observable object motion, but degrade to near-chance (<0.60 balanced accuracy) on contact-intensive assembly tasks. Error analysis reveals a systematic bias toward predicting success under ambiguous evidence, which persists even with increased reasoning effort. Finally, we show that input-level intervention--spatially localizing and cropping outcome-relevant regions--improves the top detector by 2.4 percentage points without extra training.

</details>


### [279] [QLAUN: A Research-Oriented, Robust, Agile, Modular, and Affordable Torque-Controlled Quadruped Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03623)
*Mohamad S. Moudallal,Noel J. Maalouf*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一套名为QLAUN的扭矩控制四足机器人平台，该机器人以研究为导向、成本效益高，旨在同时实现鲁棒性和敏捷性。整个机器人几乎完全采用3D打印技术制造（主体为PLA，脚部为TPU-95A），搭载12个自由度（每条腿3个），配备全3D打印的准直驱（QDD）执行器（无刷直流电机+低减速比齿轮箱+皮带传动），采用无电子元件的模块化腿部设计并提供解耦的髋关节和膝关节执行器，旨在赋能黎巴嫩及MENA地区高校的机器人研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在为黎巴嫩和中东北非地区（MENA）的大学和科研机构提供一个经济实惠、研究导向的四足机器人平台，以推动足式机器人运动研究的普及和发展，同时实现鲁棒性与敏捷性的兼顾。

Method: 设计了一种创新的无电子元件（electronics-free）腿部结构，采用模块化、可互换且易于更换的腿部。每条腿配备3个自由度（共12 DoF），髋膝关节执行器解耦以提升模块化程度。每个关节搭配完全3D打印的准直驱（QDD）执行器，由无刷直流电机、低减速比齿轮箱和皮带传动系统组成以显著提升关节扭矩输出。机器人主体采用PLA材料3D打印，脚部采用TPU-95A柔性材料打印以缓解冲击并应对地形不确定性。腿部关节拥有大范围运动能力，包含连续的髋关节屈伸关节。

Result: 成功构建了QLAUN机器人平台：重约15 kg，具有12个自由度，几乎完全使用3D打印技术制造并采用市售零部件组装，形成一款低成本、鲁棒且敏捷的足式机器人研究平台。

Conclusion: QLAUN作为一款全新的足式机器人研究平台，通过其在制造、设计原则和成本控制方面的创新（全3D打印QDD执行器、模块化腿部、低减速比传动），为机器人学科研界提供了面向鲁棒性和敏捷性研究的可行且可负担的实验载体。

Abstract: QLAUN Bot (Quad-Legged Adaptive Unmanned Navigator Robot) is a torque-controlled quadruped robot that is research-oriented, cost-effective, and aimed at achieving simultaneous robustness and agility while being completely 3D-printed. It is a quadruped robot that is aimed at empowering robotics research at universities and research institutes in Lebanon and the MENA region. Using a novel electronics-free leg design strategy, we present a modular robot with interchangeable and easily replaceable legs. The 15 kg robot possesses 12 DoF (Degrees-of-Freedom) with three per leg, each paired with a completely 3D-printed Quasi-Direct Drive (QDD) actuator that consists of a brushless DC motor and a low-ratio gearbox transmission that is connected to a belt transmission system for significantly increasing the torque outputs at the joints. We present legs that have decoupled hip and knee actuators to improve the overall modularity of the robot.
