QLAUN is almost completely 3D-printed using polylactic acid (PLA) and assembled using off-the-shelf parts to create a robust, agile, and affordable robot for legged robot locomotion research. The legs possess joints with wide ranges of motion, including a continuous hip flexion-extension joint. A compliant foot, printed using TPU-95A is also implemented for alleviating hard impacts and handling terrain uncertainties. This extended abstract aims to introduce QLAUN, a novel platform for robotics research, emphasizing the design concepts and principles that underpin its development to the academic and research communities in the field of robotics.

</details>


### [280] [Local Path Planning and Obstacle Avoidance for an Omnicopter Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03630)
*Mikolaj Helinski,Spilios Theodoulis,Mahmoud Hamandi,Abdullah Mohamed Ali,Anthony Tzes,Marija Popovic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对全向多旋翼（omnicopter）的实时局部规划与避障模块，将动态窗口法（DWA）扩展至六自由度（6D-DWA），通过局部地图体素化、球体近似飞行器几何和自适应速度采样实现实时性，并引入"Agile Mode"上下文感知的在线评分权重调整以提升对未知障碍的响应能力。实验验证了其在0.2秒控制循环内运行、密集航点跟踪及静态/未知障碍场景下的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主无人机在杂乱稠密环境中运行时，RRT*等全局规划器无法在控制频率下直接部署，亟需一种能在实时速率下工作的局部规划与避障方案，特别是针对具有六自由度运动能力的全向多旋翼平台。

Method: 方法包含三个关键技术：(i) 局部地图体素化以实现实时可行性；(ii) 基于球体的紧凑几何近似表征飞行器外形；(iii) 在六维搜索空间中进行自适应速度采样。此外提出"Agile Mode"，根据上下文在线调整评分权重，在目标进展、间隙余量与航向/朝向约束之间动态平衡，以增强对未知障碍的规避能力。

Result: 在仿真中，规划器在0.2秒控制循环内稳定运行；在稠密航点全局路径跟踪中平均横向误差小于0.1米，平均航向误差13度；在静态环境下可成功避碰。未知障碍规避方面，Agile Mode对偏心障碍物成功率达79.3%，对中心障碍物成功率为41.4%，既展示了自适应权重调整的有效性，也暴露了在高度受限几何场景下的局限性。

Conclusion: 6D-DWA结合Agile Mode为全向多旋翼提供了一种实时的局部规划新方法，在常规场景下具有良好性能表现，但在高度约束的几何构型中仍存在鲁棒性不足的问题，需在后续工作中进一步改进。

Abstract: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) increasingly operate in cluttered environments where global planners such as RRT* are not directly deployable at control rates. This paper presents a real-time local planning and obstacle avoidance module for an omnidirectional multirotor (omnicopter) by extending the Dynamic Window Approach to six degrees of freedom (6D-DWA). Our method achieves real-time feasibility through (i) local-map voxelisation, (ii) a compact sphere-based approximation of the vehicle geometry, and (iii) adaptive velocity sampling in the 6D search space. To improve reactivity to unknown obstacles, we introduce a context-aware "Agile Mode" that adjusts scoring weights online to trade-off between goal progress, clearance, and heading/facing constraints during evasive manoeuvres. We evaluate our approach in simulation across computational stress tests, dense-waypoint path tracking, and static/unknown obstacle scenarios. Our planner runs consistently within a 0.2s control loop, tracks waypoint-dense global paths with < 0.1m average cross-track error and 13deg average heading error, and avoids collisions in static environments. For unknown obstacle avoidance, Agile Mode achieves 79.3% success for an off-centre obstacle and 41.4% for a centred obstacle, highlighting both the effectiveness of adaptive weighting and remaining limitations in highly constrained geometries.

</details>


### [281] [WISE: World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03681)
*Chenhao Zhang,Hanyu Zhao,Hang Cheng,Tengfei Pan,Long Zeng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WISE是一个用于视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型世界模型后训练的统一框架，通过智能调度想象力的使用时机和方式，在交互相关状态选择性调用有界的多视角rollout，利用进度和完成信号评估候选未来，实现高效策略精化，减少约80%的GPU计算量并提升跨多种操作任务的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略的后训练通常依赖昂贵的专家示范进行监督微调，或需要昂贵的、可能不稳定的真实世界探索进行强化学习。世界模型虽然提供了一种通过想象未来评估候选行为的替代方案，但有效的后训练不仅需要准确的预测，还需要合理的想象力调度、可靠的时间范围约束，以及将想象力转化为可信的策略监督信号。在机器人操作中，想象力的价值在不同执行阶段差异显著，而延长的rollout会累积预测误差并引入不可靠的学习信号。

Method: WISE框架通过以下机制协调世界模型想象力在后训练中的使用：(1)在交互相关状态选择性调用想象力；(2)执行有界的多视角rollout；(3)使用进度和完成信号评估候选未来；(4)利用相对结果精化从真实交互上下文产生的动作。该框架在π0和π0.5两个VLA模型上进行验证。

Result: 在多种操作任务上，WISE在π0和π0.5上都一致性地提升了性能，同时相比完整想象力方法减少了约80%的GPU计算时间。真实世界评估进一步表明，在多种真实世界分布偏移下，该方法在鲁棒性和泛化性方面取得了显著提升。

Conclusion: WISE证明了"何时以及如何使用世界模型想象力"这一调度策略对VLA策略后训练效率至关重要，通过选择性地在有界范围内使用想象力并辅以可靠的评估信号，可以在大幅降低计算成本的同时实现更好的策略性能、鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Post-training VLA policies typically rely on supervised fine-tuning with costly expert demonstrations or reinforcement learning with expensive and potentially unstable real-world exploration. World models offer a promising alternative by evaluating candidate behaviors through imagined futures, yet effective post-training requires more than accurate prediction: imagination must be scheduled where it is useful, bounded within reliable horizons, and translated into trustworthy policy supervision. In robotic manipulation, the value of imagination varies substantially across execution stages, while extended rollouts can accumulate prediction errors and introduce unreliable learning signals. We introduce WISE (World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models), a unified framework that coordinates when and how world-model imagination is used during policy refinement. WISE selectively invokes imagination at interaction-relevant states, performs bounded multi-view rollouts, evaluates candidate futures using progress and completion signals, and uses their relative outcomes to refine actions generated from real interaction contexts. Extensive experiments with both $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse manipulation tasks while reducing GPU computation time by approximately 80% compared with full imagination. Real-world evaluations further show substantial gains in robustness and generalization under diverse real-world distribution shifts.

</details>


### [282] [Predictive Zonotope Reduction: Precise Runtime Monitoring under Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03699)
*Vladimir Krsmanovic,Florian Kohn,Bernd Finkbeiner,Milan Simovic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出预测性Zonotope缩减（PZR）方法，将缩减器选择建模为最优控制问题，通过束搜索模型预测控制求解，并利用策略蒸馏生成小型神经策略以提高推理速度，从而在资源受限的实时系统上实现不确定性感知的运行时监控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在物理环境中基于不确定的传感器测量做控制决策，可能导致不安全或次优行为。运行时监控器需要以可靠方式表示这种不确定性。Zonotope是常用表示方法，但持续融入新测量会使阶数无界增长，需周期性地应用过近似缩减。缩减方法的选择显著影响精度，然而现有方法通常全程使用固定方法，尽管最优选择取决于当前状态。

Method: 将缩减器选择形式化为最优控制问题，采用束搜索模型预测控制求解；随后通过策略蒸馏将MPC策略蒸馏成小型神经策略，兼顾执行速度与性能提升，使不确定性感知的运行时监控能在资源受限的实时系统上运行。实现于RLola运行时监控框架中。

Result: 在MuJoCo模拟的5自由度机械臂上进行评估，传感器不确定性按ISO 5725建模。在Raspberry Pi 5上的实验表明，动态缩减相比静态缩减策略显著降低了监控中的假阳性率。

Conclusion: 动态选择Zonotope缩减方法相比静态策略能显著提升运行时监控的精度，且通过策略蒸馏可以兼顾实时性要求，适用于资源受限的嵌入式系统。

Abstract: Robots operating in physical environments make control decisions based on uncertain sensor measurements, which can lead to unsafe or suboptimal actions. Runtime monitors that check their behavior against safety specifications must represent this uncertainty soundly. Zonotopes are a widely used representation, but continuously incorporating new measurements grows their order unboundedly, so monitors must periodically apply an over-approximating reduction. The choice of the reduction method substantially affects the zonotope's precision, yet existing approaches typically utilize a fixed method throughout the run, even though the optimal choice depends on the current state. This paper presents a Predictive Zonotope Reduction (PZR) approach, which frames reducer selection as an optimal control problem and solves it using beam-search model predictive control. Policy distillation into a small neural policy further provides substantially higher execution speed than model predictive control while maintaining improved performance, enabling uncertainty-aware runtime monitoring on resource-constrained real-time systems. We implement our approach in the RLola runtime monitoring framework and evaluate it on a 5-degree-of-freedom robotic arm simulated in MuJoCo, with sensor uncertainty modeled according to ISO 5725. Experiments on a Raspberry Pi 5 show that dynamic reduction significantly lowers false-positive rates in monitoring compared with static reduction strategies.

</details>


### [283] [Toward an~Integrated Cognitive--Ergonomic Architecture for~Human--Machine Interaction: Combining Cognitive Models with~Human Factors Ergonomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03704)
*Antoine Lenat,Olivier Cheminat,Damien Chablat,Camilo Charron*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文综合认知架构（SOAR、ACT-R、LIDA、COCOM）与人为因素工效学（HFE）理论，提出一种面向动态人机交互（HMI）环境的集成化人类能力建模架构，并在工业机器人应用中进行了实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知理论与系统设计之间存在鸿沟，现有人机交互系统缺乏理论支撑的、可扩展的人类能力建模方法，尤其是在动态工业环境中，需要一种整合认知架构与工效学原理的框架来弥合理论与实践差距。

Method: 通过对SOAR、ACT-R、LIDA和COCOM四种成熟认知模型进行对比分析，综合其优势，设计出一种定制化架构。该架构被置于工效学框架中进行情境化，以阐明决策、技能习得和适应性行为背后的机制，并在工业机器人应用中通过操作员专业知识、规范性知识和实时反馈回路进行实证检验。

Result: 所提出的架构增强了人机交互系统的认知对齐，并提供了一种可扩展的方法论，用于在高风险环境中设计智能化、以人为本的交互界面。

Conclusion: 该工作同时推进了人类能力的理论理解与自适应、工效学优化系统的实际实现，填补了认知理论向应用系统设计转化的关键空白。

Abstract: This paper presents an integrated approach to modeling human competencies by combining the theoretical foundations of cognitive architectures with principles from Human Factors Ergonomics (HFE). Through a comparative analysis of established cognitive models-SOAR, ACT-R, LIDA, and COCOM-we synthesize a tailored architecture designed to address the complexities of human-machine interaction (HMI) in dynamic environments. By contextualizing this model within ergonomic frameworks, we elucidate the mechanisms underlying decision-making, skill acquisition, and adaptive behavior, bridging the gap between cognitive theory and applied system design. Our framework is empirically grounded in industrial robotics applications, where operator expertise, normative knowledge, and real-time feedback loops are critical. The proposed architecture not only enhances the cognitive alignment of HMI systems but also provides a scalable methodology for designing intelligent, human-centered interfaces in high-stakes environments. This work advances both the theoretical understanding of human competencies and the practical implementation of adaptive, ergonomically optimized systems.

</details>


### [284] [MINERVA: How Small Can a Manipulation Policy Be and Still Solve LIBERO?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03715)
*Kohei Sendai,Tatsuya Matsushima,Yusuke Iwasawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MINERVA，一组超紧凑的视觉-动作策略模型，用于测量LIBERO操作基准的任务特定容量下限。仅0.54M参数的策略在LIBERO四个套件上达到95.1%的平均成功率，比LeRobot π_0.5仅低2.4个点但参数少7700×，且无需GPU推理速度更快，首次实证估计了LIBERO的容量下限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前拥有数十亿参数的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在LIBERO基准上占据主导地位，但该基准实际所需的模型容量并不明确。作者旨在回答"基准到底需要多大能力"这一问题，以推动容量感知设计和高效部署的机器人策略。

Method: 设计了一组刻意保持紧凑的视觉运动策略MINERVA（最小仅0.54M参数），系统性地进行架构、训练和推理的广泛扫描，包括动作块长度（action-chunk）、视觉容量、流匹配（flow matching）与直接L1回归对比等实验；并通过任务ID置换探针（permutation probe）分析LIBERO指令条件化的机制；同时在LIBERO-90和LIBERO-Plus扰动集上评估泛化能力。

Result: 0.54M参数策略在2000次rollout上达到95.1%平均成功率；性能在约1M参数处饱和，低于0.25M时崩溃；仅动作块长度和视觉容量能稳定超出±1点训练种子带；流匹配相对L1回归无优势且回归GPU推理快3.8×；任务ID置换使成功率跌至接近随机，表明标准LIBERO指令条件化主要在选择记忆任务；同一配方在LIBERO-90上达94.6%，但在LIBERO-Plus扰动下降至46-56%，对光度变化鲁棒性接近零；单块CPU上推理比SmolVLA快113×、比π_0.5快1400×。

Conclusion: 研究首次建立了LIBERO基准的任务特定容量下限（约1M参数饱和、0.25M以下崩溃），显示该基准在标准设置下主要衡量任务记忆与检索能力而非真正的开放泛化，且对扰动鲁棒性极弱。这为容量感知的模型设计和蒸馏提供了实证基础，推动部署高效机器人策略的发展。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models with billions of parameters now dominate the LIBERO manipulation benchmark, but the model capacity actually required by the benchmark remains unclear. We introduce MINERVA (MINimal Efficient Robotic Vision-Action policy), a family of deliberately compact visuomotor policies designed to measure this task-specific capacity floor. A 0.54M-parameter policy achieves 95.1% average success over 2,000 rollouts on the four standard LIBERO suites, only 2.4 points below the reported LeRobot $π_{0.5}$ result despite using 7,700$\times$ fewer parameters. Performance saturates near 1M parameters and collapses below 0.25M. Across broad architectural, training, and inference sweeps, only action-chunk length and vision capacity consistently exceed a $\pm$1-point training-seed band. Flow matching provides no detectable advantage over direct L1 regression across three seeds, while regression is up to 3.8$\times$ faster on GPU. A task-ID permutation probe shows that standard LIBERO instruction conditioning primarily selects among memorized tasks: changing only the task-ID mapping reduces success to near chance. The same recipe achieves 94.6% success across 89 LIBERO-90 tasks, while LIBERO-Plus perturbations reduce performance to 46--56%, with near-zero robustness to photometric shifts. The 0.54M policy replans every control step in 5--9 ms per chunk on a laptop CPU, 113$\times$ faster than SmolVLA and 1,400$\times$ faster than $π_{0.5}$, without a GPU. These results establish a first empirical estimate of LIBERO's task-specific capacity floor and motivate capacity-aware design and distillation for deployment-efficient robot policies.

</details>


### [285] [RoughSense: Lightweight Terrain-Induced Rover Vibration Prediction Using Point Clouds and IMU Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03720)
*Gabriel Manuel Garcia,Stephanie Aravecchia,Miguel Angel Olivares-Mendez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种轻量级的实时振动感知可通行性建图方法，结合LiDAR点云与IMU测量，利用RANSAC从SLAM生成的点云局部块估算初始振动代理，并通过递推最小二乘在线校正几何估计与实测振动响应之间的差异，在多类地形环境中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间自主导航（尤其地下环境）面临通信受限、计算资源和功耗有限的挑战，需要可靠的实时地形评估以确保安全操作。现有地形评估方法难以在资源受限条件下兼顾准确性和轻量化。

Method: 采用RANSAC对SLAM产生的局部点云块进行几何拟合以估计初始振动代理；同时在并行分支利用IMU测量直接观测漫游车行驶过程中的实际振动；最后通过递推最小二乘（RLS）在线校正点云几何预测与实测振动响应之间的偏差，实现自适应更新。

Result: 该方法在月球模拟环境、户外场地以及地下矿井三种不同地形场景中进行了评估，结果表明该系统能够在线适应几何估计与实际漫游车响应的差异，实现轻量化的实时振动感知可通行性建图。

Conclusion: 基于LiDAR与IMU融合的振动感知建图方法能够在地形几何信息与实际车辆动态响应之间建立自适应映射关系，为地下等受限环境中的自主导航提供了一种计算高效的通行性评估手段。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in space requires reliable terrain assessment for safe operations, especially in underground environments with limited communication, computing resources, and power budget. This paper presents a lightweight method for real-time vibration-aware traversability mapping using a Light Detecting And Ranging (LiDAR) point cloud and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) measurements. An initial vibration proxy is estimated from terrain geometry by applying Random sample consensus (RANSAC) to local point-cloud patches produced by a Simultaneous Localisation And Mapping (SLAM) algorithm. In parallel, the IMU provides local observations of the vibration experienced by the rover during traversal. The point-cloud-based prediction is then corrected online using Recursive Least Squares, allowing the system to adapt the geometric estimate to the measured rover response. The approach is evaluated in a lunar analogue environment, an outdoor field, and an underground mine.

</details>


### [286] [A Multi-Vine Soft Robot Enabling Accessible Working Channel and Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03758)
*Reza Kashef,Cem Suulker,Mohammad Sheikh Sofla,Kaspar Althoefer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多藤蔓（multi-vine）架构，通过两个软体翻转机器人（vine robots）耦合一个外部集成的工作通道（working channel），实现生长过程中近90°的主动锐利转向，克服了传统嵌入式工作通道对工具尺寸的限制和摩擦问题，为微创医疗及非医疗应用提供了新的可能性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体翻转机器人（vine robots）因其低摩擦生长和被动顺应能力适合复杂环境（如人体结肠）中的导航与检查，但尖锐方向变化（如乙状结肠）限制了被动生长，需主动转向。同时，现有集成工作通道的方法受限于工具尺寸、引入摩擦，且仅能通过机器人尖端访问环境，亟需一种既能主动转向又能灵活输送工具的架构。

Method: 提出多藤蔓架构：将两个vine机器人通过软性安装尖端（soft mounting tips）耦合到一个外部集成的工作通道上。两个vine机器人可独立驱动，使工作通道在推进过程中实现主动尖端转向，而无需将通道嵌入藤蔓本体内部。

Result: 实验证明该架构在生长过程中可实现近90°的锐利转向，展示了该架构在医疗和非医疗应用中的潜力。

Conclusion: 多藤蔓耦合外部工作通道的架构能有效兼顾主动转向与工具输送功能，是对现有vine机器人工作通道集成方案的有力补充，具有广泛的应用前景。

Abstract: Soft eversion robots, also known as vine robots, have attracted growing interest for navigation and inspection tasks, including minimally invasive medical applications [1]. A vine robot consists of a thin, flexible, inextensible tube folded inward that everts and grows forward when pressurized. This tip-growth enables navigation with minimal friction, making vine robots well suited for complex environments such as the human colon [2]. While their inherent softness allows passive conforma- tion to curved pathways in confined spaces, navigation performance strongly depends on environmental inter- actions, including contact angle and the length of un- constrained deployed material [3], [4]. Sharp directional changes, such as those in the sigmoid colon, often limit passive growth and necessitate active steering. Existing solutions include distributed artificial muscles [5] or dedicated tip-based steering mechanisms [6]. In addition, many applications require payload delivery, such as sensors and tools [7], [8]. Within the ERC Synergy project EndoTheranostics, this motivates the development of vine robots capable of delivering micro- surgical tools during growth. Prior work has integrated working channels within the vine body [8], [9], but these approaches constrain tool size, introduce friction, and limit access to the environment to the robot tip. In this work, we propose a multi-vine architecture in which two vine robots are coupled to an externally integrated working channel via soft mounting tips [10]. Independent vine actuation enables active tip steering while advancing the working channel without embed- ding it within the vine bodies Figure 1. Experiments demonstrate sharp steering of nearly 90 degrees during growth, highlighting the potential of this architecture for versatile medical and non-medical applications.

</details>


### [287] [Virtual Testing of Automated Driving Systems through Credible Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03760)
*Riccardo Dona,Espedito Rusciano,Biagio Ciuffo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于风险的可信度评估框架，用于评估自动驾驶系统（ADS）安全评估中仿真工具链的可信度。该框架借鉴NASA STD-7009等安全关键领域的成熟实践，将传统V&V扩展为与仿真输出预期用途和安全决策关键性显式关联的生命周期导向评估方案，涵盖工具链管理、建模假设与局限、验证、确认和敏感性分析，并按用途分层设定可信度阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ADS行为复杂、运行设计域庞大，物理测试不切实际，虚拟测试在审批阶段被广泛使用。但当前ADS领域的虚拟测试认证方法仅依赖验证实践，在复杂多工具仿真环境中扩展性差，难以支撑道路安全决策所需的仿真结果可信度评估。

Method: 借鉴NASA STD-7009等安全关键领域的成熟实践，构建基于风险的仿真工具链可信度评估框架。框架将可信度要求与仿真输出的预期用途及所支持决策的安全关键性显式关联，提供生命周期导向的评估方案，整合工具链管理、建模假设与局限、验证、确认及敏感性分析。可信度验收阈值按比例定义，根据仿真用途（探索性安全分析、部分决策支持或替代物理测试）采取差异化要求。

Result: 该框架在ADS领域得到验证，定义了分层级的可信度验收阈值，能够根据仿真在审批流程中所支持决策的安全关键性差异化设置准则要求。框架具有直接可推广性，适用于虚拟测试在安全评估和监管决策中起核心作用的道路安全及仿真研究。

Conclusion: 提出的基于风险的可信度评估框架克服了当前ADS领域纯验证方法扩展性差的局限，通过在审批过程中将可信度要求与预期用途和安全关键性关联，为安全关键领域复杂多工具仿真环境提供了更稳健的可信度评估方案，并可推广至更广泛的道路安全研究。

Abstract: Simulation is increasingly used to support safety-related decision-making in road transport, particularly for the assessment and approval of automated driving systems (ADS). The complexity of ADS behavior and size of their operational design domains make exclusive reliance on physical testing impractical, leading to extensive use of virtual testing (VT) during the approval phase. This shift raises critical questions regarding the credibility of modelling and simulation (M&S) results used to support road safety decisions. Current VT accreditation approaches in the ADS domain typically rely on validation-only practices, which have been shown to scale poorly when applied to complex, multi-tool simulation environments. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a risk-based framework for assessing the credibility of simulation toolchains used in ADS safety evaluation, drawing inspiration from established practices in other safety-critical domains, notably NASA's STD-7009 for models and simulations. The framework extends traditional verification and validation (V&V) by explicitly linking credibility requirements to the intended use of simulation outputs and to the safety criticality of the decisions they support within the approval process. It provides a lifecycle-oriented assessment scheme integrating toolchain management, modelling assumptions and limitations, verification, validation, and sensitivity analysis. Credibility acceptance thresholds are defined proportionally, allowing differentiated requirements depending on whether simulation is used for exploratory safety analysis, partial decision support, or as a substitute for physical testing. While demonstrated for ADS, the proposed approach is directly applicable to road safety and simulation studies where VT plays a central role in safety assessment and regulatory decision-making.

</details>


### [288] [Robot Aware Computational Design of Object Specific Passive Grippers for Additive Manufacturing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03761)
*Abdullah Yahya Abdullah Omaisan,Ibrahim Sheikh Mohamed*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一套端到端计算流水线，将目标网格、物体位姿和六轴机器人转化为一种目标专属、非驱动的增材制造夹爪，并对配准、接触、力学、拓扑优化等环节建立可追溯的设计标识，通过数字仿真门禁验证于四个物体案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作将抓取选择、工具几何、运动规划和结构设计视为相互独立的问题，缺乏将目标网格、物体位姿、机器人法兰、接触集和插入假设统一绑定的端到端可追溯设计流程。需要一种能同时求解接触、夹持机构、机器人可达性和结构强度的自动化方法，以输出可直接3D打印的目标专属被动夹爪。

Method: 流水线依次包含精确网格RGB-D/ICP位姿配准、确定性表面接触采样、考虑不确定性的力螺旋筛选、六种被动捕获机构选择、对象共形表面合成、全姿态机器人逆运动学、扫掠体积感知制造域、定向熔融沉积有限元筛选以及约束三维SIMP拓扑优化。每项导出设计绑定源网格、物体位姿、机器人法兰、接触集和插入假设并分配可追溯设计标识。论文还推导了各环节方程并证明了三个数值性质：节点载荷保持、SIMP插值下的单调柔度灵敏度及拓扑后处理的体素域包含性。

Result: 四个存档物体（兔子、相机法兰、3DBenchy、多面胸像）均通过标称贴合、不确定力螺旋、运行时间扫掠和基准/后拓扑有限元门禁。在人为放大的+/-3mm、+/-5度位姿压力测试中，160次模拟试验中保留了29至134次，区分了各设计鲁棒性。重建拓扑保留了92.0%-97.6%的有限元域，因功能区受保护。机器人照片展示了打印装配件，但由于仅有标称材料属性且缺乏校准的仪器化试验，四个设计处于数字筛选状态而非发布状态。

Conclusion: 该流水线在数字层面展示了从网格/位姿/机器人到可制造夹爪的全自动可追溯设计能力，并在四种物体上通过筛查门禁。然而，由于缺少基于实际材料的试样标定与仪器化物理测试，所有设计仍停留在数字筛选验证阶段，尚未达到可运行发布的产品级状态。

Abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end computational pipeline that converts a selected object mesh, a measured object state, and a selected six-axis robot into an object-specific, unactuated, additively manufacturable gripper. The method couples exact-mesh RGB-D/ICP pose registration, deterministic surface-contact sampling, uncertainty-aware wrench screening, selection among six passive capture mechanisms, object-conformal surface synthesis, full-orientation robot inverse kinematics, a swept-volume-aware manufacturing domain, directional fused-deposition finite-element screening, and constrained three-dimensional SIMP topology optimization. Unlike workflows that treat grasp selection, tool geometry, motion, and structural design as separate problems, every exported design is bound to the source mesh, object pose, robot flange, contact set, and insertion hypothesis by a traceable design identifier. We derive the implemented registration, contact, fit-tolerance, finite-element, and density-optimization equations and prove three properties of the numerical construction: nodal load preservation, monotonic compliance sensitivity under SIMP interpolation, and voxel-domain containment after topology post-processing. Four archived object-specific attempts - a rabbit, camera flange, 3DBenchy, and faceted bust - meet the nominal fit, uncertain-wrench, runtime-sweep, and baseline/post-topology FEA gates. A deliberately enlarged +/-3 mm, +/-5 degree pose stress check differentiates the designs, retaining 29-134 of 160 simulated trials. Their reconstructed topologies retain 92.0-97.6% of the FE domain because functional regions are protected. Archived robot photographs show the corresponding printed assemblies qualitatively, while nominal material properties and absent coupon-calibrated, instrumented tests keep all four at digital-screening status rather than operational release.

</details>


### [289] [A comparative study on the accuracy & repeatability of mobile robotic platforms for the delivery of precision NDE measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03794)
*SeyedMohammadAmin Nabi Pour,S. Gareth Pierce,Randika Vithanage,Ehsan Mohseni,David Carswell,Matthew Shields*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于激光跟踪仪的通用评估流程（地面真值误差约6微米），对五种商用移动机器人平台（KUKA KMP-1500、KUKA KMR、MiR250、Boston Dynamics Spot、Clearpath Husky）在统一外部参照协议下进行静态与分段轨迹定位精度评估。结果表明静态定位精度中位数范围为8.2mm至63.5mm，动态路径跟踪误差范围为6.9mm至112.1mm，没有任何平台仅凭基座定位能满足0.2-1.0mm的航空航天无损检测公差，该结果作为设计输入以量化各平台所需的补充传感量级，为平台选型提供可复现依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人平台为大型航空航天结构的无损检测提供了比固定机械臂更灵活的替代方案，但其基座定位精度及该精度应如何指导部署决策，此前尚未在统一的、外部参照的协议下得到系统评估。

Method: 采用激光跟踪仪构建评估工作流（地面真值误差约6微米），对五种商用移动平台在统一协议下测量静态与分段轨迹定位精度；通过耦合多角点标定恢复激光到机器人的变换及反射镜偏移，使用全位姿普通最小二乘估计，稳健估计仅作为粗差检测保留。

Result: 静态定位精度中位数范围从KMP-1500的8.2mm到Spot的63.5mm，仅靠轮式里程计的Husky无法标定；动态路径跟随以横向偏差表征，对时间对齐不敏感，范围从KMP-1500的6.9mm到Spot的112.1mm。精度与可标定性均与定位能力（从最新LiDAR SLAM平台到无地图视觉里程计）相关。无平台能在基座层面满足0.2-1.0mm的航空航天NDE公差，最佳平台需约一个数量级的补充传感，最差平台需近两个数量级。

Conclusion: 研究结果以设计输入的形式量化了各平台所需的补充传感规模，为平台选择提供了可复现的依据，而非单纯的可实现性声明。

Abstract: Mobile robotic platforms offer a flexible alternative to fixed manipulators for non-destructive evaluation (NDE) of large aerospace structures, but their base-positioning accuracy and how that accuracy should inform deployment have not been assessed under a common, externally referenced protocol. This work presents a laser tracker-based evaluation workflow (ground truth approximately 6 micrometers) that measures the static and segmented trajectory positioning accuracy of five commercial mobile platforms (KUKA KMP-1500, KUKA KMR, MiR250, Boston Dynamics Spot, Clearpath Husky) under a common protocol. A coupled multi-corner calibration recovers the laser-to-robot transformation and reflector offsets; ordinary least squares over all poses is used, with robust estimation retained only as a blunder check.
  Static positioning accuracy ranged from a median of 8.2 mm (KMP-1500) to 63.5 mm (Spot), with the wheel-odometry-only Husky uncalibratable. Dynamic path following was characterised by cross-track error; the component was insensitive to temporal alignment, which ranged from 6.9 mm (KMP-1500) to 112.1 mm (Spot). Both accuracy and calibratability tracked localisation capability, from the newest LiDAR SLAM platform to map-free visual odometry. No configuration meets the 0.2 to 1.0 mm aerospace NDE tolerance from the base alone; the results are framed as a design input that sizes the supplementary sensing each platform requires: roughly one order of magnitude for the best platform and nearly two for the worst, providing a reproducible basis for platform selection rather than a feasibility claim.

</details>


### [290] [FWBC-VLA: Force-Aware Whole-Body Compensation for Contact-Rich Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03889)
*Yutian Zhang,Siyuan Ma,Liwen Yang,Yang Li,Ce Hao,Haozhen Chi,Dong We,Qiaojun Yu,Dibo Hou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出FWBC-VLA框架，用于轮腿机器人的接触丰富型移动操作任务。该框架通过无传感器的残差力矩估计器（HSR-Force）推断接触强度与时间变化，并将其编码为token注入VLA模型的动作解码过程，使策略能感知接触的起始、持续与释放。同时，机器人的本体感知状态、Jacobian导出的机体坐标系力估计以及估计的接触状态被联合馈入补偿生成器以产生修正动作，最终与操作动作结合后交由全身控制（WBC）策略执行。在黑板擦拭和带门吸器的开门等真实实验中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型只能生成任务级动作，无法解释动作引发的物理交互；全身控制（WBC）能稳定机器人但无法区分任务相关接触力与外部扰动；力/力矩传感器虽可直接测量物理交互但改造硬件成本高、集成负担大。因此需要一种无需额外传感器即可实现力感知的桥梁框架。

Method: 1）提出HSR-Force无传感器残差力矩估计器，用于推断接触强度及其时间变化；2）将接触估计编码为token注入VLA动作专家，使策略感知接触起始、持续加载和释放阶段；3）在包含5000+episodes的WL&Arm数据集上微调预训练VLA骨干全部参数；4）将本体感知状态、Jacobian导出的机体系力估计及接触状态共同馈入补偿生成器产生修正动作；5）将操作动作与修正动作结合后交给WBC策略执行。

Result: 在黑板擦拭和带门吸器的开门两项真实接触丰富移动操作实验中，FWBC-VLA框架均验证了有效性，证明其在力感知的轮腿移动操作中的实际可行性。

Conclusion: FWBC-VLA成功建立了任务级VLA动作生成与底层全身补偿控制之间的力感知桥梁，通过无传感器的接触估计方式避免了额外硬件成本，为接触丰富型轮腿机器人的移动操作提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Contact-rich loco-manipulation requires a bridge between semantic action generation and physical interaction control. Existing Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate task-level actions from visual and linguistic observations, but cannot interpret the physical interactions induced by those actions. While the whole-body control (WBC) policy can stabilize the robot, it cannot distinguish task-relevant interaction forces from forces induced by external disturbances during manipulation. Although force/torque sensors provide direct measurements of physical interactions, retrofitting them entails additional hardware costs and substantial integration effort, particularly for platforms not designed with sensor integration in mind. To address this problem, we propose FWBC-VLA, a force-aware framework that bridges task-level VLA action generation and low-level whole-body compensation control for wheeled-legged robots. First, we introduce HSR-Force, a sensorless residual-torque estimator for inferring contact strength and its temporal variation. These contact estimates are then encoded as tokens and injected into the VLA action expert during action decoding, enabling the policy to perceive contact onset, sustained loading, and release. For loco-manipulation tasks, all parameters of the pretrained VLA backbone are fine-tuned on our WL\&Arm Dataset, which comprises more than 5,000 episodes. Moreover, the robot's proprioceptive state, the Jacobian-derived body-frame force estimate, and the estimated contact state are jointly fed into a compensation generator to produce corrective actions. The manipulation-centric actions are subsequently combined with the corrective actions and passed to the WBC policy for execution. Real-world experiments on whiteboard wiping and door opening with a door closer demonstrate the effectiveness of our FWBC-VLA in contact-rich loco-manipulation.

</details>


### [291] [A hybrid pipeline for dynamic ontology-based semantic mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03891)
*Konstantinos Dimitropoulos,Ioannis Hatzilygeroudis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种混合语义映射管线，结合外部标定相机的单应投影几何映射与定位、目标检测、持续目标跟踪和本体驱动的语义更新，构建动态语义世界模型，并使用线性回归模型修正真实世界坐标估计，最终实现基于实时感知数据的对象实例、空间属性和语义关系的持续更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义映射对机器人操作、导航和复杂环境交互至关重要，尽管现有管线已涵盖SLAM、感知、语义融合和表示，但大多数工作未有效整合先验知识（如知识图谱或语义场景图）来增强环境上下文的语义理解。作者旨在弥补这一不足，通过引入外部相机和本体论知识驱动，构建更具上下文感知能力的语义映射系统。

Method: 提出一种混合语义映射管线，主要包含以下组件：(1) 利用外部标定相机通过单应（homography）投影实现几何映射和定位；(2) 结合目标检测与持久目标跟踪；(3) 采用本体（ontology）驱动的语义更新机制，利用本体层级结构与语义表达力支持动态世界建模；(4) 使用线性回归模型对真实世界坐标估计值进行校正；(5) 基于实时感知数据持续更新对象实例、空间属性和语义关系。

Result: 系统能够持续更新对象实例、空间属性与语义关系，形成了动态语义世界模型。由于包含了本体驱动的语义更新与几何坐标回归校正，管线在语义映射的上下文理解能力和动态建模方面具备优于传统管线的能力（文中未给出定量实验数据）。

Conclusion: 作者认为本体因其层级结构、语义表达力以及对动态世界建模的支持，是语义映射中知识表示的优选形式。该混合管线整合了几何、感知与语义先验知识，为机器人在复杂环境中进行高质量的语义映射提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: Semantic mapping plays a crucial role in the ability of a robot to interact with objects, operate and navigate a complex environment. The most common pipeline for semantic mapping consists of geometric mapping and localization (SLAM), perception, semantic fusion and semantic representation. However, more recent works also integrate a form of prior knowledge in their application, most notably knowledge graphs or semantic scene graphs, to improve contextual understanding of the environment. In this paper, we present a hybrid pipeline for semantic mapping. Our system incorporates an external calibrated camera using homography projection for geometric mapping and localization, combined with object detection, persistent object tracking and ontology driven semantic updates to build a dynamic semantic world model. Linear regression models are also used for correction of the estimated values of real world coordinates. The system continuously updates object instances, spatial properties and semantic relations based on real time sensory data. Ontologies are selected as form of knowledge representation due to their hierarchical structure, semantic expressiveness and support for dynamic world modelling.

</details>


### [292] [Revisiting Topological Graphs for Macro Action based Closed-loop Reinforcement Learning of Vision Language Navigation in Continuous Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03906)
*Shuhao Ye,Sitong Mao,Yuxiang Cui,Yufei Wei,Xuan Yu,Shichao Zhai,Wen Chen,Shunbo Zhou,Rong Xiong,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将连续环境下的视觉语言导航(VLN-CE)重新建模为层次马尔可夫决策过程(HMDP)，通过拓扑图抽象将高层策略作用于前沿节点宏动作空间，配合无需训练的低层控制器作为状态转移，并使用基于图的PPO和动作感知价值头进行强化学习优化，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模仿学习(IL)在VLN-CE闭环设定中存在问题：行为克隆遭受分布偏移，DAgger在轨迹偏离后专家动作变得模糊。虽然强化学习(RL)是自然解决方案，但直接在微观动作空间应用RL因奖励稀疏而样本效率低。

Method: 1) 将VLN-CE重新表述为层次MDP，解耦高层规划与低层控制；2) 将环境抽象为拓扑图，高层策略在宏动作空间（前沿节点）上运行，低层控制采用无训练控制器作为状态转移；3) 提出动作感知价值头以在动态前沿动作空间下评估状态价值，并基于此实现图结构的PPO算法。

Result: 大量实验验证了架构的有效性，模型在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上达到最先进(state-of-the-art)性能。

Conclusion: 通过层次化分解和宏动作空间设计，闭环RL在VLN-CE中变得可训练且高效，克服了IL管线与直接RL方法在稀疏奖励下的局限。

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an agent to follow natural language instructions through unseen environments. Existing imitation learning (IL) pipelines struggle in this closed-loop setting: behavior cloning suffers from distribution shift, and DAgger's expert actions become ambiguous upon trajectory deviation. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a natural paradigm to address this, directly applying RL to micro action spaces is sample-inefficient due to reward sparsity. To overcome this bottleneck, we reformulate VLN-CE as a Hierarchical Markov Decision Process (MDP), explicitly decoupling high-level planning from low-level control. By abstracting the environment into a topological graph, our high-level policy operates on a macro action space of frontier nodes, with a training-free low-level controller acting as its state transition, which significantly compresses the decision horizon and makes closed-loop RL tractable. To support RL optimization on the macro MDP, we propose an action-aware value head to effectively evaluate state values under the dynamic frontier action space, powering a graph-based PPO. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our architecture. Finally, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.

</details>


### [293] [Toward Unified Robot Learning: Bridging Representation, Vision-Language-Action, and World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03927)
*Shaunak A. Mehta,Ananya Hazarika,Haochen Zhang,Fan Yang,Ryo Moriyama,Wenkai Li,Yash Patel,Kanata Suzuki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一视角来审视机器人学习，将现有方法按三条互补轴线组织：通过表示学习实现"理解"、通过VLA模型实现"行动"、通过世界模型实现"推理"，并引入结构化分类体系分析组件间交互，指出挑战源于各组件孤立开发及缺乏跨感知、行动与推理的整合，呼吁向统一、物理扎根、概率化的机器人学习方向发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界中的机器人需要感知、行动并推理行动后果。表示学习、VLA模型和世界模型虽各自取得显著进展，但这些范式通常孤立发展，导致系统碎片化，难以应对泛化、长时序推理与规划以及在非结构化环境中的部署等核心挑战。

Method: 以综述形式提出统一视角：按理解（表示学习）、行动（VLA模型）、推理（世界模型）三条互补轴线组织现有方法；构建结构化分类体系，覆盖环境表示、策略学习和预测建模中的关键设计选择；总结近期进展并分析各组件间如何交互。

Result: 完成了对机器人学习领域现有方法的系统归类与总结，识别出不确定性量化、分布外泛化、跨具身迁移、长上下文理解与长时序规划等核心挑战，并论证这些挑战不仅源于单个组件的局限，更源于感知、行动与推理之间缺乏整合。

Conclusion: 指出未来方向应朝向统一、物理扎根且概率化的机器人学习，以构建保持一致内部表示并在真实环境长时间交互中支持决策的稳健机器人系统。

Abstract: For robots to operate reliably in real-world environments, they need to perceive their surroundings, act, and reason about the consequences of those actions. Rapid progress in the domains of representation learning, VLA models, and world models has significantly enhanced the capabilities of robot learning systems, enabling robots to work in increasingly complex environments. However, these paradigms are typically developed in isolation, resulting in fragmented systems that struggle with generalization, long-horizon temporal reasoning and planning, and deployment in unstructured environments. In this survey, we present a unified perspective on robot learning by organizing the existing methods along three complementary axes: understanding through representation learning, acting through VLA models, and reasoning through world models. We introduce a structured taxonomy that captures key design choices in environment representation, policy learning, and predictive modeling, and summarize the recent progress in these domains. Beyond classifying the existing works, we analyze how these components interact, discuss common limitations, and highlight emerging trends towards more integrated systems. Through this lens, we identify the challenges in the domain of robot learning, including uncertainty quantification, out-of-distribution generalization, cross-embodiment transfer, long-context understanding, and long-horizon planning. We argue that these challenges arise not only from limitations within individual components but also from the lack of integration across perception, action, and reasoning. Building on this analysis, we outline future directions towards unified, physically grounded, and probabilistic robot learning to develop robust robotic systems that maintain consistent internal representations and support decision making over extended interactions in real-world environments.

</details>


### [294] [Automated Weld Seam Recognition and 3D Mapping for Robotic Post Processing Using Photogrammetry and Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03970)
*Augustin Raju,Abilash Madavath,Chandra Yuvesh Aubeeluck,Nicolas Pyschny,Felix Hackelöer,Florian Zwanzig*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于视觉的焊缝近似定位流水线，作为高精度测量前的预扫描阶段，通过多视角图像采集、语义分割焊缝识别、摄影测量重建及焊缝投影到三维模型，以减少大型工件表面扫描的工作量和数据量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型工件使用高精度激光扫描仪或结构光传感器进行完整表面扫描既耗时又会产生大量无关数据，因此需要一个初步的焊缝定位阶段来减少整体扫描工作量并提高数据采集效率。

Method: 提出实验性视觉流水线，包含四个步骤：从多个视角采集工件图像；使用语义分割从图像中识别焊缝；利用摄影测量技术重建工件三维模型；将识别出的焊缝投影到重建模型中，实现焊缝在大工件上的近似定位。

Result: 该流水线作为高精度测量前的预定位阶段，能够减少整体扫描工作量并提升数据采集效率（论文未提供定量实验结果细节）。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于视觉的焊缝近似定位方法可作为自动化机器人后处理（如磨削、精加工和检测）高精度测量的有效前置步骤，降低扫描成本并提升效率。

Abstract: Accurate identification of weld seam geometries is essential for automated robotic post processing operations such as grinding, finishing, and inspection. For large workpieces, complete surface scanning using high precision laser scanners or structured light sensors can be time consuming and often generates substantial amount of data that are not relevant. This paper presents an experimental vision based pipeline for the approximate localization of weld seams. This serves as a preliminary stage before high precision measurement. The proposed approach aims to reduce the overall scanning effort and data acquisition efficiency. The proposed method includes capturing images of the workpiece from multiple viewpoints, identifying weld seams from the images using semantic segmentation, reconstructing the workpiece using photogrammetry, and projection of identified weld seams into the reconstructed model.

</details>


### [295] [MulDP: Multimodal Diffusion Policy for Autonomous Quadruped Parkour Navigation across Complex Terrains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03984)
*Kangmai Hu,Yueqi Zhang,Peng Zhai,Xiaoyi Wei,Jiabin Hu,Zhixiang Liu,Quancheng Qian,Lihua Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多模态扩散策略（MulDP），将视觉感知与机器人本体感觉及目标信息融合，生成时间上连贯且具有预见性的导航速度指令，以实现四足机器人在复杂地形上的自主跑酷导航；同时构建了首个四足跑酷导航数据集（QPND）用于训练，实验验证了其在长时程自主导航和复杂地形穿越中的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四足机器人在跑酷运动上已展现出出色的敏捷性，但大多数系统在高层级规划中仍依赖人工干预，自主跑酷导航尚未被充分探索。核心挑战包括细粒度的速度调控、长时程的前瞻性行为以及感知与具身执行之间的紧密耦合。

Method: 提出多模态扩散策略（MulDP），融合视觉感知、机器人本体感觉和目标信息，利用扩散模型生成时间上连贯且具有前瞻性的导航速度指令，从而实现感知与具身控制的紧密耦合；并构建了首个包含多样导航行为和复杂地形的多模态四足跑酷导航数据集（QPND）以支持模型训练。

Result: 大量的仿真和真实世界实验表明，MulDP能够在复杂地形上实现鲁棒的长时程自主导航和有效的穿越能力。

Conclusion: MulDP通过多模态扩散策略有效解决了四足机器人自主跑酷导航中的速度调控、前瞻行为和感知-执行耦合等关键问题，填补了该领域自主高层规划的空白。

Abstract: Quadruped robots have demonstrated impressive agility in parkour locomotion across complex terrains. However, most systems still rely on human intervention for high-level planning, and autonomous parkour navigation remains underexplored. The key challenges include fine-grained velocity regulation, long-horizon anticipatory behaviors, and tight coupling between perception and embodied execution. To address these challenges, we propose a Multimodal Diffusion Policy (MulDP) that integrates visual perception with robot proprioception and goal information to generate temporally coherent and anticipatory navigation velocity commands, tightly coupling perception with embodied control to enable robust autonomous navigation. To support the training of MulDP, we construct the first Quadruped Parkour Navigation Dataset (QPND), a multimodal dataset that encompasses diverse navigation behaviors and complex terrains. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that MulDP enables robust long-horizon autonomous navigation and effective traversal across complex terrains.

</details>


### [296] [Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04096)
*Sixu Yan,Shikang Wang,Binhua Huang,Xuanlai Tang,Guohua Fan,Fan Huang,Haoxuan Li,Yongkang Li,Yuhan Li,Bencheng Liao,Zeyu Zhang,Wenyu Liu,Hangxin Liu,Xinggang Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaRoboVLG，一种任务自适应的视觉-语言-抓取框架，将物理抓取合成与任务相关理解解耦，支持跨不同机械手的通用抓取合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLG方法将基础模型与端到端抓取策略紧密耦合，难以跨机械手泛化，且新任务需求会导致底层抓取策略重训练；需要一种可扩展的、将物理可行性抓取与任务理解分离的框架。

Method: AdaRoboVLG学习一个高效且可泛化的基础策略，通过显式运动学映射和力闭合稳定性估计来生成和评估物理可行的抓取候选；将任务相关理解卸载至专门化的基础模型模块，这些模块提供可组合的先验知识并集成到抓取合成过程中，无需重训练底层抓取策略即可实现上下文自适应的抓取合成。

Result: 实验表明：基础策略具有高效学习和强跨手泛化能力；框架能有效整合空间、认知和时间先验来解决三类代表性抓取挑战，且抓取合成性能不逊于SOTA方法；多种先验可联合工作，在杂乱动态环境中实现功能性抓取。

Conclusion: 将物理抓取合成与任务相关理解解耦为机器人抓取提供了可扩展范式，未来基础模型的进步可直接转化为抓取能力提升，而无需重新设计或训练底层抓取策略。

Abstract: This paper proposes AdaRoboVLG, a task-adaptive Vision-Language-Grasp (VLG) framework that supports generalizable grasp synthesis across different robotic hands. Unlike existing VLG methods that tightly couple foundation models with end-to-end grasp policies, AdaRoboVLG learns an efficient generalizable base policy that generates and evaluates physically feasible grasp candidates through explicit kinematic mapping and force-closure-based stability estimation, while offloading task-dependent understanding to specialized foundation-model modules. These modules provide composable priors that are integrated into the grasp synthesis process, enabling contextually adaptive grasp synthesis without retraining the underlying grasp policy. Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, we demonstrate that (i) the base policy exhibits efficient learning and strong cross-hand generalization, (ii) the framework effectively incorporates spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors to address three representative grasping challenges without compromising grasp synthesis performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, and (iii) these priors can operate jointly to enable functional grasping in cluttered and dynamic environments. These results indicate that decoupling physical grasp synthesis from task-dependent understanding provides a scalable paradigm for robotic grasping, allowing future advances in foundation models to be directly translated into improved grasp capabilities without redesigning or retraining the underlying grasp policy. Supplementary videos are available at https://adarobovlg.github.io/

</details>


### [297] [Corner Cases: Headland Coverage Path Planning for Autonomous Driving in Arable Farming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04103)
*Riikka Soitinaho,Timo Oksanen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于耕地地头覆盖路径规划的新方法，通过修改多边形角点允许倒退转弯，相比两种现有方法在间隙、重叠和越界方面均有改进，尤其在约90°及240°以上的地头拐角处效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地头覆盖路径规划方法多采用嵌套多边形和平滑转弯，但在地块角落处完全覆盖需要倒退机动，已有方法无法有效处理这一难题。

Method: 新方法通过修改多边形角点以允许倒退转弯（reversing turn），从而实现对地块角部区域的完整覆盖。

Result: 与两种其他方法相比，新方法在间隙（gap）、重叠（overlap）和跨越田块边界（crossing the field boundary）方面均有所改进，尤其在约90°及240°以上角度的地块拐角处提升明显。通过多个真实多边形田块地图的实例验证了方法的适用性。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于倒退转弯的地头覆盖路径规划方法能够有效改善复杂形状地块角落的覆盖质量，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: This paper presents a new method for headland coverage path planning for arable fields. Several earlier approaches suggest covering the headland with nested polygons and smooth turns, however, covering the field corners entirely requires manoeuvres with reversing. In the new method, the polygon corners are modified to allow a reversing turn. A comparison to two other methods considering gap, overlap, and crossing the field boundary shows an improvement in the coverage result especially in field corners of around 90 degrees, and 240 degrees and above. Applicability of the new method is shown with several examples of real polygonal field maps.

</details>


### [298] [GIFT: Guided Intermediate Feature Training via Action-Oriented Structural Supervision for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04193)
*Yupeng Zheng,Xiang Li,Songen Gu,Yuhang Zheng,Shuai Tian,Weize Li,Linbo Wang,Chaoyue Li,Qichao Zhang,Haoran Li,Zhongpu Xia,Ya-Qin Zhang,Shuicheng Yan,Dongbin Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出GIFT（Guided Intermediate Feature Training）框架，通过引导中间特征保留几何、 affordance 和目标三个控制相关结构，弥合视觉预训练特征丰富性与控制效用之间的"动作充分性差距"。在三种不同动作制定的VLA、WAM和IDM模型上均取得显著零样本迁移性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言预训练与世界模型为机器人策略提供了丰富的语义和动态视觉特征，但其原生目标往往忽略关键物理与任务结构，同时保留与控制无关的视觉冗余。这种视觉丰富性与控制效用之间的不匹配（即"动作充分性差距"）限制了机器人策略的性能，作者旨在探究能否通过引导中间特征来弥合这一差距。

Method: GIFT框架通过三种结构化约束引导中间特征训练：(1) 几何对齐，保留控制运动可行性的空间几何；(2) affordance预测，编码与指令相关的可操作实体；(3) 目标区域重建，将指令锚定到任务相关区域。该框架是架构灵活的，可实例化在VLA策略、直接动作WAM和逆动力学WAM中，同时保持各模型原有的动作表述。

Result: 在LIBERO-Plus零样本迁移中，GIFT-VLA、GIFT-WAM-Fast、GIFT-WAM-IDM分别达到79.6%、72.6%和87.8%，较基线提升4.6、12.6和5.2个百分点。在RoboCasa上分别达到61.4%、83.6%和82.3%，提升12.6、9.0和8.4个百分点。在关节物体任务和未见视觉与空间扰动下的高精度真实世界操作中获益尤为显著。

Conclusion: 学习功能结构化的中间特征是一种跨模型特定动作制定的可复用原则，能够有效弥合视觉丰富性与控制效用之间的动作充分性差距，在多种机器人操作模型架构上带来一致且显著的性能提升。

Abstract: Vision-language pre-training and predictive world modeling provide robot policies with rich semantic and dynamic visual features, but their native action and visual-prediction objectives may omit critical physical and task structure while retaining control-irrelevant visual redundancy. We call this mismatch between visual richness and control utility the action-sufficiency gap. We investigate whether this gap can be bridged by guiding intermediate features to preserve three control-relevant structure in robotic manipulation: geometry governing motion feasibility, affordance encoding instruction-relevant entities, and goals grounding instructions in task-relevant regions. To this end, we present GIFT (Guided Intermediate Feature Training), an architecture-flexible framework for learning intermediate features that translates these structures into training-time constraints through geometry alignment, affordance prediction, and goal-region reconstruction. We instantiate GIFT in a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, a direct-action World-Action Model (WAM), and an inverse-dynamics WAM while retaining each model's action formulation. Under zero-shot transfer to LIBERO-Plus, GIFT-VLA, GIFT-WAM-Fast, and GIFT-WAM-IDM outperform StarVLA-OFT, Fast-WAM, and Fast-WAM-IDM by 4.6, 12.6, and 5.2 points, reaching 79.6%, 72.6%, and 87.8%, respectively. On RoboCasa, the three GIFT variants reach 61.4%, 83.6%, and 82.3%, outperforming their counterparts by 12.6, 9.0, and 8.4 points, respectively. Together, these results establish learning functionally structured intermediate features as a reusable principle across model-specific action formulations, with especially large gains on articulated-object tasks and high-precision real-world manipulation under unseen visual and spatial perturbations. Project page: https://openphoenix-team.github.io/GIFT-pages.

</details>

# q-bio.BM [[Back]](#toc)

### [299] [Advances in Machine Learning for Directed Evolution: A Five-Year Retrospective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03046)
*Bruce J. Wittmann*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: 本文反思了机器学习辅助定向进化（MLDE）领域在过去五年多的发展困境，指出该领域研究者追求"找到最优蛋白"的目标与定向进化"在时间和资源约束下找到足够好的蛋白"的广泛目标之间存在脱节，并批评大多数MLDE方法忽略了DNA合成成本等实际约束，导致其实用价值有限。文章最后指出近期一些例外工作，并强调这五年ML辅助蛋白工程的努力与新目标框架不必互相排斥。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去五年机器学习在诸多蛋白工程领域取得突破性进展，但定向进化领域却未能被同等程度地变革。作者认为核心原因是MLDE研究目标与实际应用需求之间存在根本性错位，因此需要反思并重新审视该领域的研究方向。

Method: 本文是一篇反思性/观点性文章，作者以回顾自身先前合著观点的形式，从目标设定的角度剖析MLDE发展受限的原因，分析MLDE研究者与定向进化实践者的目标差异，特别以DNA合成成本的忽略为例说明现有方法的实用局限性，并对例外工作进行评述。

Result: 作者指出MLDE与广泛定向进化之间的目标脱节是制约该领域变革的核心原因；大多数现有MLDE方法因忽略DNA合成等实际成本而缺乏实际适用性；不过也有一些例外工作开始考虑实际约束，并且ML辅助蛋白工程的既有努力与重新定义MLDE目标并不冲突。

Conclusion: MLDE需要从"寻找最优蛋白"重新定位为"在时间和资源约束下寻找足够好的蛋白"，以实用性为导向纳入DNA合成成本等现实因素，同时保留ML技术进步所带来的优势，二者可以兼顾。

Abstract: The last five-plus years have seen many protein engineering disciplines transformed by advances in machine learning (ML), but the same cannot be said for directed evolution. Reflecting on a previously co-authored perspective, I discuss why I believe this to be the case, arguing that a disconnect between the goals of machine-learning-assisted directed evolution (MLDE) researchers--"identify an optimal protein"--and the goals of directed evolution more broadly--"identify a sufficient protein given time and resource constraints"--is a principal culprit. As an example, I highlight how nearly all current MLDE methods neglect to account for the cost of DNA synthesis, resulting in strategies that have limited practical applicability regardless of the underlying models' capabilities. I close by discussing recent works that are exceptions to this overarching trend, and emphasize that the last five years of efforts in ML-assisted protein engineering and the prescribed reframe of MLDE objectives need not be mutually exclusive.

</details>


### [300] [An Integrative Computational Approach to Predict Viral Epitopes by Targeting the MHC-TCR Complexation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03182)
*Jaya Vasavi Pamidimukkala,Roshan Balaji,Nirav Pravinbhai Bhatt,Sanjib Senapati*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: 本文采用整合计算策略（生物信息学+分子动力学模拟+机器学习）研究pMHC-TCR结合触发T细胞活化的机制，通过150个MHC-肽-TCR复合物的微秒级模拟并训练ML模型（DynamiT），以73.3%的准确率识别出T细胞活化的关键决定因素，为疫苗开发提供ML引导的表位筛选工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T细胞免疫是脊椎动物抗病毒的主要防御系统，但pMHC-TCR结合触发T细胞活化的机制仍不清楚。理解这一机制对于疫苗开发至关重要。

Method: 整合生物信息学、全原子与粗粒化分子动力学（MD）模拟及机器学习：对150个嵌入树突状细胞和T细胞的MHC-肽-TCR复合物各模拟1微秒，从2500个时间点提取结构和动力学特征训练DynamiT ML模型。

Result: DynamiT模型以73.3%的准确率识别出T细胞活化的关键决定因素，鉴定出TCR跨膜区弯曲、TCRα恒定区的主要动力学运动以及pMHC-TCR界面的埋藏表面积是影响免疫反应启动的关键因素。

Conclusion: 该方法揭示了T细胞介导免疫反应的机制，并支持机器学习引导的病毒表位筛选以加速疫苗开发。

Abstract: T-cell immunity acts as a major defense system against controlling viral infections in vertebrates. During viral entry, innate immune cells degrade the viral proteins (antigens) and present them on their surface via Major Histocompatibility (MHC) proteins. T-cell receptors (TCRs) recognize these antigens/peptides presented by MHC (pMHC), initiating a T-cell mediated immune response. Despite its significance, the mechanism by which pMHC-TCR binding triggers T-cell activation remains unclear. In this study, we employed an integrative computational approach combining Bioinformatics, Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, and Machine Learning (ML) to identify viral epitopes as potential vaccine candidates. We performed large-scale all-atom and coarse-grained MD simulations on MHC-peptide-TCR complexes embedded into dendritic and T-cells, for which experimental immunogenicity data is available. One hundred fifty such systems are simulated for 1 μs each to capture the conformational and dynamical changes that underlie T-cell activation. Our ML model (DynamiT), trained on simulation-derived structural and dynamical features extracted from 2500 time points, revealed key determinants responsible for T-cell activation with an accuracy of 73.3%. Notably, we have identified the bending of the TCR transmembrane region, major dynamic motions of the TCRα constant region and the buried surface area at the pMHC and TCR interface as critical factors influencing immune response initiation. Our approach unravels the mechanism of T-cell mediated immune response and helps ML-guided screening of viral epitopes for vaccine development.

</details>


### [301] [Structural control over equilibrium silicon and oxygen isotopic fractionation: A first-principles density-functional theory study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03486)
*Merlin Méheut,Michele Lazzeri,Etienne Balan,Francesco Mauri*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: 本文利用第一性原理方法计算了石英、顽火辉石、镁橄榄石、利蛇纹石和高岭石等硅酸盐矿物中氧和硅的同位素分馏因子，发现氧同位素理论与实验吻合良好，而硅同位素与现有平衡分馏估计存在异同。研究否定了硅分馏与矿物聚合度相关的先前论断，提出硅分馏依赖于矿物阳离子含量，与氧分馏行为类似，可借助氧分馏特性推断硅分馏行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过第一性原理计算精确获取硅酸盐矿物中氧和硅的同位素分馏因子，并厘清硅分馏与矿物聚合度和化学成分之间的内在关系，以验证或修正前人提出的相关假说。

Method: 采用第一性原理计算方法，对选定硅酸盐矿物（石英、顽火辉石、镁橄榄石、利蛇纹石、高岭石）计算氧和硅的同位素分馏因子，并与实验值及已有估计进行对比，进而系统分析硅分馏因子与聚合度及化学成分之间的关系。

Result: 氧同位素分馏因子的理论计算结果与实验数据吻合良好；硅同位素方面，与现有平衡分馏估计既有吻合之处也存在差异。研究未证实硅分馏与矿物聚合度的先前关系，但发现硅分馏依赖于矿物的阳离子含量，其行为模式与氧分馏相似。

Conclusion: 硅酸盐中硅同位素分馏并非由聚合度主导，而是由矿物阳离子含量所控制；由于硅和氧的分馏行为具有相似性，可通过氧同位素分馏特性为硅同位素分馏行为提供预测参考。

Abstract: Isotopic fractionation factors for oxygen and silicon in selected silicates (quartz, enstatite, forsterite, lizardite, kaolinite) have been calculated using first-principles methods. Good agreement between theory and experiment is obtained in the case of oxygen. In the case of silicon, agreement and differences with existing estimates of equilibrium fractionation factors are discussed. The relationships between silicon fractionation factors and oxygen fractionation factors, silicate polymerization degree and chemical composition is studied. The previously stated relationship with the polymerization degree of the mineral is not confirmed. Nevertheless, our calculation suggests that silicon fractionation depends on the cationic content of the mineral, in a way similar to oxygen.  Oxygen fractionation properties could thus provide some insights on silicon fractionation behavior.

</details>

### [302] [SurfSpec: Enhancing Off-Target-Agnostic Specificity by Bounding Pocket-Ligand Geometric Mismatch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02963)
*Minyeong Hwang,Yoorim Gang,Ziseok Lee,Wooyeol Lee,Young Bin Park,Jae-Mun Choi,Kyungsu Kim,Eunho Yang*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出SurfSpec，一个无需脱靶结构知识的特异性感知先导物优化框架，通过分析配体与靶点口袋的几何失配，利用三角不等式推导出保守特异性下界，并迭代向靶点口袋表面欠占据区域生长配体以降低几何失配，从而在保持靶点亲和力提升的同时改善经验特异性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于亲和力的先导物优化方法不显式控制特异性，而特异性感知方法通常需要预先知道脱靶结构。作者希望在无需脱靶结构信息的前提下实现特异性感知的先导物优化，解决真实药物研发中脱靶结构常不可知的痛点。

Method: 首先通过度量口袋-配体几何失配，利用三角不等式证明：降低靶点-配体失配可提升对分离脱靶类别的保守失配下界；再通过经验几何-亲和力校准将该下界转化为特异性下界。基于此理论分析，SurfSpec框架交替进行：(1) 向靶点口袋表面欠占据区域生成连接子，提供几何伪标签；(2) 在口袋条件配体先验下细化，将伪标签恢复为有效配体。在CrossDocked2020上进行评估。

Result: 在CrossDocked2020测试集上，SurfSpec降低了几何失配，在经验特异性上超越所评估的无需脱靶先导物优化基线方法，同时保持有竞争力的靶点亲和力提升效果。

Conclusion: 通过纯粹基于几何的分析将不对称性（特异性）建模为靶点-配体几何失配的保守下界，SurfSpec证明即使在完全不知道脱靶结构的情况下，也能实现特异性感知的先导物优化，避免与几何上分离的脱靶口袋发生不希望的相互作用。

Abstract: Lead optimization in structure-based drug design aims to improve target binding while avoiding unintended interactions with off-target pockets. However, existing affinity-driven methods do not explicitly control specificity, whereas current specificity-aware approaches commonly require prior knowledge of off-target structures. We address off-target-agnostic specificity-aware lead optimization by analyzing the geometric mismatch between a ligand and the target pocket. We provide a conservative specificity lower bound for geometrically separated off-targets without requiring access to off-target structures. By metricizing pocket--ligand mismatch, the triangle inequality shows that reducing target--ligand mismatch improves a conservative lower bound on mismatch to a separated off-target class, which can be translated into a specificity lower bound through an empirical geometry--affinity calibration. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce SurfSpec, an off-target-agnostic lead optimization framework that iteratively grows ligands toward under-occupied regions of the target pocket surface. SurfSpec alternates between linker generation toward selected target-surface patches, which provides geometric pseudo-labels, and refinement under a pocket-conditioned ligand prior, which restores these pseudo-labels into valid ligands. On the CrossDocked2020 test set, SurfSpec reduces geometric mismatch and outperforms evaluated off-target-agnostic lead optimization baselines in empirical specificity, while maintaining competitive target-affinity improvement.

</details>


### [303] [Sparse concept attribution for histomorphological hypothesis generation from whole-slide classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02985)
*Tristan Lazard,Kenza Bouzid,Julius Hense,Shruthi Bannur,Daniel Coelho de Castro,Daniel Shao,Rajesh Jena,Drew Williamson,Stephanie Hyland*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE方法，通过结合病理学视觉-语言模型与稀疏概念归因，对全切片图像分类器进行可解释的形态学分析，并引入MorphoRecoveryBench基准（7个病理医师标注任务）验证解释质量，证明稀疏归因能有效恢复已知形态学特征，且分解池化切片嵌入可在极低计算成本下达到相近效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织学图像蕴含丰富形态学信息，可揭示病理过程，但手动图像判读环节仍是建立形态表型与临床属性关联的瓶颈，亟需自动化的可解释分析方法。

Method: 提出SCOPE方法，将病理特异性视觉-语言模型与稀疏概念归因相结合，将切片级分类器的解释映射到通用组织形态学概念库上；同时构建MorphoRecoveryBench基准，包含7个带病理学家精选参考描述的任务，并对比密集与稀疏概念归因策略以及分解池化切片嵌入方法。

Result: 在MorphoRecoveryBench上，密集概念归因的表现与随机基线无法区分，而稀疏归因能显著恢复已知形态学信息；分解池化切片嵌入在解释正确性上与稀疏归因相近，但计算成本大幅降低。

Conclusion: 全切片分类器的后验可解释性能够以规模化方式生成形态学假设供专家验证，为病理学形态表型与临床属性关联的自动化发现提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Histology images contain rich morphological information and can provide insights into pathological processes. However, deriving hypotheses relating morphological phenotypes to clinical attributes is bottlenecked by a manual image interpretation step. Here, we demonstrate that this process can be automated through interpretable deep learning. We present SCOPE, a method to interpret slide-level classifiers by combining pathology-specific vision--language models with sparse concept attribution onto a generalist histomorphological concept bank. To measure whether such explanations recover known morphology, we introduce MorphoRecoveryBench, a benchmark of seven tasks with pathologist-curated reference descriptions. On this benchmark, dense concept attribution is indistinguishable from a random baseline, whereas sparse attribution recovers substantial known morphology; decomposing the pooled slide embedding reaches similar explanation correctness at a fraction of the computational cost. Post-hoc interpretation of whole-slide classifiers can thus generate morphological hypotheses at scale, for expert validation.

</details>


### [304] [The Identification of Biological Stains at Crime Scenes: A Promising Role for Proteomics and Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03521)
*Anna Rosenberg,Stéphanie Laurent,Esther Morandeau,Alix Munoz,Joelle Vinh*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文开发并评估了三种基于LC-HRMS/MS的互补蛋白质组学方法，用于鉴定血液、唾液、精液、尿液和阴道液等法医体液，包括纯样品和复杂混合物。三种方法分别基于体液特异性肽生物标志物、肽丰度比以及分类器链随机森林机器学习模型，其中特异性肽生物标志物和机器学习方法最为稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法医体液鉴定对犯罪现场重建至关重要。DNA分析虽能提供个体识别，但无法判断体液的来源类型（如血液、精液等）。因此需要开发能够准确鉴定体液来源的补充方法，以完善法医调查中的证据链。

Method: 研究采用液相色谱-高分辨质谱联用（LC-HRMS/MS）技术，开发并比较了三种蛋白质组学方法：（1）基于体液特异性肽生物标志物的方法，用于纯体液鉴定；（2）基于肽丰度比的方法，适用于体液混合物分析；（3）采用分类器链随机森林（Classifier Chain Random Forest）的机器学习模型，同时测试纯体液和混合物样本。

Result: 肽特异性生物标志物方法对纯体液具有高准确率；肽丰度比方法在体液混合物中表现有效；机器学习模型对纯体液达到100%准确率，对混合物也取得了有前景的结果。研究发现不同方法具有互补性，其中肽特异性生物标志物和机器学习方法最为稳健。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了蛋白质组学在法医体液综合鉴定方面的潜力，为法医调查提供了有价值的工具，可弥补DNA分析无法确定体液来源的局限性。

Abstract: Forensic body fluid identification is crucial for reconstructing crime scene events. While DNA analysis provides individualization, it lacks information about the fluid's origin. We developed and evaluated three complementary proteomic approaches using LC-HRMS/MS to identify blood, saliva, semen, urine, and vaginal fluid, including complex mixtures. The first method utilized fluid-specific peptide biomarkers, achieving high accuracy for pure fluids. The second employed peptide abundance ratios, demonstrating effectiveness in body fluid mixtures. The third, a machine learning model using Classifier Chain Random Forest, achieved 100% accuracy for pure fluids and promising results for mixtures. Our results revealed the complementarity of different tests, with the peptide-specific biomarker and machine-learning approaches being the most robust. This study demonstrates the potential of proteomics for comprehensive body fluid identification, offering valuable tools for forensic investigations.

</details>

### [305] [The Illusion of Independent Quorums: Epistemic Fault Domains and Correlated Cognitive Failures in Agentic Quorums](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02925)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出"认知故障域"(EFDs)和"结构认知割"κ_E概念，用于量化授权决策中多签名者共享上游故障源的脆弱性。作者证明大规模quorum仍可能具有κ_E=1（即完全缺乏认知冗余），并设计了依赖感知的quorum控制器(DAQC)在运行时强制结构割约束，附带了120项冻结基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多代理quorum广泛用于授权高风险的基建和策略变更，但不同审查者常常共享上游遥测、文档或工具后端。当上游输入失败时，多个投票会塌缩到同一个被污染的原因上——复制数量不等于认知冗余（epistemic redundancy）。作者希望形式化并量化这种隐蔽的脆弱性。

Method: 作者定义了Epistemic Fault Domains (EFDs)和Structural Epistemic Cut κ_E，该指标在显式的Epistemic Fault Basis下量化"覆盖一个授权联盟所需的最少根故障数"。在封闭因果核算、保守暴露和授权对齐条件下，κ_E构成语义妥协所需的根故障数(κ_S)的下界。作者推导了若干理论性质，并设计了Dependency-Aware Quorum Controller (DAQC)在运行时准入阶段强制实施结构割约束，通过解析推导和模拟验证机制。

Result: 论文证明了三个核心定理：任意大的quorum仍可能保持κ_E=1（即无认知冗余）；识别共享祖先从不增加被认定的韧性；在兼容暴露扩展下，固定阈值条件下增加投票者不能提高结构割。作者还提供了DAQC的机制验证以及一个含120个任务的冻结外部基准套件。

Conclusion: 复制不等于冗余是安全领域的关键洞见。该工作为quorum设计的认知独立性提供了可计算的形式化指标，说明盲目扩大审查规模不足以提升安全性，必须在运行时主动检测和隔离共享的故障根源。

Abstract: Multi-agent quorums are widely used to authorize high-stakes infrastructure and policy mutations, yet distinct reviewers often share upstream telemetry, documents, or tool backends. When upstream inputs fail, multiple votes collapse onto a single corrupted cause: replication does not imply epistemic redundancy. We introduce Epistemic Fault Domains (EFDs) and the Structural Epistemic Cut κ_E, which quantifies the minimum number of modeled root faults whose exposure covers an authorizing coalition relative to an explicit Epistemic Fault Basis. Under closed causal accounting, conservative exposure, and authorization alignment, κ_E lower-bounds the number of roots required for semantic compromise (κ_S). We prove that arbitrarily large quorums can retain κ_E=1, that recognizing shared ancestry never increases credited resilience, and that adding voters at a fixed threshold cannot increase the cut under compatible exposure extensions. Finally, we design the Dependency-Aware Quorum Controller (DAQC) to enforce structural cuts at runtime admission, evaluate its mechanics via analytical derivations and simulations, and provide a frozen 120-task external benchmark suite.

</details>


### [306] [Fully Fluctuating Sleepy Consensus from Minimal Assumptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03063)
*Javier Nieto,Yuval Efron,Joachim Neu,Ling Ren*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在外部敌手模型下、支持完全波动参与和腐败节点恢复的sleepy共识协议，仅基于PKI和VRF两种最小化假设，不依赖VDF或硬件假设，通过引入"分级清醒度"新原语实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比特币的PoW协议允许矿工随时离线并可通过恢复挖掘最长链来重获诚实身份，仅需诚实节点占多数算力。然而，对应的PoS协议（在sleepy模型中）未能匹配这一鲁棒性，因为标准sleepy共识协议在plain PKI模型中必须严格限制敌手参与的波动。尽管Efron等人通过外部敌手模型实现了完全波动的参与，但其协议依赖VDF这一强密码学原语，本质上仍隐含类似PoW的顺序计算假设。因此，目标是用更基础的原语实现同等鲁棒性。

Method: 核心创新是"分级清醒度"（graded wakeness）原语，允许节点对哪些其他节点处于清醒状态形成一致的共识意见。协议仅依赖PKI和VRF两种最小化假设，舍弃了VDF或硬件假设。在此基础上，进一步扩展协议以支持"非腐败"（uncorruption）场景，即腐败节点恢复诚实，该扩展仅需关于VRF输出不可预测性的温和假设以保证活性。

Result: 在诚实多数条件下，实现了外部敌手模型中完全波动参与的sleepy共识协议，从最小假设（PKI+VRF）出发，无需VDF或硬件假设。协议还支持腐败节点恢复诚实（uncorruption），仅以VRF输出的不可预测性作为活性方面的额外温和假设。

Conclusion: 通过分级清醒度这一新原语，表明在sleepy模型中无需VDF等强原语也能实现完全波动参与和腐败恢复的鲁棒共识，显著降低了与比特币PoW协议鲁棒性相匹配的PoS协议所需的密码学假设强度。

Abstract: Bitcoin's proof-of-work (PoW)-based protocol is remarkable for how little it asks of its participants. Not only can miners take breaks from work whenever they please, but it is almost unique in offering a path of contrition: corrupt miners can reclaim honest status simply by resuming mining on the longest chain. The protocol only requires that honest miners hold the majority of computational power at any given time. Analogous proof-of-stake (PoS) protocols, usually formalized via the sleepy model of Pass and Shi (2017), have fallen short of matching this robustness. In fact, sleepy consensus protocols in the plain PKI model must heavily restrict fluctuations in adversarial participation over time. The recent work of Efron, Neu, and Pitassi (2025) enables fully fluctuating participation in the sleepy model by introducing the external adversary model. Their protocol, however, relies on verifiable delay functions (VDFs), a strong cryptographic primitive that somewhat resembles PoW, by assuming that the adversary cannot compute sequential work significantly faster than honest nodes.
  In this work, we design a sleepy consensus protocol for fully fluctuating participation with an external adversary under an honest majority, from minimal assumptions: a public key infrastructure (PKI) and a verifiable random function (VRF). In particular, we make no VDF or hardware assumptions. Our key technique is graded wakeness, a novel primitive that allows nodes to form consistent opinions on which other nodes are awake. We further extend our protocol to handle uncorruption, where corrupt nodes return to honesty. This extension requires only a mild additional assumption on the unpredictability of VRF outputs for liveness.

</details>


### [307] [Skywing: A Platform for Decentralized Mathematical Computing in Unreliable Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03145)
*Alyson Fox,Colin Ponce,Annika Mauro,Wayne Mitchell,Sarah Osborn,Tom Benson,Shayna Kapadia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Skywing是一个开源平台，用于在不可靠通信网络中的异构设备间进行去中心化数学计算。它通过三种抽象（Agent、Processor、Iteration）将数学逻辑与通信/执行基础设施分离，支持异步操作、发布-订阅通信和复杂去中心化工作流组合，并通过共识、优化、数值线性代数等代表性算法验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘计算、自主系统和信息物理系统日益需要跨异构设备且通过不可靠网络连接的数学计算。传统高性能计算和分布式数据处理框架依赖集中协调、可靠通信和全局同步，不适用于无法假设这些条件的去中心化场景。

Method: 提出三种抽象：(1) Agent表示去中心化计算中的参与者；(2) Processor封装算法特定的更新规则；(3) Iteration管理分布式执行。平台支持异步操作、发布-订阅通信、托管消息处理，以及将独立算法组合为复杂的去中心化工作流。

Result: 在原生Skywing运行时上使用共识、优化和数值线性代数领域的代表性算法进行了演示，包括Push Sum和Max共识、组合的监控与控制工作流、延迟通信下的弹性Push Sum，以及恶意数据损坏下的弹性异步Jacobi。结果表明Skywing支持多样化的去中心化算法，同时将数学逻辑与通信及执行基础设施相分离。

Conclusion: Skywing既可作为去中心化应用的部署框架，也可作为开发弹性数学算法的研究平台。

Abstract: Emerging edge, autonomous, and cyber-physical systems increasingly require mathematical computation across heterogeneous devices connected by unreliable communication networks. Traditional high-performance computing and distributed data-processing frameworks provide powerful abstractions for managed environments but are less suited to decentralized settings where centralized coordination, reliable communication, and global synchronization cannot be assumed. This paper presents Skywing, an open-source platform for decentralized mathematical computing in unreliable environments. Its programming model consists of three abstractions: agents represent participants in a decentralized computation, processors encapsulate algorithm-specific update rules, and iterations manage distributed execution. Skywing supports asynchronous operation, publish-subscribe communication, managed message handling, and the composition of independent algorithms into complex decentralized workflows. We demonstrate Skywing using representative algorithms from consensus, optimization, and numerical linear algebra. Experiments on the native Skywing runtime include Push Sum and Max Consensus, a composed monitoring and control workflow, resilient Push Sum under delayed communication, and resilient asynchronous Jacobi under malevolent data corruption. These demonstrations show that Skywing supports diverse decentralized algorithms while separating mathematical logic from communication and execution infrastructure. Skywing serves as both a deployment framework for decentralized applications and a research platform for developing resilient mathematical algorithms.

</details>


### [308] [BASP: Communication-Efficient Batch-Aware Sequence Parallelism for LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03151)
*Bigyan Ghimire,Jon C. Calhoun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出BASP（Batch-Aware Sequence Parallelism），一种利用批次结构减少通信开销的序列并行方法。BASP根据微批次大小将GPU划分为不相交的序列并行组，缩小all-to-all通信组规模，从而局部化通信并提升训练效率。在NVIDIA A100集群上的实验结果（Llama和Qwen模型）显示，相比标准序列并行基线，端到端训练时间最多提升1.17-1.31倍，同时保持完全一致的模型精度和内存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理对LLM日益重要，但长序列训练面临巨大的内存和通信需求。现有序列并行方法都是batch-agnostic的，对所有批次大小应用统一的序列划分策略，导致通信效率低下。

Method: BASP通过利用批次结构来降低通信开销：根据微批次大小将GPU划分为多个不相交的序列并行组，从而缩小all-to-all通信的组规模，实现通信局部化，提升训练效率。

Result: 在NVIDIA A100集群上，基于Llama和Qwen模型的实验表明，相比标准序列并行基线，BASP将端到端训练时间提升了1.17-1.31倍，且不牺牲模型精度或增加内存使用。

Conclusion: BASP通过批感知的GPU分组策略有效降低了序列并行中的通信开销，在保持模型精度和内存占用不变的前提下显著提升了长序列LLM训练的效率。

Abstract: Long-context reasoning for large language models (LLMs) is becoming increasingly important, but training over long sequences remains challenging due to massive memory and communication requirements. Sequence parallelism has emerged as an essential technique for addressing bottlenecks in long sequence LLM training. However, we observe that existing sequence parallelism methods are batch-agnostic and apply uniform sequence partitioning across all batch sizes, resulting in inefficient communication. In this paper, we introduce Batch- Aware Sequence Parallelism (BASP), a sequence parallelism approach that leverages batch structure to reduce communication overhead. BASP exploits batch structure by partitioning GPUs into disjoint sequence-parallel groups according to the micro- batch size. This design reduces the all-to-all communication group size, thereby localizing communication and improving training efficiency. Experimental results on an NVIDIA A100 cluster show that BASP improves end-to-end training time by up to 1.17 - 1.31x in Llama and Qwen models compared to standard sequence parallel baselines, while preserving identical model accuracy and memory usage.

</details>


### [309] [Carbon-aware Resource Management for Latency-Sensitive Cloud Computing Environments: A Taxonomy and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03270)
*Tharindu B. Hewage,Shashikant Ilager,Maria Rodriguez Read,Rajkumar Buyya*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对延迟敏感型云计算环境中的碳感知资源管理最新文献进行了系统分类（taxonomy），通过分类体系分析现有工作的优化方面，识别研究空白并指出未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 延迟敏感型工作负载的激增促使云基础设施从通用计算平台演化为多样化的专用云环境，而云服务商为满足延迟约束不断扩展基础设施，导致碳足迹显著增长，威胁净零排放目标。由于延迟优化采用面向性能的刚性部署模式，降低其碳足迹极具挑战，亟需利用应用特定机会的高效技术。

Method: 提出了一个详细的分类体系（taxonomy），对延迟敏感型云计算环境中碳感知资源管理的近期文献进行分类，并利用该分类体系分析现有工作，从优化角度评估其方法。

Result: 基于提出的分类体系，系统分析了现有碳感知资源管理文献的优化方面，识别出当前研究中存在的空白，并提出了未来研究方向。

Conclusion: 延迟敏感型云环境下实现碳感知资源管理需要打破性能优先的刚性部署思维，通过分类分析和空白识别，为后续研究在延迟约束与碳减排之间寻求平衡提供了框架性指导。

Abstract: Proliferation of cloud-based latency-sensitive workloads requires infrastructures tuned to their workload-specific latency constraints. Today, they shape the cloud from a generalized computing platform to diverse workload-specific cloud environments. As the demand for latency-sensitive workloads increases, cloud service providers continue to scale their infrastructure, adversely increasing the carbon footprint and challenging climate-crisis-driven net-zero emission goals. Due to performance-oriented rigid deployment patterns of latency-optimizations, reducing its carbon footprint is challenging. Therefore, efficient techniques that exploit application specific opportunities are needed in that. To this end, we present a detailed taxonomy of recent literature on carbon-aware resource management in latency-sensitive cloud computing environments. Using the taxonomy, we analyze existing works discussing their optimization aspects, identify the gaps, and highlight future research directions.

</details>


### [310] [FlowTT: Exploiting Computation Flow Reuse in Irregular Tensor-Train Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03459)
*Jongmin Seok,Chae Eun Rhee*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FlowTT 是一个面向 GPU 的流感知执行框架，通过将 TT 嵌入查找重构为前缀共享的不规则计算流，结合前缀分组、融合执行、片上中间结果保留及持久线程调度等设计，在 Meta 推荐基准上将推理延迟最高降低 42.2%、训练延迟最高降低 49.2%，并实现最低的推理峰值内存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TT（Tensor-Train）分解虽能有效压缩推荐模型中的大型嵌入表，但基于 TT 的嵌入查找仍然低效：一方面，跨输入索引的部分共享计算未被充分利用；另一方面，顺序 TT-core 收缩之间的中间结果被反复物化到片外，造成大量不必要的全局内存储访问和计算冗余。

Method: FlowTT 将 TT gather 重构为一组前缀共享的不规则计算流，并采用三项核心协同设计：(1) 流对齐的前缀分组策略来组织输入索引；(2) 融合的 TT 嵌入执行路径，在片上保留中间结果，避免片外往返；(3) 基于 chunk 式工作窃取和 L2 checkpointing 的持久线程调度，以在偏斜工作负载下保持复用。该方法对任务形成、数据缓存和调度进行系统性联合优化。

Result: 在 Meta 合成推荐基准（Meta-240、Meta-480、Meta-788）上，FlowTT 相比现有方法始终达到最低延迟。在 batch size 为 32,768 时，相较于 EcoRec，推理延迟最高降低 42.2%，训练延迟最高降低 49.2%，同时达到最低的推理峰值内存使用量。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，暴露前缀共享的计算结构是提升 TT 嵌入执行效率的关键，FlowTT 通过将任务形成、数据缓冲和调度与 TT gather 的结构性对齐，有效减少了冗余 TT-core 操作、全局内存流量和负载不均衡问题。

Abstract: Tensor-Train (TT) decomposition effectively compresses large embedding tables in recommendation models, but TT-based embedding lookup remains inefficient because partially shared computation flows across input indices are not fully reused and intermediate results are repeatedly materialized off-chip between sequential TT-core contractions. We present FlowTT, a flow-aware GPU execution framework that reformulates TT gather as a set of prefix-shared irregular computation flows. FlowTT combines flow-aligned prefix-based index grouping, a fused TT-embedding execution path with on-chip intermediate retention, and persistent-thread scheduling with chunk-based work stealing and L2 checkpointing to preserve reuse under skewed workloads. By co-designing task formation, data buffering, and scheduling with the structure of TT gather, FlowTT reduces redundant TT-core operations, global-memory traffic, and load imbalance. On Meta's synthetic recommendation benchmarks (Meta-240, Meta-480, and Meta-788), FlowTT consistently achieves the lowest latency compared to existing methods. At batch size 32,768, it reduces latency by up to 42.2% in inference and 49.2% in training relative to EcoRec, while also achieving the lowest inference peak memory usage. These results show that exposing prefix-shared computation is key to efficient TT-based embedding execution.

</details>


### [311] [A Technique for Load Shifting Low-latency Applications in Multi-Region Renewables Harvesting via SMT Core Pooling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03297)
*Tharindu B. Hewage,Shashikant Ilager,Maria A. Rodriguez,Rajkumar Buyya*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种软硬件协同设计方案，通过在同一硬件上配置两组服务器池（一组启用SMT、一组关闭SMT）并利用CPU深度空闲状态进行负载匹配，使得低延迟应用能够在区域内保持静态逻辑核集，避免跨WAN的区域间负载迁移，从而在追求可再生能源的同时满足低延迟应用的性能要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨地理区域的负载迁移常用于降低云基础设施碳足迹，但广域网（WAN）的高延迟波动使得低延迟应用难以参与此类负载调度。现有方案通常将低延迟应用排除在负载迁移之外，导致其在可再生能源利用方面的碳减排潜力受限。

Method: 采用软硬件协同设计：硬件层面通过深度空闲物理核，在两个参数相同但一个启用SMT的服务器池间进行服务器负载与可再生能源峰谷的匹配，从而在能源动态变化中获得静态逻辑核集，降低工作负载迁移概率；软件层面在区域内高效追逐静态核集以服务低延迟应用，同时优先保障尽力而为应用以满足跨WAN的迁移需求。

Result: 在真实实验平台（基于OpenStack与CPU空闲状态实现，使用Azure VM到达轨迹评估）上，低延迟VM的卸载减少80%，p90端到端延迟的变异系数降低43.81%，最坏情况下因SMT核导致的延迟妥协为11.97%。

Conclusion: 通过软硬件协同设计，低延迟应用可以被纳入可再生能源驱动的跨区域负载调度框架中，在显著降低碳足迹的同时仅付出可接受的少量延迟代价，为兼顾延迟敏感应用与绿色云计算提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Load shifting across geographic regions to chase intermittent renewable energy availability is commonly used in reducing cloud infrastructure carbon footprint. However, it often omits low-latency applications due to high latency variances of wide area networks (WAN) that interconnect regions. This paper addresses accommodating low-latency applications into load shifting by minimizing their shifting across the WAN. We propose a technique using a hardware-software co-design approach. At the hardware level, we conduct server load matching over renewables supply peaks and valleys by deep idling physical cores in two otherwise identical server pools, with one enabling simultaneous multi-threading (SMT) in CPUs. In return, we achieve a static set of logical cores amidst energy supply dynamics, reducing the probability of workload shifting. At the software level, we efficiently chase the static set of cores for low-latency applications within regions while prioritizing best-effort applications to accommodate shifting requirements across WANs. Our approach exploits the lower performance compromise of SMT cores due to their hardware multi-threading. We implement the proposed technique with OpenStack and CPU idle states and evaluate its performance on a real experimental testbed with Azure VM arrival traces. Results show an 80% reduction in offloading low-latency VMs and a 43.81% reduction in coefficient of variation of p90 end-user latency while having a worst-case latency compromise of 11.97% due to SMT cores.

</details>


### [312] [Lantern: Finding Committable Transactions via Back-Propagation on DAGs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03315)
*Denglong Li,Gerui Wang,Tian Guan,Mingchao Wan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出Lantern，一种无需预先知道事务读写集的确定性并发控制协议。其核心思想是：本地依赖图中所有零出度事务顶点可以使用覆盖允许策略按升序安全提交。论文还引入Back-Propagation机制和Conflict-Free Batch Selection（CFBS）以提升性能，集成到区块链平台ChainMaker后，相比Aria最高获得4.2倍吞吐提升，并将ChainMaker执行层吞吐提升至少2.2倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有并发控制协议要么引入非确定性，导致主节点和副本节点之间产生串行执行-重放的依赖关系；要么依赖不切实际的先验知识（即预先知道事务的读写集）。这促使研究者寻求一种无需先验知识的确定性并发控制方案。

Method: 1) 核心洞察：本地依赖图中所有零出度事务顶点可用覆盖允许策略（overwrite-permissive）按升序安全提交；2) 提出Back-Propagation机制，从汇点（sink）到源点（source）顶点迭代传播依赖状态，识别更多可提交事务；3) 提出Conflict-Free Batch Selection（CFBS）以应对读-修改-写密集场景。

Result: 将Lantern集成到开源区块链平台ChainMaker中，在YCSB和SmallBank基准上的广泛评估显示：相比Aria最高获得4.2倍吞吐加速，并将ChainMaker执行层的吞吐量提升至少2.2倍。

Conclusion: Lantern提供了一种无需先验读-写集知识即可实现确定性并发控制的有效协议，兼顾高性能与确定性，适用于高吞吐事务处理系统（如区块链平台），在性能上显著优于现有方案。

Abstract: Existing concurrency control protocols either introduce nondeterminism, resulting in a serial execution-replay dependency between primary and replica nodes, or rely on impractical prior knowledge of transaction read-write sets. In this paper, we present Lantern, a deterministic concurrency control protocol tailored for high-performance transaction processing systems operating without prior knowledge. The key insight of Lantern is that all zero-out-degree transaction vertices in the local dependency graph can be safely committed in ascending order using an overwrite-permissive strategy. We further introduce a novel Back-Propagation mechanism that iteratively propagates dependency states from sink to source vertices to identify additional committable transactions. We also propose Conflict-Free Batch Selection (CFBS) for read-modify-write intensive scenarios. We integrate Lantern into the open-source blockchain platform ChainMaker. Extensive evaluations on YCSB and SmallBank benchmarks demonstrate that Lantern achieves up to a 4.2x throughput speedup over Aria and improves the throughput of ChainMaker's execution layer by at least 2.2x.

</details>


### [313] [Iapetus: Content-Aware Hierarchical Scheduling for Collaborative ViT Inference in LEO Satellite Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03318)
*Yan Chen,Yunxiang Zhang,Guanjun Jiang,Haiquan Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出Sys（内容感知的层次化调度器），用于卫星边缘计算中的协作推理场景，通过模型分割、令牌压缩和层卸载的联合规划，平衡时延、能耗与质量损失，在任务吞吐、时延和电池节省上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在卫星边缘计算中，协作推理通过模型分割将ViT的连续层组分配给不同节点以分摊计算负载，但中间激活数据量庞大，带来严重的传输开销；令牌压缩虽能降低下游计算和激活传输，但其质量影响高度依赖输入内容、模型深度和先前剪枝决策；同时层卸载需适应随时间变化的联系和电池条件。这些因素互相耦合，亟需一个综合考虑内容、拓扑和资源状态的自适应调度框架。

Method: Sys是一个内容感知的层次化调度器，包含两步：(1) 筛选星座级候选方案，保留有界的候选集；(2) 对每个候选通过质量预测与联合规划，细化为完整的令牌压缩与层卸载轨迹。其统一目标函数在每任务延迟、能耗和质量损失与累积工作负载及电池压力之间进行权衡。实现基于NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin硬件在环测试台，并用经验证的执行模型进行星座级轨迹回放。

Result: 在5任务/秒的负载下，Sys完成91.6%的释放任务，较最强基线MARATD3高出26.1个百分点；平均延迟和电池消耗分别降低53.0%和70.8%，同时满足质量目标。

Conclusion: Sys通过内容感知的联合调度（令牌压缩决策感知输入内容与模型深度、层卸载适应动态拓扑与电池状态），在任务完成率、延迟、能耗与质量之间取得了明显优于强基线的综合性能，验证了层次化候选筛选与细化策略在卫星协作推理中的有效性。

Abstract: Collaborative inference pools distributed resources to run compute-intensive Vision Transformers (ViTs) in satellite edge computing. Model partitioning enables such collaboration by assigning consecutive layer groups to different nodes, but the large volume of intermediate activation data incurs substantial transfer overhead that can erase its benefit. Token compression reduces downstream computation and activation transfer, but its quality impact depends on input content, model depth, and earlier pruning decisions, while layer offloading must adapt to time-varying contact and battery conditions. We present \sys, a content-aware hierarchical scheduler that screens constellation-wide options to retain a bounded candidate set, then refines each candidate into a complete token compression and layer offloading trajectory using quality prediction and joint planning. A unified objective balances per-task latency, energy, and quality loss against accumulated workload and battery pressures.
