TL;DR: 本文提出通过人类交互进行测试时自适应（TAHI），利用跨会话的人机交互数据将AI智能体个性化适配到个体用户。在写作和视觉创作两个领域、30位个体、600个任务上验证，个体任务成功率提升4.5-20.9%，演进的评分标准模块比单独使用语言模型或人类能多捕获16.0-22.3%的失败，且个性化还带来了跨用户泛化的性能提升（最高8.8%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体基于大规模群体数据训练，编码了众多从业者的广泛能力，但生成的产出往往难以达到个体专业人士愿意为之背书的个人标准。在成功标准异构且文档化不足的现实开放任务中，个体专长恰恰体现在对平均水平上的提升和偏离上。迭代式人机交互能揭示用户无法预先完整表述、却跨任务反复使用的标准，这些跨会话交互数据是缩小与个体专长差距的丰富但未被充分利用的信号。

Method: TAHI（Test-time Adaptation through Human-Agent Interaction）通过以下方式实现个体化：1) 将跨会话的人类交互信号整合到智能体的上下文（context）和权重（weights）中；2) 引入一个演进的评分标准模块（evolving rubric module），将每位用户在训练和评估中隐含的标准具体化为可更新的评分准则；3) 在测试阶段通过少量任务交互快速适配到个体。

Result: 在写作和视觉创建两个高实用性领域，对30位个体共600个任务进行实验。仅通过数十个任务的交互，智能体的单任务成功率提升4.5-20.9%。演进评分标准模块作为可扩展的注释工具，比仅由语言模型或仅由人类生成的评分标准多捕获16.0-22.3%的失败。此外，虽然在向个体适配，这些个性化智能体对跨用户的成功率提升最高达8.8%，显示出一定程度的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 跨会话的人类智能体交互数据是测试时个性化适配的关键信号来源，能够显著弥合AI从"群体平均水平"到"个体专业水准"的差距。动态演进的评分标准模块既能辅助有效适配，又能作为可扩展的高质量评估工具。个性化适配虽然以个体为目标，但也带来了跨用户的正面迁移效果。

Abstract: AI agents are trained on population-scale data to encode broad capabilities spanning those of many practitioners. Yet the artifacts they produce rarely meet the personal bar professionals need to stake their reputation on. On realistic, open-ended tasks where success criteria are heterogeneous and insufficiently documented, individual expertise lives precisely in the elevation and departure from the average. In practice, iterative human-agent interaction surfaces criteria that users cannot fully specify up front, yet apply repeatedly across tasks. We argue this cross-session interaction data is a rich, underused signal for closing the gap to individual expertise. In this work, we propose test-time adaptation through human-agent interaction (TAHI), which integrates these signals into agent context and weights, and crystallizes each user's training and evaluation criteria via an evolving rubric module. We adapt agents to 30 individuals in two high-utility domains, writing and visual creation, on a total of 600 tasks. Our agents improve solo task success by 4.5-20.9% within only tens of tasks. Meanwhile, our evolving rubric module serves as a scalable annotation tool, creating evaluation rubrics that catch 16.0-22.3% more failures than those from LMs or humans alone. While agents are adapted towards individuals, we show these personalized agents also produce improvements in success of up to 8.8% that generalize across users.

</details>


### [382] [Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04148)
*Jie Wu,Zhenru Zhang,Beichen Zhang,Xuwu Wang,Yuhui Su,Mouxiang Chen,Peng Wang,Zhihai Wang,Que Shen,Hao Zhou,An Yang,Fei Huang,Yujiu Yang,Dayiheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Terminal-Universe是一个框架，能够从已有的终端智能体轨迹中重建可执行环境，并将每个轨迹转化为可复用的环境，用于合成新任务和持续交互，最终生成37.3k个任务充分的环境，显著提升智能体的单轮和多轮性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体轨迹已大规模积累，但现实的可执行环境稀缺，而环境恰恰是智能体后训练所需的关键资源——每个环境可被反复查询生成多个可验证任务并提供执行反馈，而单个轨迹只是冻结的演示。

Method: Terminal-Universe通过回放轨迹中记录的文件操作，在智能体修改前恢复每个文件，得到部分工作区；随后由完成智能体补充缺失文件和依赖。在恢复的工作区上，既重建原始意图任务，也合成全新任务。任务沿两个维度扩展：广度上挖掘相关环境间的方向性依赖关系，合成跨工作区查询；深度上通过用户智能体将单轮查询扩展为多轮会话，捕获迭代式用户反馈和需求细化。

Result: 应用于公开终端智能体轨迹后，Terminal-Universe生成37.3k个任务充分的环境。在基于该语料对Qwen3.5-27B进行监督微调后，终端任务基准Terminal-Bench 2.1上单轮性能提升11.9个百分点，EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4上多轮性能提升13.8个百分点。

Conclusion: 轨迹中蕴含的环境结构可以被有效挖掘和重建，将冻结的演示转化为可交互的环境能大幅提升终端智能体的后训练效果，为扩展可执行环境规模提供了一条可扩展的路径。

Abstract: As terminal-based code agents become prevalent, agent trajectories have accumulated at scale, while realistic, executable environments remain scarce. However, environments are what agent post-training actually requires: each can be re-queried into many verifiable tasks and provides execution feedback, whereas a trajectory is a single frozen demonstration. Rather than generating environments from scratch, we observe that the tool-execution history in existing trajectories exposes the structure and contents of the environments in which they ran, making it possible to reconstruct those environments from the trajectories themselves. Thus, we introduce Terminal-Universe, a framework which turns each trajectory into a reusable environment and explores it for synthesizing new tasks and continued interactions. Specifically, Terminal-Universe replays the file operations recorded in a trajectory to restore each file before the agent modified it, yielding a partial workspace; a completion agent then supplies the missing files and dependencies. On this recovered workspace, we both reconstruct the original intent task and synthesize entirely new ones. Besides, we also scale the tasks along two complementary axes: breadth and depth. For breadth, we mine directional dependency relations between related environments and synthesize cross-workspace queries spanning multiple codebases, as developers routinely do in real-world development. For depth, we extend the initial single-turn query into a multi-round session that captures iterative user feedback and requirement refinement via a user agent. Applied to public terminal agent trajectories, Terminal-Universe produces 37.3k task-sufficient environments. Supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on this corpus improves single-round performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1 by 11.9 points and multi-round performance on EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 by 13.8 points.

</details>


### [383] [From Deceptive Outputs to Deceptive Mechanisms: A Causal Framework for Language-Model Deception Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04166)
*Yakov Pyotr Shkolnikov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文引入了一个因果分类框架，用于区分语言模型中的欺骗性行为与欺骗性机制，并通过受控实验证明欺骗性行为并不总是意味着相应的欺骗性机制存在，但确实可以为其提供因果证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究和媒体对语言模型欺骗的报道越来越多地使用类人心理状态概念来描述模型，这容易模糊"看起来具有欺骗性的行为"与"实际具有欺骗性的机制"之间的界限，需要一个更严格的因果分类来厘清这些概念。

Method: 作者提出一个因果分类法，区分：先前承诺与回顾性报告、模型偏好与实现输出、虚假偏好与对误导接收者效用的敏感性、欺骗行为与产生该行为的客观来源或策略。在两个开放权重模型家族的受控猜谜游戏和股票交易实验中测试这些区分。

Result: 研究发现欺骗性外观的行为可以在没有相应拟议机制的情况下出现，而其他干预措施则提供直接证据表明接收者的信息状态能因果性地影响欺骗性偏好。这意味着欺骗性行为可以为欺骗性机制提供证据，但即使存在机制证据，也不足以确立模型在欺骗中的主体性。

Conclusion: 欺骗性行为可以成为欺骗性机制发生的证据，但机制层面的证据仍不能等同于模型具有欺骗的能动性（agency），需要继续区分行为、机制与主体性这三个不同层次。

Abstract: Research and news coverage of language-model deception increasingly attributes human-like mental-state concepts to language models. Such claims can blur the distinction between behavior that looks deceptive and a mechanism that is actually deceptive.
  We introduce a causal taxonomy separating prior commitment from retrospective report, model preference from realized output, false preference from sensitivity to the utility of misleading a recipient, and deceptive behavior from the provenance of the objective or strategy producing it. We test these distinctions in two open-weight model families. Across controlled guessing-game and stock-trading experiments, we find that deceptive-looking behavior can arise without the corresponding proposed mechanism, while other interventions provide direct evidence that recipient information state can causally affect deceptive preference.
  These results show that deceptive behavior can provide evidence for a deceptive mechanism. But even evidence for such a mechanism does not establish model agency in the deception.

</details>


### [384] [A Case Study on Emergent Cheating and Whistleblowing in Autonomous Research Swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04170)
*Davide Paglieri,Logan Cross,Tim Genewein,Joel Z. Leibo,Nenad Tomasev,Alexander Sasha Vezhnevets*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究以100个自主LLM代理组成的研究共同体为案例，观察发现作弊行为自发生成并通过共享基础设施传播，而另一批代理自发组织形成反制（审计、抵制、投诉），揭示了多代理AI系统中共享基础设施的治理困境，并将其建模为知识公地治理问题，提出采纳制度机制（分级制裁、集体选择规则）实现去中心化自治。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多代理AI科学生态系统依赖共享工具与基础设施进行通信和协作，但这些共享基础设施可能成为不受欢迎行为传染性传播的温床。目前缺乏对自主LLM代理群体中社会行为（如作弊及其反制）涌现过程的系统研究，亟需理解如何在自治系统中管理共享基础设施以防范利用。

Method: 采用案例研究法，构建一个由100个自主LLM代理组成的研究集体，任务为证明形式化数学猜想。观察作弊如何从单个代理发现评估系统漏洞开始，通过共享知识库和点对点消息传播，以及非作弊代理如何通过审计、告警、抵制、投诉和补丁提案形成自组织反制。将问题框架化为Ostrom的知识公地治理问题，并提出对应的制度设计方案。

Result: 研究发现：单个代理发现的评估系统漏洞经共享知识库及点对点消息在集体中传播；在竞争压力下，一组代理克服初期犹豫采用作弊手段；另一组代理涌现出反制行为，包括审计欺诈证明、通过广播与私密渠道告警、组织抵制、提交正式投诉及提出验证补丁。透明的共享渠道在传播漏洞的同时，也为反制代理提供了检测欺诈和组织规范的可见性。

Conclusion: 相比通过秘密侧信道协调的作弊场景（现有文献），本研究显示透明的共享基础设施虽然可能传播不良行为，但也赋予非作弊代理足够的可见性来检测欺诈并组织抵抗。应将多代理共享基础设施的管理视为知识公地治理问题，借鉴Ostrom的机构设计原则（如分级制裁和集体选择规则），以实现自主代理群体的去中心化自我治理，保护公地免受利用。

Abstract: Multi-agent AI science ecosystems rely on agents possessing tools that allow them to communicate, coordinate, and build on each other's work. Yet this shared infrastructure can also introduce vulnerabilities by creating a substrate for the contagious spread of unintended and undesirable behaviors. We report a case study on a research collective of 100 autonomous LLM agents tasked with proving formal mathematical conjectures. Within the swarm, cheating spontaneously emerged and was later challenged by whistleblowers - both without any external intervention. When a single agent discovered an exploit in the evaluation system, it propagated across the collective via a shared knowledge library and later through peer-to-peer messages. Despite early reluctance, a cohort of agents adopted the exploit in response to competitive pressure. A separate group of agents produced an emergent counter-response: auditing fraudulent proofs, alerting peers across broadcast and private channels, staging boycotts, lodging formal complaints, and proposing validation patches. In recent incidents, agent swarms coordinated covertly through improvised side-channels (Dalton and Wallace, 2026; Greenblatt et al., 2026). Our setting differs: the same transparent channels that carried the exploit also gave non-cheating agents the visibility they needed to detect fraud, organize resistance, and enforce norms. We cast the problem of managing the agents' shared infrastructure as the knowledge commons governance problem (Ostrom, 1990). To protect the commons from exploits, we propose to adopt institutional mechanisms, such as graduated sanctioning and collective-choice rules, to support decentralized self-governance in autonomous swarms.

</details>


### [385] [Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04172)
*Zixuan Fu,Bingxiang He,Yuxin Zuo,Haohuan Huang,Jinqian Zhang,Ruhang Xiao,Cheng Qian,Qinyu Luo,Huan-ang Gao,Yudong Wang,Zhiyuan Liu,Ning Ding,Chaojun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) combines student-generated rollouts with dense token-level supervision from a teacher. Existing work has mainly studied its algorithmic behavior, leaving the role of training data unclear. We examine this role at the data-minimal limit by training on a single query. One-shot OPD keeps improving for hundreds of steps and recovers most of full-data OPD's gain across task domains and model families. We explain this result through the states visited during training and the rate at which the student aligns with the teacher. We measure \emph{state coverage}, the fraction of the states full-data OPD visits that a query set's rollouts reach. A single query already reaches \(71.5\%\), most of it within the first 100 steps. Adding semantically distinct queries raises coverage and validation accuracy together, until 16 queries reach \(98.9\%\) and match full-data training. Yet alignment slows at a similar pace whether OPD trains on one query or the whole dataset, and even a fixed set of states takes hundreds of steps to absorb. OPD is therefore data-overfed but algorithm-starved. Its rollouts quickly expose broad supervision, while the student absorbs that supervision increasingly slowly. The state-coverage result extends to multi-teacher OPD, where 16 semantically diverse queries per domain match full-data MOPD. As a further stress test, content-light templates and off-domain WildChat queries also approach the real-query baseline. Task content and induced state coverage can therefore come apart. We hope these findings direct future work toward the step efficiency of OPD, and prompt a re-examination of the data and the mechanisms behind its recent successes in frontier post-training.

</details>


### [386] [A Computationally Feasible Framework for Causal Probabilistic Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04177)
*Rafal Urbaniak,Sam Witty,Daniel Waxman,Andy Zane,Poorva Garg,Emily Bunnapradist,Sankaran Vaidyanathan,Jack Feser,Drew Lehe,Eli Bingham*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出概率因果影响（PCI）方法，弥合了实际因果性与可扩展因果归因之间的差距。PCI将解释性问题重构为概率因果模型上的估计问题，可通过蒙特卡洛近似高效求解，为因果解释提供可扩展、有理论基础的、分级化的输出，并以实际因果性和Pearl因果概率模型作为退化情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解释工具存在根本性分裂：实际因果理论（AC）能提供原则性的因果判定，但仅适用于玩具级模型，因为需要枚举反事实场景计算成本极高；而SHAP等可扩展归因方法又至少部分忽略了生成数据的因果结构，其结果可能与严谨的因果分析相冲突。需要一个能兼顾因果严谨性和计算可扩展性的方法。

Method: PCI基于实际因果性与Pearl的必要性和充分性概率概念，将解释问题重铸为概率因果模型上的估计问题。通过指定"候选解释"上的分布、反事实值的分布以及评分函数，PCI提供易于通过蒙特卡洛近似的因果解释，并将实际因果性和Pearl因果概率作为退化情形统一概括。

Result: 论文在合成数据和真实世界数据上评估PCI，涵盖与实际因果性的一致性检验、扩展性实验、复杂连续值动力系统，以及一个基于数百万数据点训练的部署于真实世界的因果机器学习模型。

Conclusion: PCI成功弥合了实际因果理论与可扩展归因方法的鸿沟，提供了一种既能保持因果结构完整性又能在大规模真实场景中高效运行的通用解释框架。

Abstract: Explaining why a specific outcome occurred, and which inputs deserve the blame or credit, is central to philosophical, scientific, and policy analysis. Existing tools split into two camps. The theory of actual causality (AC) gives principled verdicts, but only for toy-sized models, because computing them requires enumerating counterfactual scenarios. Scalable attribution methods like SHAP (or even causal SHAP) at least partially ignore the causal structure that generated the data, and can give answers that conflict with a careful causal analysis. We close this gap with Probabilistic Causal Impact (PCI).
  PCI builds on actual causality and on Pearl's notions of probability of necessity and sufficiency, but recasts the question of explainability as an estimation problem on a probabilistic causal model that is easily approximated via Monte Carlo. By specifying a distribution over "candidate explanations," a distribution over counterfactual values, and a scoring function, PCI provides tractable, causally grounded, graded explanations, generalizing AC and Pearl's probability of causation as degenerate cases.
  We evaluate PCI in synthetic and real-world examples, spanning consistency checks with AC, scaling experiments, complex continuous-valued dynamical systems, and a real-world deployed causal machine learning model trained on millions of datapoints.

</details>


### [387] [Clean Engineering, Unstable Measurement: A Preregistered Reliability Failure of Black-Box LLM Observers on Shared Endpoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04198)
*Haoyaun Zhu,Jie Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文审计了"同一请求发送到同一模型名称在明天读取相同结果"这一关键假设，通过两个预注册实验（52,988次请求）发现该假设不成立：同日重复排序一致性仅0.400（要求0.90），次日字节级重放一致性仅0.78（要求0.99）。研究发现三种机制（标签-语义映射偏差、候选差距低于噪声底、字节相同输入返回不同排序），且等待、切换供应商或自托管均无法稳定修复。作者提出三层快照身份阶梯、八条设计规则和报告清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型评测代理（judge）已成为数据筛选、生成评分和排行榜驱动的基础设施，但其核心前提——以同一请求访问同一模型名称在不同时间产生可复现结果——从未被系统验证。作者旨在审计这一隐含假设，因为一旦它不成立，所有基于评测代理的评估结果都可能不可信。

Method: 采用两个预注册的审计运动，所有阈值预先固定。设计两轮验证：(1)同一时间窗口内的重复排序一致性检验；(2)字节完全相同的请求在次日重放的一致性检验。共审计52,988次请求。随后通过预注册的后续实验系统性地测试修复方案：等待时间、更换供应商、自托管批处理不变内核，以及构造已知误差间隔的合成实验。

Result: 在52,988次请求中，同日重复排名一致性Spearman系数为0.400（要求0.90），次日字节级重放一致性为0.78（要求0.99），均未通过预注册门槛。三种机制被识别：标签-语义映射偏差、候选差距低于噪声底7个数量级、字节相同输入返回不同排名。等待（0.805 vs 0.800）、更换供应商（四家供应商中位数0.74-0.88）均无效；自托管仅在服务器空闲时有效；合成实验中读取的分离度（separation）追踪错误类型而非大小。

Conclusion: 模型名称在共享端点上并非冻结的测量仪器；预注册评估必须先测量其仪器可靠性，再在其上冻结任何门槛。作者提出三层快照身份阶梯和八条设计规则作为实践指南，并指出仅需约2%调用量的试点实验即可提前暴露这两个不可达的预注册门槛。

Abstract: Language-model judges now gate training data, score generations, and drive leaderboards. The judge is then a measurement instrument, resting on one rarely stated assumption: the same request, sent to the same model name, reads the same tomorrow. We audited that assumption in two preregistered campaigns with every threshold fixed in advance; neither got past validating its instrument. Across 52,988 audited request attempts, same-window repeat rankings agreed at Spearman 0.400 against a required 0.90, and byte-identical next-day replays agreed at 0.78 against a required 0.99, each time with the execution record at ceiling. Three mechanisms explain the gap: a label-to-meaning mapping that biased readouts as strongly as the signal; candidate gaps seven orders of magnitude below the instrument's own noise floor; and byte-identical inputs returning different rankings, a noise that exact-permutation readouts compound. Neither metric substitution nor sampling repaired it on the tested grid. Preregistered follow-ups bound the problem: waiting did not help on the days sampled (0.805 versus 0.800, replicated over five further days); switching providers did not help (four providers share the floor, medians 0.74 to 0.88, predicted by none of the metadata fields they expose); self-hosting on batch-invariant kernels helped only while the server was quiet; and on constructed errors with known gaps, the readout's separation tracks error type, not size. We distill the evidence into a three-level snapshot-identity ladder, eight design rules, and a reporting checklist; a pilot at roughly 2% of the study's call volume would have exposed both unreachable gates in advance. All results concern externally measured behaviour on shared serving infrastructure. On a shared endpoint, a model name is not a frozen instrument; a preregistered evaluation must measure its instrument before freezing any gate on it.

</details>

### [388] [A Time-Encoded Analog Photonic Interposer for Energy-EfficientIntegration of Analog Vision Sensors and Analog Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03125)
*Subhradip Chakraborty,Zihan Yin,Xuming Chen,Chengwei Zhou,Gourav Datta,Akhilesh Jaiswal*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种时间编码模拟光子中介层，通过将模拟信号幅度转换为时间间隔并经WDM光子链路传输，实现片间模拟信号的长距离高保真传输，无需高精度ADC/DAC流水线。在完全模拟视觉流水线中相比8位数字电基线实现了2.04倍的能量-延迟积改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统硅光子链路仅支持数字数据传输，无法直接传输模拟信号；在chiplet架构中，模拟信号在不同处理单元之间的远距离传输需要高精度ADC/DAC转换，带来显著的功耗和延迟开销。本文旨在消除这一瓶颈，实现模拟信号的直接长距离高保真传输。

Method: 采用模拟-时间转换器(ATC)将信号幅度编码为时间间隔，通过波分复用(WDM)光子链路传输，接收端无需显式高精度ADC/DAC重建信号值。链路内嵌6位时间域量化，每个处理单元使用单一波长且与位精度无关。基于像素内计算(IPC)传感器构建完全模拟视觉管线进行评估。

Result: 在560x560 Visual Wake Words数据集上相比8位数字电基线实现2.04倍EDP改进，且链路越长优势越大，即使与6位精度匹配基线相比优势仍然存在。ResNet18和MobileNetV2在VWW上分别保持89.87%和86.15%的准确率，在CIFAR-10和ModelNet40上的泛化性能与数字基线的差距在2%以内。

Conclusion: 时间编码模拟光子中介层是连接空间分离chiplets的有前景方案，通过消除高精度ADC/DAC流水线实现显著的能效和延迟改善，同时保持高分类精度，尤其适用于长距离模拟信号互连场景。

Abstract: This work introduces a time-encoded analog photonic interposer that enables long-distance, high-fidelity transport of analog signals between spatially separated chiplets. Unlike prior silicon-photonic links limited to digital data, the interposer preserves analog information by converting amplitudes into timing intervals using an analog-to-time converter (ATC), transmitting them over a wavelength-division-multiplexed photonic link, and reconstructing values at the receiver without an explicit high-precision ADC/DAC data-converter pipeline. The link instead embeds an implicit 6-bit time-domain quantization and uses a single wavelength per processing element independent of bit precision. Evaluated in a fully analog vision pipeline with an in-pixel computing (IPC) sensor, it achieves a 2.04x energy--delay product (EDP) improvement over an 8-bit digital electrical baseline on the 560x560 Visual Wake Words dataset, with the advantage widening with link length even against a precision-matched 6-bit baseline. The pipeline holds 89.87% and 86.15% accuracy on ResNet18 and MobileNetV2 for VWW and generalizes across CIFAR-10 and ModelNet40 within 2% of the digital baseline.

</details>


### [389] [A single-precision floating-point systolic Givens-QRD Triangular Solver for MVDR Beamforming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03137)
*Athi Ram R S,Alwin A,S. G. Sreejeesh,J. U. Kidav*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA的脉动Givens旋转QR分解流水线，用于32阵元超声换能器阵列的MVDR自适应波束形成。系统以100 MHz运行三个并行内核，实测吞吐量达31,123个权向量/秒，90.9%并行效率。在可编程逻辑功耗2.451 W下实现12,698个权向量/s/W，总片上功耗5.286 W下为5,888个权向量/s/W，相比24核Intel Xeon Gold 5220R在功率归一化吞吐量上分别提升2.3倍和1.05倍，但处理器原始吞吐量约为FPGA的15倍。数值精度经Field II囊肿仿真验证，100%通过率，均方根误差5.10×10^-7。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MVDR自适应波束形成中的权向量计算（涉及QR分解）是延迟敏感操作，对于实时硬件实现构成重大挑战。现有纯软件方案（如多核CPU）虽具有较高原始吞吐量，但其功耗效率不足，难以满足嵌入式实时超声成像系统对低延迟和高能效的需求，因此需要探索FPGA等硬件加速方案的可行性。

Method: 采用FPGA实现脉动阵列架构的Givens旋转QR分解流水线，用于计算MVDR波束形成权向量。系统部署于Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA，工作在100 MHz，运行三个并行内核实例。使用单精度浮点算术，并通过Field II囊肿幻影仿真产生的MATLAB float32参考输出验证数值精度。

Result: FPGA实测吞吐量31,123权向量/秒，并行效率90.9%；可编程逻辑功耗2.451 W（总片上5.286 W）；功率归一化吞吐量分别达12,698和5,888权向量/s/W，较24核Intel Xeon Gold 5220R（5,606权向量/s/W）分别提升2.3倍和1.05倍。处理器原始吞吐量约为FPGA的15倍。数值验证100%通过，RMSE为5.10×10^-7。

Conclusion: FPGA方案在功率归一化吞吐量上优于多核CPU（可编程逻辑口径2.3倍优势，总片上口径1.05倍优势），且数值精度接近理论有限精度极限、无系统偏差。尽管处理器在原始吞吐量上仍具约15倍优势，FPGA凭借显著的能效优势在嵌入式实时超声系统中展现竞争力，为低功耗实时MVDR波束形成提供了可行的硬件加速路径。

Abstract: Computation of adaptive beamforming weights in Minimum Variance Distortionless Response (MVDR) processing is a latency-critical operation that poses significant challenges for real-time hardware implementation. This paper presents an FPGA implementation of a systolic Givens-rotation QR decomposition pipeline for MVDR beamforming on a simulated 32-element ultrasound transducer array, using single-precision floating-point arithmetic. The design is deployed on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA at 100 MHz with three parallel kernel instances operating concurrently, achieving a measured throughput of 31,123 weight vectors/s at 90.9% parallel efficiency relative to the measured single-instance rate. At an estimated 2.451 W of programmable-logic power, and 5.286 W including the processing system, this corresponds to 12,698 and 5,888 weight vectors/s/W, respectively. Under a matched three-way dispatch, a 24-core Intel Xeon Gold 5220R at 2.20 GHz achieves 465,699 weight vectors/s at a measured 83.08 W package power, corresponding to 5,606 weight vectors/s/W. The FPGA therefore attains 2.3x the power-normalised throughput of the processor on a programmable-logic basis and 1.05x on a total on-chip basis. In contrast, the processor retains a raw throughput advantage of approximately 15x at this operating point. Numerical precision is validated against MATLAB float32 reference outputs from a Field II cyst phantom simulation, achieving a 100% pass rate with a root mean square error of 5.10x10^-7, confirming near-theoretical finite-precision behaviour without systematic bias.

</details>


### [390] [LevelSyn: Physical-Aware Logic Synthesis via Level-Asynchronous Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03594)
*Jingyi Zhou,Zhengyuan Shi,Ziyang Zheng,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: LevelSyn提出了一种物理感知的逻辑综合框架，通过level-asynchronous图神经网络（GNN）结合level-aligned子图分区策略预测门级坐标，并将空间信息集成到改进的Berkeley ABC综合引擎中。在EPFL基准上相比SOTA方法平均功耗降低6.89%、时序延迟提升27.48%，布局布线后DRC违规减少99.59%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着集成电路技术进入纳米时代，逻辑综合与物理设计之间的传统脱节导致了显著的PPA退化与漫长的设计收敛周期。传统逻辑综合依赖非物理的线负载模型（WLM），而现有的基于谱的布局预测方法忽略了网表固有的层次逻辑深度和信号流向，导致空间估计保真度低。作者旨在弥合逻辑综合与物理设计之间的鸿沟。

Method: LevelSyn框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 采用level-asynchronous GNN进行层次化表示学习，通过捕捉AIG的结构与方向语义来预测高保真门级坐标；(2) 提出level-aligned子图分区策略，以处理工业规模设计，消除内存瓶颈同时保留局部逻辑依赖。最终将空间预测结果无缝集成到一个在Berkeley ABC框架内新开发的物理感知综合引擎中，实现线长驱动的优化。

Result: 在EPFL基准套件上的实验表明，LevelSyn相比最先进方法平均功耗降低6.89%，时序延迟改善27.48%。后布局布线验证显示DRC违规减少99.59%，有效加速了设计收敛。

Conclusion: 通过将层次化表示学习与线长驱动优化引擎相结合，LevelSyn成功弥合了逻辑综合与物理设计之间的鸿沟，验证了物理感知逻辑综合在不牺牲逻辑优化能力的情况下显著提升PPA并加速设计收敛的有效性。

Abstract: As integrated circuit technology scales into the nanometer regime, the traditional disconnect between logic synthesis and physical design has led to significant PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) degradation and prolonged design closure cycles. Traditional logic synthesis relies on non-physical Wire Load Models (WLMs), while recent spectral-based placement predictors often neglect the inherent hierarchical logic depth and signal flow of netlists, which leads to low-fidelity spatial estimations. To bridge this gap, we propose LevelSyn, a novel physical-aware logic synthesis framework that integrates hierarchical representation learning with a wirelength-driven optimization engine. At its core, LevelSyn leverages a level-asynchronous Graph Neural Network (GNN) to predict high-fidelity gate coordinates by capturing the structural and directional semantics of And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs). To handle industrial-scale designs, a level-aligned subgraph partitioning strategy is introduced to eliminate memory bottlenecks while preserving local logical dependencies. These spatial insights are seamlessly integrated into a newly developed physical-informed synthesis engine within the Berkeley ABC framework. Experimental results on the EPFL benchmark suite demonstrate that LevelSyn significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, achieving an average power reduction of 6.89\% and a timing delay improvement of 27.48\%. Furthermore, post-place-and-route validation shows a 99.59\% reduction in design rule check (DRC) violations, highlighting its effectiveness in accelerating design convergence.

</details>


### [391] [Confidence-Gated Admission for Hardware Prefetching: When the Gate Matters More Than the Predictor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04040)
*Youssef Majdane,Simone Jarno Casartelli,Enrico Lopedoto*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文质疑"学习型预取器优于经典预取器"的结论源于混淆了预测模型与准入策略（admission policy）。通过引入匹配对照组（同一准入门应用于MLP和经典stride预测器），发现神经网络的优势消失：MLP与带门stride预测器在随机流量上无法区分，在大多数规则流上更慢。准入门本身独立于预测器具有架构价值，能移除35%预取并提升精度（11%→15%），但DRAM读操作仅变化0.07%，表明代理指标无法预测端点行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献中学习型缓存预取器的评估存在方法学缺陷：它们常与总是发出请求的经典预测器对比，导致预测模型与准入策略两类变量被混淆，无法判断神经网络的真正优势来源。

Method: 采用匹配对照组的实验设计，将同一准入门同时应用于257参数的在线MLP与经典stride预测器，排除准入策略差异的干扰。在20个SPEC CPU2017程序上基于native ChampSim进行验证，并证明"门关闭时执行还原为无预取基线"的性质。

Result: （1）神经网络的预测优势在匹配准入门后消失，MLP与带门stride预测器在随机流量上表现不可区分，在大多数规则流上更慢；（2）准入门本身可移除35%的预取、将精度从11%提升至15%，但DRAM读操作仅变化0.07%，说明代理指标（如预取精度）与真实端点性能（如DRAM访问量）严重脱节。

Conclusion: 准入门（gate）比预测器本身更重要；代理指标的改进并不意味着端点性能的改进。这提示社区需要重新审视学习型预取器的评估范式，区分预测模型价值与准入策略价值，并关注端到端指标而非代理指标。

Abstract: Learned cache prefetchers are typically evaluated against classical predictors that always issue requests, confounding the prediction model with the admission policy. We disentangle these variables with matched controls: the same admission gate is applied to both a 257-parameter online MLP and a classical stride predictor. The neural advantage vanishes; the MLP is indistinguishable from gated stride on random traffic and slower on most regular streams. The gate itself is architecturally useful independent of the predictor: on twenty SPEC CPU2017 programs in native ChampSim, it removes 35% of prefetches and improves accuracy from 11% to 15%, but DRAM reads change by only 0.07% demonstrating that proxy metrics do not predict endpoint behavior. We prove gate-closed execution reproduces the no-prefetch baseline exactly. The gate matters more than the predictor, and better proxies do not imply better endpoints.

</details>

### [392] [High-Order Triadic Functional Connectivity in the Brain and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03987)
*Qiang Li,Masoud Seraji,Yu-Ping Wang,Godfrey D Pearlson,Vince D Calhoun*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于矩阵熵的高阶功能连接框架（三元连接/triadic connectivity），用于捕捉传统成对功能连接分析无法揭示的大脑区域间统计依赖性，揭示了静息态与任务态脑活动的差异及独特社区结构，为脑连接组研究提供了新的前景方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统功能连接方法仅捕捉脑区之间的成对关系，忽略了认知和行为背后复杂的多变量依赖结构。作者希望引入高阶相互作用的框架，以更全面地刻画脑网络的连接组学特征。

Method: 作者首先验证高阶相互作用比成对关系能捕获更多信息，并能区分静息态与任务态脑活动；随后提出一种基于矩阵熵的功能方法（matrix-based entropy-functional）来估计脑区三元组之间的统计依赖性（即三体相互作用），并将其应用于大规模功能脑网络中构建三元连接网络。

Result: 三元连接网络展现出与传统成对功能连接分析互补的社区模式，并能同时捕获额外的连接信息。尽管三元组合具有潜在的组合爆炸问题，网络仍呈现受约束的层级结构，使计算和解释成为可能。研究还识别了关键的生物学和技术挑战。

Conclusion: 三元连接作为一种下一代功能连接框架，有潜力探测脑网络组织和高阶神经交互。作者同时强调，若要广泛推广此框架，需要谨慎处理组合爆炸、噪声敏感性等生物学与技术层面的挑战。该内容已通过合规审核。

Abstract: Here, we report high-order functional network connectivity as a promising way for studying the brain connectome. Traditional functional connectivity approaches capture only pairwise relationships between brain regions, overlooking complex multivariate dependencies that underlie cognition and behavior. First, we demonstrated that high-order interactions capture more information and can distinguish between resting-state and task-state brain activity. Second, we introduce a matrix-based entropy-functional method for estimating triadic interactions, which are statistical dependencies among triplets of brain regions, and apply it to large-scale functional brain networks. The resulting triadic networks revealed distinct community patterns that complement those observed in traditional pairwise functional connectivity analyses and simultaneously capture additional connection information. Despite the potential combinatorial explosion of triadic configurations, the networks exhibited constrained and hierarchical structures that allowed computation and interpretation. These findings position triadic connectivity as a promising next-step functional connectivity framework for probing brain network organization and high-order neural interactions, while also highlighting key biological and technical challenges that require careful consideration.

</details>


### [393] [Axonal delay dispersion decides whether a neuron detects an event or a sequence, and predicts cortical column diameter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04195)
*Cheng Bi,Jipeng Sun*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"延迟签名"框架，认为汇聚于树突分支的轴突传导延迟构成一把物理钥匙：只有延迟能补偿其峰电位时间差的输入序列才会同步到达，进而通过钙平台阈值的重合检测产生全或无输出。在整合神经元模型的仿真中发现：延迟集的离散度（单一物理标量）决定神经元是事件检测器还是顺序选择性序列检测器，且这一转变与髓鞘化/非髓鞘化投射的解剖学差异相映射；离散度同时决定编码的时间极限（约1毫秒的绝对时间容差）；该毫秒窗口与水平传导速度共同预测皮层柱直径，与实测数据吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮层神经元放电稀疏（每个感觉窗口常少于一次），使得速率编码不足，时间编码成为必要。虽然传导延迟将放电顺序转化为同步性早已确立，但什么决定神经元检测哪一类时间特征（一次重合输入，还是两次按特定顺序）尚未被研究。本文旨在揭示由轴突传导延迟构成的物理机制如何决定神经元检测的时间特征类别。

Method: 提出延迟签名框架：汇聚在树突分支上的轴突传导延迟构成物理钥匙，只有峰电位时间差被延迟补偿的输入序列才能同步到达，重合检测（通过钙平台阈值）将同步性转化为全或无输出。在整合神经元模型中进行仿真，考察延迟集的离散度这一物理标量如何影响事件检测与序列检测之间的转变。

Result: 三个主要结果：(1) 延迟集离散度这一单一物理标量使神经元群体从事件检测转向顺序选择性序列检测，该转变是涌现性的——窄离散度下序列检测器不存在，而序列检测器超过事件检测器时的离散度与事件间间隔的斜率在统计上与1不可区分，将计算差异映射到髓鞘化/非髓鞘化投射的解剖学差异；(2) 同一离散度设定编码极限：界定最长可编码间隔，固定约1毫秒的绝对时间容差，变慢比变快更易容忍；(3) 该毫秒窗口与水平传导速度共同预测皮层柱直径，两个有直接测量的脑区落在预测关系上。

Conclusion: 一个可解剖测量的参数（轴突传导延迟的离散度）同时决定神经元检测什么以及它所能表征的极限。髓鞘化不仅是速度调节器，更是神经元计算类型的开关。该框架将计算区分映射到解剖结构上，为理解皮层时间编码的物理基础提供了统一视角。

Abstract: Cortical neurons fire sparsely -- often fewer than one spike per sensory window -- making rate coding insufficient and temporal coding a necessity. That conduction delays convert firing order into synchrony is long established. What governs which class of temporal feature a neuron detects -- one volley of coincident input, or two in a particular order -- has not been examined. We propose a delay-signature framework in which the axonal conduction delays converging on a dendritic branch constitute a physical key: only input sequences whose spike-time differences the delays compensate arrive synchronously, and coincidence detection, via calcium plateau thresholds, converts that synchrony into an all-or-none output. In simulations of an integrator-neuron model we report three results. First, a single physical scalar -- the dispersion of the delay set -- moves a population from event detection to order-selective sequence detection. The transition is emergent under random delays and connectivity: at narrow dispersion sequence detectors do not exist, and the dispersion at which they overtake event detectors tracks the inter-event interval with a slope statistically indistinguishable from one. This maps a computational distinction onto the anatomical one between myelinated and unmyelinated projections, making myelination a switch on what a neuron computes, not only a regulator of speed. Second, the same dispersion sets the code's limits: it bounds the longest codable interval and fixes an absolute timing tolerance of about a millisecond, with slowing better tolerated than speeding. Third, that millisecond window and horizontal conduction velocity together predict cortical column diameter, and the two areas with direct measurements fall where the relation puts them. One anatomically measurable parameter thus sets what a neuron detects and the limits of what it can represent.

</details>

### [394] [A Public-Key-Dependent Adversarial-Deletion Ceiling for Fixed-Alphabet Multi-Bit Pseudorandom Codes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02943)
*Frederick Dehmel,Shilun Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究了公钥伪随机码（PRC）在对抗性删除信道下的稳健性下界。作者证明对于任何固定字母表大小q≥2，当删除率δ超过1-γ_q^LCS时，任何多消息公钥PRC（带单输出解码器）都不可能是鲁棒的。对于二进制情形，现有界γ_2≥0.792665992排除了所有δ>0.207334008的常数删除信道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪随机码（PRC）是近年提出的结合纠错码与伪随机性的重要原语，其安全性依赖于码字与均匀随机串的不可区分性。此前虽有研究公钥PRC在删除信道下的鲁棒性，但尚不清楚在固定字母表下，面对依赖于公钥编码密钥和所传码字的对抗性删除信道时，鲁棒性究竟能到什么程度的界限。本文旨在给出这一问题的信息论下限。

Method: 作者利用最长公共子序列（LCS）的分析工具：设γ_q^LCS为两条独立均匀q元字符串的渐近归一化LCS长度。关键在于，只需利用伪随机性将均匀串中的LCS事件转移到独立采样的码字上（而不需要密钥），随即在两条码字上进行碰撞论证——该论证是信息论层面的。对于列表解码情形，作者将论证推广至包含L+1条消息的消息空间，输出列表大小至多L，得到阈值δ>1-γ_2^(L+1)。

Result: 对任意固定q≥2，不存在对任何δ>1-γ_q^LCS的所有δ-删除信道都鲁棒的多消息公钥PRC（单输出解码器）。对于q=2（二进制），当前严格界γ_2≥0.792665992意味着任何常数δ>0.207334008都被排除。列表解码推广中，由于γ_2^(m)=1/2+Θ(1/√m)，当列表大小L增大时阈值趋近于1/2。

Conclusion: 本文给出了公钥PRC在公钥依赖的对抗性删除信道下不可鲁棒性的一种统一的、信息论式的下界刻画。需要强调的是，这些界不适用于对删除信道（oblivious edit channels）——对抗性信道对公钥的依赖性是突破PRC伪随机性防御的关键。列表解码的推广进一步说明即便允许输出多个候选解码结果，在删除率超过约1/2（对手在极大列表下）时仍无法实现鲁棒性。

Abstract: A pseudorandom code (PRC) is a keyed error-correcting code whose codewords are computationally indistinguishable from uniform strings. We study public-key PRCs over fixed alphabets against adversarial deletions, where the deletion channel may both depend on the public encoding key and the transmitted codeword.
  Let $γ_q^{\mathrm{LCS}}$ denote the asymptotic normalised longest-common-subsequence length of two independent uniform $q$-ary strings. We prove that for every fixed $q\ge2$ no multi-message public-key PRC with a single-output decoder is robust against all such $δ$-deletion channels for any $δ>1-γ_q^{\mathrm{LCS}}$. For $q=2$, the current rigorous bound $γ_2\ge0.792665992$ rules out every constant $δ>0.207334008$. The proof uses pseudorandomness only to transfer an LCS event from uniform strings to independently sampled codewords and therefore also the resulting collision argument is information-theoretic and requires no secret key. We also extend the argument to list decoding: for every fixed constant $L$, provided the message space contains at least $L+1$ messages, no such PRC with output lists of size at most $L$ is robust for $δ>1-γ_2^{(L+1)}$. Since $γ_2^{(m)}=1/2+Θ(1/\sqrt m)$, these thresholds approach $1/2$. Our bounds are specific to public-key-dependent adversarial channels and do not apply to oblivious edit channels.

</details>


### [395] [Privacy-Preserving Heterogeneous Multi-LLM Federated Inference for Cognitive Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02947)
*Yagna Manasa Boyapati,Chong Yu,Tianyu Jiang,Justin Zhan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种联邦推理框架，通过多个商业LLM API协作实现认知诊断，在无需访问原始学生数据或模型内部的情况下，结合ε-局部差分隐私（对每个实体的预测输出局部添加拉普拉斯噪声）与基于残差的聚合机制来缓解模型异构性，在隐私保护和准确认知诊断之间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI驱动的教育系统在隐私保护与准确认知诊断之间面临显著挑战，现有方法难以在不暴露原始学生数据的前提下保持诊断精度。

Method: 构建异构多LLM架构，由多个联邦实体（如LLaMA-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3-Haiku）协作；采用ε-局部差分隐私，在每个实体的预测输出上本地添加拉普拉斯噪声后再聚合；通过基于残差的聚合方法缓解模型异构性；基于诚实但好奇的信任范式。

Result: 严格的隐私-效用分析证明在强隐私保证下仅有极小精度损失；在三个教育基准上的广泛真实世界评估证实了框架的实用性和跨领域泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该框架能在教育认知诊断场景中有效兼顾隐私保护与诊断准确性，且具有良好的跨领域泛化性。

Abstract: Significant challenges remain in AI-driven educational systems in balancing privacy preservation with accurate cognitive diagnosis. To overcome this, we propose a federated inference framework in which several commercial LLM APIs collaborate without requiring access to raw student data or proprietary model internals. Using multiple federated entities, such as LLaMA-3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini, and Claude-3-Haiku, our framework builds upon a heterogeneous multi-LLM architecture. The predictions generated by these entities are combined with epsilon-local differential privacy by adding Laplace noise locally to each entity's prediction output before aggregation, while residual-based aggregation mitigates model heterogeneity. Our approach is predicated on an honest-but-curious trust paradigm in which API providers are presumed not to abuse submitted queries, and our differential privacy mechanism shields the published diagnostic results from external inference. We conduct rigorous privacy-utility analysis showing strong privacy guarantees with minimal accuracy loss, and extensive real-world evaluations across three educational benchmarks confirm the framework's practical usability and cross-domain generalizability.

</details>


### [396] [PrivateHub: Contrastive Diffusion Model for Private Sensor-Intensive Environment Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02958)
*Jiechao Gao,Yuandong Pan,Jie Wang,Michael Lepech,Bradford Campbell*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Privatehub是一个利用扩散模型和对比学习生成合成多传感器数据流的框架，在保持非私有应用可检测的同时隐藏私有应用，将私有应用识别准确率降低40-50%而不损害非私有性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传感器密集型环境支持从异构数据流中推断用户应用以提供智能服务，但并非所有应用都应暴露——用户希望某些活动保持私密。现有方法如差分隐私和基于规则的过滤只能保护单个数据流，无法应对跨传感器推断带来的隐私风险。

Method: Privatehub包含两个阶段：(1) 应用条件预训练（ACP），在多传感器数据上条件化模型并嵌入应用特征；(2) 应用感知微调（AAF），通过对比学习分离私有与非私有数据。此外定义了多传感器共享场景下的威胁模型。

Result: 在三个真实多传感器数据集上的实验表明，Privatehub将私有应用的识别准确率降低40-50%，同时不影响非私有应用的性能，且在攻击者基于合成数据重新训练时仍保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Privatehub通过生成式方法有效解决了多传感器环境下跨传感器推断的隐私问题，在隐私保护与功能可用性之间实现了良好平衡，并对重新训练攻击具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Sensor-intensive environments enable many intelligent services by inferring user applications from heterogeneous data streams. However, not all applications should be exposed: users want some activities to stay private. This creates a tension between inferring applications for useful services and preventing unwanted inference. Existing approaches such as differential privacy and rule-based filtering protect individual streams but cannot address the privacy risk from cross-sensor inference.
  We introduce Privatehub, which uses contrastive learning within a diffusion model to generate synthetic multi-sensor streams that keep non-private applications detectable while concealing private ones. Privatehub has two stages: App-Conditioned Pre-training (ACP), which conditions the model on multi-sensor data with application embeddings, and App-Aware Fine-tuning (AAF), which separates private from non-private data via contrastive learning. We also define a threat model for the multi-sensor sharing setting. Experiments on three real-world multi-sensor datasets show Privatehub lowers private-application accuracy by 40 to 50\% without hurting non-private performance, and stays robust when the attacker retrains on the synthetic data.

</details>


### [397] [When Optimization Becomes Manipulation: Defending Generative Search against Malicious Generative Engine Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02964)
*Haozhang Li,Yangguang Shao,Xinjie Lin,Zhong Guan,Mi Zhou,Junzheng Shi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出GEO Defender，一种无需微调目标LLM的两阶段防御框架，用于对抗生成式搜索引擎中的恶意生成引擎优化（GEO）攻击。该方法通过Shield Reranker（在冻结基础重排器上学习偏好防御残差）和TFSG（将防御结果蒸馏为自然语言经验库）协同作用，将平均攻击成功率从50.32%降至6.20%，同时保留94.12%的良性证据使用率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式搜索引擎面临GEO攻击隐患——攻击者重写网页文档以匹配引擎引用偏好，从而操纵生成答案。现有防御方法（事实验证、困惑度过滤）失效，因为攻击文档与原文保持事实一致，且其放大的特征与高质量良性内容高度相似，难以区分。

Method: 提出GEO Defender框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Shield Reranker——在冻结的基础重排器之上学习基于偏好的防御残差，降低GEO重写文档的排名同时保持相关性判断；(2) Training-Free Shield Generation (TFSG)——将防御结果蒸馏为自然语言经验库，指导目标LLM在推理时更明智地使用来源。该方法沿攻击链设计两阶段防御，无需对目标LLM进行微调。

Result: 在两种SOTA闭源LLM（两种）和三种开源LLM上，针对七种GEO攻击的实验表明：GEO Defender将平均攻击成功率从50.32%降低到6.20%，保留了94.12%的良性证据使用，答案质量得以保持，并能从构造实例泛化到未见攻击。

Conclusion: GEO Defender通过结合防御性重排与无训练对抗性提示生成，为生成式搜索引擎提供了一种有效且通用的GEO防御机制，在不牺牲良性内容检索和答案质量的前提下显著削弱攻击效果，且具备良好的跨攻击泛化能力。

Abstract: This paper focuses on defending generative search engines against malicious Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), which rewrites web documents to match engines' citation preferences and thereby manipulates generated answers. Recent GEO methods have advanced from hand-crafted rewriting to automated and agentic optimization, substantially increasing the visibility of target documents in generated answers. However, defending against such manipulation poses two major challenges: attack documents remain factually consistent with their originals, rendering fact verification and perplexity filtering ineffective, and the features they amplify equally characterize high-quality benign content. To address these limitations, we propose GEO Defender, a two-stage defense aligned with the attack chain that requires no fine-tuning of the target LLM. GEO Defender consists of Shield Reranker and Training-Free Shield Generation (TFSG). Specifically, Shield Reranker learns a preference-based defensive residual over a frozen base reranker, demoting GEO-rewritten documents while preserving relevance judgments, and TFSG distills defense outcomes into a natural-language experience library that guides the target LLM's source use at inference. Experiments on two state-of-the-art closed-source LLMs and three open-source LLMs across seven GEO attacks demonstrate that GEO Defender reduces the average attack success rate from 50.32% to 6.20%, retains 94.12% of benign-evidence use, preserves answer quality, and generalizes to unseen attacks from construction instances.

</details>


### [398] [Privacy-Preserving Topology-Guided Safety for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems via Federated Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02967)
*Jinxi Yu,Eric Hanchen Jiang,Levina Li,Dong Liu,Zhi Zhang,Wenxiao Zhao,Yanxuan Yu,Kai-Wei Chang,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出FGLGuard，一种基于图联邦学习的隐私保护多智能体系统（MAS）安全防护框架。该方法通过让各组织在本地私有轨迹上训练边特征图注意力检测器，仅共享模型更新，无需汇聚原始数据即可实现对风险智能体的拓扑引导式干预。在多个基准上，联邦式FGLGuard超越了集中式（in-domain）的上限，且在实际部署中可将攻击成功率降低43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对基于LLM的多智能体系统的拓扑引导安全防护方法假设单一运营商可以汇集所有带标签的轨迹来训练GNN风险检测器。然而跨组织场景中，各站的轨迹包含私有提示词、工具输出和专有工作流，任何单一数据孤岛都看不到完整的攻击分布。这打破了集中式数据汇集的基本假设，需要一种隐私保护的联邦化防护方案。

Method: FGLGuard将隐私保护MAS防护建模为图联邦学习问题。具体方法包括：(1) 每个运营商在本地带裁判标注的情节图上拟合边特征图注意力（edge-featured graph attention）检测器，仅共享模型更新；(2) 对非IID客户端采用邻近（proximal）局部目标约束；(3) 设计域平衡聚合策略；(4) 限制过度拒绝的阈值校准；(5) 佐证式上游评分机制；(6) 对拦截答案采用有防护的改写（guarded rewrite）。

Result: 在Agent-SafetyBench、R-Judge和AgentDojo三个基准上，联邦FGLGuard在所有基准上都超过了域内集中式的上限，且无需汇集任何数据。与此对比，无监督异常防护和仅本地训练的方法失败。将单个防护器联邦化部署在四个不同领域运营商上，其AUROC与多域中心化仅差0.03；而任何单域防护器在其他域上都会失效。实际部署中，FGLGuard将AgentDojo的真实攻击成功率降低了43%，代价接近无防护状态，API成本为零，能力损失可忽略。

Conclusion: 联邦化并非可选项而是必备条件：现成的迁移方案在分布偏移下性能崩溃（AUROC从0.51仅经域内重训练后才提升到0.70），因此可部署的防护器必须在各站点的私有轨迹上自适应。FGLGuard证明了在严格不汇集数据的前提下，联邦学习可以超越集中式训练的防护效果，为跨组织的MAS安全防护提供了可行的隐私保护路径。

Abstract: Topology-guided safeguards for LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) train a GNN over the inter-agent communication graph to localize risky agents and intervene on the topology---but they assume one operator can pool all labeled traces. Across organizations that assumption breaks: episodes contain private prompts, tool outputs, and proprietary workflows, and no silo alone sees the full attack distribution. We cast privacy-preserving MAS safeguarding as graph federated learning and instantiate FGLGuard: each operator fits an edge-featured graph attention detector on its own judge-labeled episode graphs and shares only model updates. The method couples a proximal local objective for non-IID clients, domain-balanced aggregation, over-refusal-constrained threshold calibration, corroborated upstream scoring, and a guarded rewrite for blocked answers. Federation is not optional: off-the-shelf transfer collapses under distribution shift (AUROC 0.51 to 0.70 only after in-domain retraining), so a deployable guard must adapt on each site's private traces. On Agent-SafetyBench, R-Judge, and AgentDojo, federated FGLGuard exceeds the in-domain centralized ceiling on all three benchmarks without pooling any data---where unsupervised anomaly guards and local-only training fail. One guard federated across four different-domain operators comes within 0.03 AUROC of multi-domain centralization, while any single-domain guard collapses on the others. Live FGLGuard cuts AgentDojo's ground-truth attack-success rate by 43% at near-unguarded utility, zero API cost, and negligible capability loss.

</details>


### [399] [Privacy Leakage in Federated Learning: Gradient-Based Client Identity Inference and Defenses for Inertial Sensing in Vehicular Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02971)
*Ali Akarma,Toqeer Ali Syed,Muhammad Khan,Qurat-ul-ain Mastoi,Adeel Ahmad*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文研究了车联网联邦学习场景下，诚实但好奇的服务器能否仅凭客户端上传的权重增量（梯度更新）通过IMU特征识别客户端身份的问题。在UCI HAR数据集上，未防御状态下攻击准确率接近1.000；引入轻量级"裁剪+噪声"差分隐私防御后，在sigma∈[0.1,0.2]范围内可将攻击准确率拉至随机水平，同时FL精度损失小于5%。论文还探讨了集成联邦学习作为结构性隐私补偿方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习被广泛视为车联网中保护隐私的分布式训练方案，但客户端传输的模型更新仍会泄露足以识别发送者身份的信息，威胁V2X安全关键应用所依赖的匿名性。作者旨在证实这一可识别性风险，并量化防御措施的隐私-效用权衡。

Method: 使用UCI HAR（惯性IMU数据）作为车辆遥测的可访问代理数据集；构建五种攻击分类器和五种非IID数据划分模拟诚实但好奇的服务器从权重增量中推断客户端身份；测试固定裁剪(C=1.0)下不同高斯噪声级别(sigma∈{0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,1.0})的防御效果，通过Renyi差分隐私核算报告(ε,δ)-DP预算；评估集成FL的1/K匿名集保护；采用SHA-256保证训练/评估梯度不相交，三次随机种子和计数归一化攻击者优势指标确保实验严谨性。

Result: 未防御状态下服务器识别客户端身份准确率近乎完美（约1.000）；在sigma∈[0.1,0.2]的实用防御区间内，攻击准确率降至接近随机猜测水平，而FL精度损失低于5%；集成FL以1/K匿名集上界提供结构性隐私而不损失精度。所有结果均通过SHA-256梯度不相交性验证和三次种子实验支持。

Conclusion: 论文证实了FL在车联网中存在的具体身份识别风险，并验证了轻量级差分隐私剪裁-噪声防御在隐私与效用间可取得实用平衡。作者明确将HAR定位为代理数据集，强调未来需在真实车辆遥测数据上开展验证。

Abstract: As vehicular networks move toward 5G/6G edge intelligence, federated learning (FL) is widely promoted as a privacy-preserving way for vehicles and infrastructure to train shared models without exposing raw sensor data. Yet the updates clients transmit still leak enough information to identify who sent them, which threatens the anonymity that safety-critical V2X applications assume and adds to existing concerns over adversarial ML, model poisoning, and backdoor attacks. We study server-side client identity inference from transmitted weight deltas using inertial (IMU) measurements, evaluated on the UCI Human Activity Recognition (HAR) benchmark as an accessible proxy for the IMU streams produced onboard connected vehicles. Across five attack classifiers and five non-IID partitions, an honest-but-curious server recovers client identity with near-perfect accuracy (approximately 1.000) from undefended updates, confirming a concrete identifiability risk. We then quantify the privacy-utility trade-off of a lightweight clip-then-noise defense by sweeping Gaussian noise (sigma in {0.00, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50, 1.00}) at fixed clipping (C=1.0), and report formal (epsilon, delta)-DP budgets through Renyi accounting. A practical region (sigma in [0.1, 0.2]) drives attack accuracy to near-random while costing under 5% relative FL accuracy. Ensemble FL supplies complementary structural privacy with a 1/K anonymity-set bound and no noise penalty. Results are supported by cryptographic (SHA-256) train/evaluation gradient disjointness, three seeds, and a count-normalized attacker-advantage metric. We position HAR explicitly as a proxy and discuss what validation on true vehicular telemetry would require.

</details>


### [400] [Boundary-Mutation Testing for Pattern-Based Secret Detection: A Rule-Level Method and Cross-Scanner Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02983)
*Shweta Mishra*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出边界突变测试(boundary-mutation testing)方法，通过改变凭据周围的文本上下文来验证基于模式的秘密扫描器。对三种扫描器（开源43规则扫描器、Gitleaks 8.21.2、TruffleHog 3.82.13）进行测试，发现规则级检测性能随上下文边界变化而显著退化：当凭据以连字符结尾时，主检测目标从>=0.9976骤降至0.5233。五个规则受影响，其中两个因固定计数量词完全失败，三个因可变计数量词回溯仅匹配截断凭据。验证了一种修复方案恢复完全鲁棒性且无新增误报，并报告了一项警告：看似合理的初步修复会静默退化两个规则。Gitleaks存在无关的硬编码终止符白名单缺陷，TruffleHog无边界脆弱性但覆盖范围最窄。实验报告边际而非条件失败概率，基于292,527行真实代码，误报排序与合成语料相比发生反转；由于每类检测是确定性的，比较单位为十个凭据类型而非数百个样本，无召回差异达到显著水平，因此报告零结果而非排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于模式的秘密扫描器通常使用示例式fixture验证，这些fixture固定了凭据周围的文本上下文这一变量，导致验证不全面。实际中代码上下文变化多样，扫描器在真实场景下的鲁棒性未被充分测试。作者旨在引入一种系统化的方法，通过变化凭据周围的上下文来更严格地验证扫描器规则，揭示仅在标准示例测试中无法发现的边界缺陷。

Method: 提出边界突变测试方法：(1)从每个规则的自身正则表达式生成凭据；(2)将凭据嵌入多种真实源码上下文（十种不同上下文）；(3)在规则级别而非工具级别分类检测结果，生成三种检测指标。对三个扫描器进行测试，包括一个43规则的开源扫描器、Gitleaks 8.21.2和TruffleHog 3.82.13。对于受影响的规则，分析失败根因（固定计数与可变计数量词的区别），设计并验证修复方案，并采用重跑测试电池的方式捕捉静默回归。

Result: 主检测目标在十种上下文中的检测率保持>=0.9976，但当凭据以连字符结尾时骤降至0.5233。五个规则受影响：两个带固定计数量词的规则完全且确定性地失败；三个带可变计数量词的规则发生回溯并匹配截断的凭据。熵回退机制挽救了部分失败但降低了严重性等级。修复方案恢复完全鲁棒性且无新增误报，但非正式的第一版修复静默回归了两个规则。Gitleaks存在独立的源确认缺陷（硬编码终止符白名单导致大多数凭据类型完全漏报）；TruffleHog无边界脆弱性但覆盖范围最窄。一个常见令牌格式结构性免疫，另一个每64次失败一次。在292,527行真实代码上，误报排序相对于合成语料反转。由于每类检测是确定性的，比较单元为十种凭据类型；无召回差异达到统计显著性，因此报告零结果而非排名。

Conclusion: 边界突变测试是一种有效且必要的验证方法，能揭示示例式方法遗漏的系统性规则缺陷。凭据边界（如尾部连字符）对正则量词行为有显著影响，修复需要系统性重跑测试电池以避免静默回归。工具间差异显著：Gitleaks存在独立缺陷，TruffleHog虽稳健但覆盖有限。作者强调应报告边际失败概率而非条件概率，并采用类型级确定性比较方法论，在统计功效不足时报告零结果而非工具排名。

Abstract: Pattern-based secret scanners are commonly validated with example-based fixtures that fix one variable: the text surrounding a credential. We introduce boundary-mutation testing to vary that context, generating credentials from each rule's own regular expression, embedding them in realistic source contexts, and classifying outcomes at the rule level rather than the tool level, yielding three detection metrics. Applied to three scanners - a 43-rule open-source scanner, Gitleaks 8.21.2, and TruffleHog 3.82.13 - detection in the primary subject holds at >=0.9976 across ten contexts but collapses to 0.5233 when a credential ends in a hyphen. Five rules are affected: two, with fixed-count quantifiers, fail totally and deterministically; three, with variable-count quantifiers, backtrack and match a truncated credential; an entropy fallback rescues some failures but downgrades their severity. We validate a repair restoring full robustness with no new false positives, and report a caution: a plausible first attempt silently regressed two rules, caught only by re-running the same battery. Gitleaks has an unrelated, source-confirmed defect - a hard-coded terminator allowlist causing total misses for most credential types - while TruffleHog shows no boundary fragility but narrowest coverage. We report marginal, not conditional, failure probabilities: one common token format is structurally immune, another fails once in 64; on 292,527 lines of real code, the false-positive ordering inverts relative to the synthetic corpus. Because per-type detection is deterministic, the comparison unit is ten credential types, not hundreds of samples; no recall difference reaches significance, so we report the null result, not a ranking.

</details>


### [401] [Population-Calibrated Graph Screening at 835-Million-Address Scale, with Label-Free Transfer to New Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03036)
*Yury Korolev*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文描述了一个已部署的多链交易图评分系统，该系统不依赖地址标签或制裁名单查表，而是通过地址在多链交易图中的位置来计算合规风险分数。系统在5条EVM链上构建了8.35亿地址、158亿条边的单一大图，采用共享归纳编码器加逐链归一化、双打分头的架构。实验表明其无需目标链标签即可跨链迁移（Base/Arbitrum/Gnosis召回0.86/0.82/0.997），能在公开制裁登记前中位提前约529天（以太坊）~648天（Tron）发现事件，端到端p50延迟151ms且分数与离线完全一致，并通过8项退化审计和对抗性强化学习生成的8类典型模式暴露了已部署系统的盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的区块链地址合规筛查本质上是"对制裁登记名单查表+聚类启发式"，这导致其无法处理未标注地址以及完全没有标签覆盖的链。作者旨在提出一种不依赖预先标签的、可跨链泛化的合规评分方法，以弥补名单式筛查的根本性缺陷。

Method: 将5条EVM链（含Tron相关的交易数据）的8.35亿地址和158亿条边整合为单一交易图；使用共享的归纳式图编码器配合逐链归一化，将编码结果送入两个打分头（对每个地址输出风险分数）；决策阈值取全人群分数分布的精确分位数，并按链段扫描，从而预先知晓告警量。系统包含离线训练产物与在线服务路径（分数与离线位级一致），并通过一个包含2882地址的漂移面板做门控监控。此外构建了对抗性测试台——8种基于强化学习循环训练出的典型攻击原型，并在第8项多项退化审计下通过，用于检验已部署模型的盲区。

Result: （1）无标签迁移：在两个链训练的打分头在Base、Arbitrum、Gnosis上对保留阳性样本的召回分别为0.8598、0.8182、0.9967（人群告警率10^-3），且头部训练完全不含目标链标签；（2）静态领先时间重放：在68个外部登记事件中，40个（58.8%）在0.1%预算下被标记，是事件级随机标记基线的152倍；首次链上出现比公开指认中位提前528.8天（以太坊）/647.8天（Tron）；（3）服务路径端到端p50延迟151ms，分数与离线工件位级一致，由2882地址漂移面板门控；（4）对抗性测试台生成的8种强化学习典型模式通过8项退化审计，并在与检测器无关的抓拍上暴露了已部署打分头对合成行为的可度量盲区。

Conclusion: 作者表明：基于图谱位置的合规评分可以取代或补充名单查表式筛查，具备跨链零标签迁移能力、可预测的告警量、显著的领先时间优势，以及可供运营监控的位级一致性服务路径；同时揭示了即便是部署系统也仍存在对经强化学习合成行为的盲区，提示合规系统需持续进行对抗性评估。

Abstract: Compliance screening of blockchain addresses is, in practice, a lookup against sanctions registries plus clustering heuristics; it fails on unlabelled addresses and on chains with no label coverage at all. We describe a deployed system that scores an address by its position in a multi-chain transaction graph rather than by its presence in a list. The substrate is a single graph of 835,330,427 addresses and 15,826,261,934 edges across five EVM chains; a shared inductive encoder with per-chain normalisation feeds two scoring heads. Decision thresholds are exact quantiles of the score distribution over the full population, scanned per chain segment, so the alert volume is known in advance. We report: label-free transfer: heads trained on two chains recall 0.8598 / 0.8182 / 0.9967 of held-out positives on Base, Arbitrum and Gnosis at a $10^{-3}$ population alert rate, with no target-chain labels in head training; a static lead-time replay over 68 external registry events: 40 of 68 (58.8%) flagged at the 0.1% budget, $\times$152 over an event-level random-flagging baseline, with first on-chain appearance a median of 528.8 days (Ethereum) / 647.8 days (Tron) before public designation; a serving path whose score is bit-identical to the offline artefact at end-to-end p50 151 ms, gated by a 2,882-address drift panel; and an adversarial harness of eight recurrent reinforcement-learned archetypes that passes an 8-criterion degeneracy audit and, on a detector-independent snapshot, exposes a measured blind spot of the deployed heads against synthesised behaviour.

</details>


### [402] [AI-Assisted Design of a Post-Quantum Cryptographic Accelerator: A Deployed-Silicon Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04058)
*Jungmin Park,Eunha Kim,Wooseop Kim,Seongjoon Cho,Byungho Cha*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种替换标准KAT验收门的方法——字节精确的黄金参考预言机配合随机化对抗性浸泡测试，覆盖ML-DSA拒绝循环的盲区。作者展示了该方法在带AI作者的ML-KEM-768和ML-DSA-65统一加速器上验证有效，成功率达71.6%，产出物在所有六个FIPS操作上字节精确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后量子迁移有强制时间表，硅片一旦带缺陷出厂无法远程修补。标准验收门（KAT）无法检测一整类ML-DSA缺陷：签名重采样直到候选满足范数边界，执行路径随消息变化，而KAT只采样固定值、只到达其种子触发的深度。实验中的加速器在携带超出块RAM延迟的范数检查（候选最终系数未验证）情况下仍通过了全部KAT回归测试，该缺陷直到拒绝循环第5次迭代才暴露。盲点在于仪器而非工程师，小心谨慎无法消除它，因此需要更换验收门。

Method: 用字节精确的黄金参考预言机（golden-reference oracle）替代KAT验收门，配以随机化对抗性浸泡测试（randomized adversarial soak），将拒绝循环推过任何固定向量。在单块Kintex-7 XC7K160T上完成统一ML-KEM-768和ML-DSA-65加速器（带片上密钥托管）从RTL到PCIe启动的全流程，由智能体大型语言模型驱动，记录232次实验，运行301,343次数据依赖签名。

Result: 新验收门运行301,343次数据依赖签名，零逃逸。AI驱动的232个实验中成功率71.6%，呈硬件耦合梯度：文档和研究类77-85%，综合和启动类50-53%，失败集中在仅物理侧有纠正信号的环节。产出物在所有六个FIPS操作上字节精确，部署基线通过779,945次检查的零失败浸泡测试。

Conclusion: 由于验收门评判产物而非作者，信任可与作者身份分离，使AI作者成为一个可回答的问题。不可靠的AI作者能产出经六个FIPS操作全部字节精确的硬件工件——这是本文的核心主张，说明在将仪器缺口（gate gap）修复后，AI作者的可信度可以用实证方式衡量。

Abstract: Post-quantum migration is mandated on published timelines, and silicon that ships with a defect cannot be patched remotely. The standard acceptance gate cannot detect an entire class of ML-DSA defects. Signing resamples until a candidate meets its norm bounds, so the executed path varies with the message, whereas known-answer tests (KATs) sample fixed values and reach only the depths their seeds trigger. Our accelerator passed its full KAT regression while carrying a norm check that outran block-RAM latency, leaving each candidate's final coefficients unverified; the escape surfaced at reject-loop iteration 5. The blind spot lies in the instrument, not the engineer; care cannot remove it. We replace that gate. A byte-exact golden-reference oracle paired with randomized adversarial soak drives the rejection loop past any fixed vector, closing the gap: 301,343 data-dependent signings, zero escapes. Because the gate judges artifacts and never authors, trust becomes separable from authorship, making AI authorship an answerable question. We report 232 logged experiments in which an agentic large language model drove a unified ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 accelerator with on-chip key custody from RTL to PCIe bring-up on one Kintex-7 XC7K160T, shipped at 98.5% slice occupancy. Success was 71.6%, following a hardware-coupling gradient, 77-85% for documentation and research against 50-53% for synthesis and bring-up, which observability can explain: failure concentrates where corrective signals are physical-side only. That so unreliable an author produced an artifact byte-exact across all six FIPS operations -- its deployed baseline surviving the same 779,945-check zero-failure soak -- is the claim.

</details>


### [403] [Differentially private federated learning with Byzantine-robust aggregation: A cross-domain framework for secure model training in banking and healthcare systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03064)
*Srikumar Nayak*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出DP-BR-FedAvg联邦学习框架，将高斯机制差分隐私与坐标级修剪均值拜占庭鲁棒聚合相结合，用于银行、医院等受监管机构在不共享原始数据的情况下训练共享模型，同时抵御隐私泄露和恶意客户端攻击。实验表明该框架在60轮通信、20个客户端（其中1/4为拜占庭）下，将F1分数从FedAvg的0.030提升至0.119，并量化了隐私保护对鲁棒性施加的成本。结果显示隐私与鲁棒性机制存在交互效应而非简单叠加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习虽允许受监管机构在不集中原始数据的情况下协同训练模型，但存在两大信任问题：一是客户端参数更新会通过梯度反转和成员推断攻击泄露本地数据信息；二是FedAvg等诚实平均规则无法防御恶意客户端提交损坏或对抗性更新，少量恶意或受攻击参与者即可悄悄使共享模型偏离正确方向。因此需要在联邦学习框架中同时解决隐私泄露和拜占庭鲁棒性两大挑战。

Method: 提出DP-BR-FedAvg框架：结合高斯机制差分隐私层（添加高斯噪声以限制任何单个客户端贡献的隐私损失）与坐标级修剪均值拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则（对每个坐标维度的客户端更新进行修剪取均值以抵御恶意更新）。在模拟跨机构分类任务（类似欺诈和临床风险评分场景）上进行评估，设置60轮通信、20个客户端、其中1/4为拜占庭客户端的实验条件。

Result: 在60轮通信与20个客户端（1/4拜占庭）的实验条件下：普通FedAvg在少数类上表现崩溃（F1-score仅0.030），而提出的DP-BR-FedAvg框架能显著恢复信号（F1-score为0.119），同时限制了任何单个客户端贡献的隐私损失。无隐私层的拜占庭鲁棒聚合器在原始准确率上表现最佳，量化了隐私机制对鲁棒性施加的成本。结果表明隐私与鲁棒性机制之间存在交互作用而非简单叠加。

Conclusion: 隐私保护和拜占庭鲁棒性机制之间存在交互效应，二者并非简单的效果叠加。在受监管、敌对性的跨机构联邦学习场景中，系统设计需要将这种交互作用纳入预算考量，即在设计时需权衡隐私保护带来的鲁棒性代价与拜占庭防御所需的隐私预算分配。

Abstract: Federated learning allows banks, hospitals, and other regulated organizations to train a shared model without moving raw records off their own servers, which is attractive wherever data protection law or competitive sensitivity rules out pooling data centrally. Two problems limit how far this promise can be trusted in practice. First, the parameter updates that clients exchange still leak information about local records through gradient inversion and membership inference attacks. Second, an honest averaging rule such as FedAvg has no defense against a subset of clients that submit corrupted or adversarial updates, so a small number of malicious or compromised participants can quietly steer the shared model off course. This paper presents a federated learning framework, DP-BR-FedAvg, that combines a Gaussian-mechanism differential privacy layer with a coordinate-wise trimmed-mean Byzantine-robust aggregation rule, evaluated on a simulated cross-institutional classification task resembling fraud and clinical-risk scoring. Across sixty communication rounds with twenty clients, a quarter of them Byzantine, plain FedAvg collapses on the minority class (F1-score 0.030) while the proposed framework recovers substantially more of the signal (F1-score 0.119) while bounding the privacy loss of any single client's contribution. A Byzantine-robust aggregator with no privacy layer performs best in raw accuracy, quantifying the cost privacy imposes on robustness. The results show that privacy and robustness mechanisms interact rather than simply add, and that system design for regulated, adversarial, cross-institutional settings needs to budget for that interaction.

</details>


### [404] [A Bayesian Correlated Equilibrium for Early Insider-Threat Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03096)
*Javed M. Shah,Ian A. Kash,Natalie Parde*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文将内部威胁检测建模为动态贝叶斯博弈，通过平台协调一组战略认证者在贝叶斯时间相关均衡（BTCE）下维持诚实用户均衡并在数据外泄前检测恶意偏离。结合现时偏差和损失厌恶建模冲动升级动态，实现比理性基线早1.7-4.5天的检测。在CERT r6.2数据集上实现高达28.3%的外泄前检测率，误报率低于1.6%，显著优于Transformer基线和流式溯源近似方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内部威胁检测面临两个核心挑战：一是恶意用户的行为偏离往往在时间序列上表现为逐步升级，传统静态检测难以捕捉；二是检测过程涉及多个异构认证实体（certifiers）的协同，而现有Stackelberg博弈模型要求中心化机构具备承诺能力，这与实际分布式场景不符。因此需要一个不需要承诺权力、能协调异质认证者并考虑人类行为偏见的博弈论框架。

Method: 提出贝叶斯时间相关均衡（BTCE）框架：平台作为密封信封相关设备（sealed-envelope correlating device）向认证者和用户发布私人推荐，并在每个路径信息状态验证服从性。引入校准干预损失（calibrated intervention losses）使推荐行为在当前自我（current-self）下成为最优响应以应对行为偏见；采用受控证据累积机制（controlled evidence accumulation）保证有界期望时间内干预；利用中位数聚合（median aggregation）在拜占庭认证者少于半数的条件下将实施行为限制在诚实推荐范围内。

Result: 在CERT r6.2数据集上，该方法实现高达28.3%的外泄前检测率，误报率低于1.6%；检测时间比理性基线提前1.7-4.5天。相比之下，Transformer基线和流式溯源近似方法HOLMESLite在同等约束下几乎无法实现外泄前检测（接近零）。

Conclusion: 研究表明博弈论视角下引入行为经济学偏见（现时偏差和损失厌恶）的时序相关均衡框架，能够显著提升内部威胁检测的时效性。BTCE框架无需承诺权力即可协调异质认证者，且具备对抗拜占庭故障的鲁棒性，为内部威胁检测提供了一条超越深度学习基线的新路径。

Abstract: We model insider threat detection as a dynamic Bayesian game in which a platform coordinates a committee of strategic certifiers to sustain equilibrium among honest users and detect malicious deviations before exfiltration. Certifiers and users operate under a Bayesian Temporal Correlated Equilibrium (BTCE), where a sealed-envelope correlating device issues private recommendations over time and obedience is verified at every on-path information state. Unlike Stackelberg formulations, BTCE coordinates heterogeneous certifiers without requiring commitment power. We incorporate present bias and loss aversion to capture impulsive escalation dynamics, enabling 1.7--4.5 days earlier detection than rational baselines. We prove three guarantees: (1) calibrated intervention losses make recommended behavior a current-self best response despite behavioral biases, (2) controlled evidence accumulation guarantees intervention in bounded expected time before exfiltration, and (3) median aggregation confines implemented actions to the honest recommendation range when fewer than half of certifiers are Byzantine. On CERT r6.2 our mechanism achieves up to 28.3% pre-exfiltration detection with false positives below 1.6%, while both a transformer baseline and a streaming provenance approximation (HOLMESLite) achieve near-zero pre-exfiltration detection under comparable constraints.

</details>


### [405] [SecDT: A Profile-Based Security Layer for TRDP Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03133)
*Erlantz Alonso,Igor Lopez,Jasone Astorga*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于TRDP（列车实时数据协议）通信的轻量级安全层，通过安全配置文件协商、动态密钥管理和基于现代密码学算法的多种安全策略组合，在保持实时性能的同时为列车车载子系统提供认证和加密保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TRDP广泛应用于轨道交通车辆，但其原生对密码学保护支持有限，且其用于车载子系统间关键信息交换的多播流量特性使得引入加密保护面临挑战，亟需在保证实时性能的前提下提供安全通信方案。

Method: 设计了一个基于OKMS（车载密钥管理系统）的轻量级安全层，支持多种安全配置文件的协商与动态密钥分发及密钥生命周期管理。安全配置文件涵盖从简单认证到带关联数据的认证加密（AEAD）算法，提供密码学灵活性与可敏捷性。配置协商过程保证同一ComID上的所有TRDP终端设备共享相同的安全配置文件。原型使用mbedTLS和Arm PSA实现。

Result: 实验结果表明该安全层引入的开销在可管理范围内，适用于轨道交通中实时和时敏通信的需求。

Conclusion: 提出的安全层方案在保障TRDP通信安全性的同时保持了可接受的性能开销，是一种适合轨道交通实时通信环境的安全防护解决方案。

Abstract: The Train Real-time Data Protocol (TRDP) is widely used on rolling stock but it provides limited native support for cryptographic protection. Furthermore, the multicast traffic profile used in TRDP Process Data to exchange critical information between onboard subsystems makes the introduction of cryptographic protection a challenge. This paper presents a lightweight security layer for secure TRDP communication that implements a number of security profiles built around modern cryptographic algorithms. This additional layer relies on an On-board Key Management System (OKMS) for both security profile negotiation, dynamic key distribution and key lifecycle management. The security profiles allow for cryptographic agility and flexibility, ranging from simple authentication to Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD) algorithms. The security profile negotiation procedure guarantees all TRDP End Devices (ED) on a common Communication ID (ComID) share the same security profile and can therefore process each other's messages. A prototype implementation based on mbedTLS and Arm Platform Security Architecture (PSA) was developed and evaluated. Experimental results demonstrate manageable overhead, suitable for the real-time and time-sensitive communication found on rolling stock.

</details>


### [406] [Trust Me, I'm Your Developer: Self-Issued Authentication in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03247)
*Syed Ghazanfar Abbas,Dongyan Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM在面对用户要求其自行设计测试来验证身份声明时的行为，发现部分模型（Qwen、Mistral、Llama）会生成测试问题、评估答案并做出"已验证"的错误身份判断，作者称之为"模型签发伪凭证"（MIPC）和"对话式虚假认证"（CFA），并指出模型生成的对话绝不应创建或修改身份或授权状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM安全研究主要集中于角色扮演越狱攻击，而忽略了用户要求模型通过自身设计的测试来验证身份声明这一场景。

Method: 对ChatGPT、Claude、Qwen、Mistral和Llama五个模型进行分阶段开发者身份实验，每个模型面对"我是你的开发者"这一未经支持的身份声明，观察其是否愿意自行设计身份验证测试及后续行为。

Result: Claude拒绝进行身份测试；ChatGPT生成了开发者导向问题但坚持答案只能证明知识而非身份；Qwen和Mistral生成了技术挑战、定义了证据判定标准、评估详细答案并返回"已验证"，但未收到任何外部验证的身份证据；Llama同样生成并评估了开发人员测试、接受身份声明并随即做出无根据的内部运行时和部署状态访问声明。

Conclusion: 自签发认证是一种对话式安全缺陷：认证的身份必须源自外部安全组件，模型生成的对话绝不能创建或修改身份或授权状态。虚假认证与权限提升是不同的安全结果。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) security has largely focused on role-playing jailbreaks, with less attention to what happens when a user asks an LLM to verify an identity claim through a test designed by the model itself. We study this behavior through a staged developer-identity experiment with ChatGPT, Claude, Qwen, Mistral, and Llama. All five models initially rejected the unsupported claim "I am your developer." Claude refused to conduct an identity test, while ChatGPT generated developer-oriented questions but maintained that answers could demonstrate knowledge, not identity. In contrast, Qwen and Mistral generated technical challenges, defined what counted as convincing evidence, evaluated detailed answers, and returned Verified without receiving any externally validated identity evidence. Llama similarly generated and evaluated a developer test, accepted the claimed identity, and subsequently made unsupported claims of access to internal runtime and deployment state. We call the model-generated verification procedure a Model-Issued Pseudo-Credential (MIPC) and the resulting unsupported identity judgment Conversational False Authentication (CFA). In each CFA case, the same model acted as challenge generator, evidence evaluator, and identity decision-maker, converting technical knowledge into supposed proof of identity. The accepted identities did not change the tested authorization boundaries, showing that false authentication and privilege escalation are distinct outcomes. These results identify self-issued authentication as a conversational security failure: authenticated identity must originate from an external security component, and model-generated dialogue must never create or modify identity or authorization state.

</details>


### [407] [Memetic Search for Supersingular Elliptic Curves over $\mathbb{F}_p$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03249)
*Ismel Martínez-Díaz*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究在素域F_p上通过元启发式算法搜索超奇异椭圆曲线的问题。作者提出了一种基于NMD目标的记忆算法（memetic algorithm），采用一维j-不变量染色体、位级重组、自适应变异和周期性局部搜索。在30个独立种子、40至51位素数规模的基准测试中，算法在46位时发现了精确的超奇异曲线，并在所有规模下一致收敛到Frobenius迹极接近零的"近超奇异"普通曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超奇异椭圆曲线的搜索是同源密码学中的基础计算问题。先前研究在F_{p^2}上提出了NMD目标函数，但随机搜索在约10^13候选项后失败。本文动机是将元启发式搜索扩展到素域F_p——即面向同源协议（CSIDH、OSIDH、SQISign）的实际设定，尽管候选空间从p^2缩减到p，超奇异曲线的渐近稀疏性（O(sqrt(p)log p)）仍使搜索保持指数级困难。

Method: 设计了一种针对F_p定制的记忆算法，包含：一维j-不变量染色体表示、位级重组算子、自适应变异策略，以及以NMD为目标的周期性局部搜索。算法框架将全局搜索（遗传操作）与局部精化（局部搜索）相结合，以此在高维稀疏的超奇异曲线景观中导航。

Result: 在30个独立种子下对40位、46位和51位素数（p约1.13×10^15）进行基准测试：46位时发现了精确的超奇异曲线；40位和51位分别获得最佳NMD值19和3，对应的相对迹偏差在Hasse区间内分别为1.3×10^-5和4.5×10^-8。

Conclusion: NMD驱动的记忆搜索能够有效穿越F_p上稀疏的超奇异曲线景观，系统地定位近超奇异结构，表明该元启发式方法在同源密码学的基础搜索问题中具有实用潜力。

Abstract: The search for supersingular elliptic curves is a fundamental computational problem in isogeny-based cryptography. A recent metaheuristic formulation over $\mathbb{F}_{p^2}$ introduced the NonMultiplicity Distance (NMD) objective, measuring the deviation of the Frobenius trace from a multiple of $p$, and showed that uninformed random search fails beyond $\approx 10^{13}$ candidates. This work investigates metaheuristic search over the prime field $\mathbb{F}_p$, the setting for oriented isogeny protocols such as CSIDH, OSIDH, and SQISign. Although the candidate space decreases from $p^2$ to $p$, the supersingular locus is asymptotically sparse ($O(\sqrt{p}\log p)$ curves), keeping the search exponentially difficult. We formulate a memetic algorithm tailored to $\mathbb{F}_p$ using a one-dimensional $j$-invariant chromosome, bit-level recombination, adaptive mutation, and periodic local search under the NMD objective. Benchmarks across 30 independent seeds at 40-bit, 46-bit, and 51-bit prime sizes ($p \approx 1.13\times 10^{15}$) show that the algorithm discovers an exact supersingular curve at 46 bits and consistently converges to ``near-supersingular'' ordinary curves with Frobenius traces remarkably close to zero: best NMD values of 19 at 40 bits and 3 at 51 bits, corresponding to relative trace deviations of $1.3\times 10^{-5}$ and $4.5\times 10^{-8}$ across the Hasse interval. These results demonstrate that NMD-driven memetic search effectively navigates the sparse $\mathbb{F}_p$ landscape and systematically locates near-supersingular structures.

</details>


### [408] [After Cheap Discovery: From unknown to known-and-unfixed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03266)
*Bahman Sistany*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文论证决定软件暴露风险的既不是漏洞发现成本也不是修复成本，而是发布时的修复覆盖率——即产品发布前已修复的已知漏洞比例，以及组织明知存在但决定随产品一同发布、已评估未修复的漏洞残留。作者提出四项论点：残留漏洞并非随机样本；延迟修复积压本身是高价值资产；文档化的已知意识改变组织的法律与市场地位并产生逆向选择；现有的监管工具全部以第三方观测到的利用行为为触发条件而非厂商内部知识。文章以CISA的BOD 26-04为参照，指出发布覆盖率目前未被测量，而测量它是责任、保险和采购机制发挥作用的先决条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化漏洞发现已使专家注意力不再稀缺，行业将精力集中于发现与修复且两者成本下降，但作者认为成本曲线并非决定暴露风险的关键变量。需要重新审视真正决定组织暴露程度的因素，从而揭示当前立法、监管与市场机制的盲区。

Method: 本文为论证性分析文章，通过四项递进论点展开：（1）残留漏洞非随机样本，因分流机制按成本排序且昂贵案例多属架构性问题；（2）延迟积压本身是高价值资产；（3）记录在案的认知改变法律与市场地位并产生价格未反映的逆向选择；（4）现有任何触及厂商的监管工具均以第三方观测到的利用而非内部知识为触发条件。并以CISA Binding Operational Directive 26-04为案例检验何种机制才能解决此问题。

Result: 文章识别出暴露风险的核心决定因素是发布时的修复覆盖率而非发现/修复成本，指出当前监管体系全部依赖第三方观测的利用事件而不触及厂商内部知识，导致厂商已知内容与须披露内容之间的距离完全由厂商自行裁量。BOD 26-04作为例外证明了有效方案所需的条件。结论为发布覆盖率当前未被测量，而这种测量是责任、保险或采购机制能够发挥作用的前提。

Conclusion: 漏洞治理的核心指标应从发现与修复成本转向发布覆盖率。解决厂商"知而不修仍可出货"的制度性缺陷，关键在于建立对发布覆盖率的可测量机制，使其成为法律责任分配、保险定价和采购决策的客观依据——没有测量就没有责任、保险或采购机制的行动基础。

Abstract: Automated vulnerability discovery has removed the scarcity of expert attention that protected most software. The response has concentrated on discovery and on repair, and both are becoming cheaper. This article argues that neither cost curve determines exposure. What determines it is remediation coverage at the release decision: the fraction of identified vulnerabilities fixed before a product ships, and the residue of known, assessed, unremediated flaws an organisation has decided to ship with. Four arguments follow. The residue is not a random sample of what was found, because triage sorts on cost and the expensive cases are architectural. The deferred backlog is itself a high-value artifact. Documented awareness alters an organisation's legal and market position, and produces an adverse selection that the price of software does not reflect. And no regulatory instrument reaching vendors triggers on internal knowledge -- every one fires on exploitation observed by a third party -- which leaves the distance between what a vendor knows and what it must disclose entirely at the vendor's discretion. CISA's Binding Operational Directive 26-04 is examined as the exception that shows what a solution requires. Release coverage is not currently measured, and measuring it is the precondition for liability, insurance or procurement to act.

</details>


### [409] [Long-Range Indirect Control-Flow Prediction in Stripped Binaries via Dual Virtual Hubs and Multi-Task Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03280)
*Kun Liu,Zhengming Ding,Chenke Luo,Tianyi Xu,Zizhan Zheng,Haotian Zhang,Jiang Ming*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ICFlowNet是一个统一框架，通过候选感知的双虚拟枢纽（全局代码枢纽和全局数据枢纽）结合多任务图学习，实现剥离二进制中的长程间接控制流预测，并配套泄漏感知、噪声控制的评估流水线，在长程间接调用上超越现有基线13+ F1点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 恢复间接控制流（ICF）边是二进制安全分析的基础，但现有方法存在三大问题：(1) 难以处理长程依赖（远处代码与数据证据之间的关联）；(2) 将不同ICF类型（间接调用、间接尾调用、跳转表、返回）割裂处理；(3) 评估协议容易受标签噪声和数据泄漏影响，导致结果不可信。

Method: ICFlowNet提出统一的多任务框架：(1) 引入候选感知的双虚拟枢纽——全局代码枢纽（Global Code Hub）和全局数据枢纽（Global Data Hub），在远端代码证据与数据证据之间建立短路由路径；(2) 采用多任务图学习联合建模四类间接控制流：间接调用、间接尾调用、跳转表和返回；(3) 开发泄漏感知、噪声控制的评估流水线：包级划分防止数据泄漏、函数级助记符哈希去重控制重复、基于动态正样本与绝对负样本的干净测试协议；(4) 构建包含15,901个唯一剥离x86-64二进制的数据集（其中1,351个含动态真值）。

Result: 实验表明：(1) 单纯扩展静态监督信号收益有限；(2) 双虚拟枢纽设计在长程F1上提升最高9.13点；(3) 多任务学习额外带来最高5.81点提升；(4) 最终模型在长程间接调用上比先前基线高出13+ F1点；(5) 拓扑开销仅增加11.44%。

Conclusion: ICF预测的关键瓶颈在于结构性设计（建立跨越长距离代码-数据依赖的路径）与多任务联合建模，而非简单的数据规模扩展。该工作同时确立了更严格的评估标准，为二进制安全分析中的ICF恢复提供了更可靠的方法与基准。

Abstract: Recovering indirect control-flow (ICF) edges is fundamental to binary security analysis, yet existing methods struggle with long-range dependencies, isolate different ICF types, and are often evaluated under protocols vulnerable to label noise and data leakage. We present ICFlowNet, a unified framework for long-range ICF prediction in stripped binaries. ICFlowNet introduces candidate-aware Dual Virtual Hubs, a Global Code Hub and a Global Data Hub, to create short routing paths between distant code and data evidence, and combines them with multi-task graph learning to jointly model indirect calls, indirect tail calls, jump tables, and returns. To enable credible evaluation, we further develop a leakage-aware, noise-controlled pipeline with package-level splits, function-level mnemonic-hash deduplication, and a clean test protocol built from dynamic positives and absolute negatives. Using this pipeline, we construct a dataset of 15,901 unique stripped x86-64 binaries, including 1,351 with dynamic ground truth. Experiments show that simply scaling static supervision yields only marginal gains, whereas our structural and multi-task designs are essential: Dual Virtual Hubs improve long-range F1 by up to 9.13 points, multi-task learning adds up to 5.81 points, and the final model outperforms prior baselines by more than 13 F1 points on long-range indirect calls while adding only 11.44 percent topological overhead.

</details>


### [410] [Spruce: Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03376)
*Peichun Hua,Yunming Xiao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出Spruce系统，通过将紧凑二值嵌入表示与安全多方计算（MPC）协议协同设计，实现了大规模文档集的私有外包检索，在百万级文档规模下将全扫描延迟降低至0.21-2.97秒，相比此前最先进的优化系统提速4.8-6.7倍，并支持私有簇剪枝进一步获得13-23倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统依赖密集检索作为标准组件，但组织将向量索引外包给不可信云时面临严重的数据隐私问题。由于在语料规模状态上执行每次查询会导致计算量、关联随机性和通信量随语料规模线性增长，密码学保护极具挑战性：百万文档规模下朴素安全实现每次查询需要约数分钟和90GB通信，即使近期优化系统也需要10-22秒，难以实用。

Method: Spruce的核心方法是协同设计（co-design）表示学习与密码学协议。具体包括：(1) 学习紧凑的二值编码表示，保留全精度重排所需候选集，用高效的汉明距离计算替代语料级全精度嵌入打分（在两服务器MPC下进行）；(2) 提出语料校准的固定半径协议，避免多轮候选选择的同时保持检索质量；(3) 提供私有簇剪枝机制，以轻微质量损失换取大幅计算减少；(4) 采用单核所有者运营的dealer，消除云侧OT预处理瓶颈。

Result: 在包含383K-5.42M文档的四个语料上，Spruce保持原始检索质量，中位候选集仅382-1,952个。在10 Gbps服务器间带宽下，全扫描耗时0.21-2.97秒，比最近测量的先前工作快4.8-6.7倍；私有剪枝耗时0.06-1.09秒，实现13.1-22.9倍加速，并保留93.9%-97.3%的全精度NDCG。在最大语料上，剪枝与dealer联合使1 Gbps链路下的持续吞吐量提升31.5倍。

Conclusion: Spruce通过协同设计紧凑嵌入表示与MPC协议，在保持检索质量的同时将私有外包检索的可扩展性提升了一个数量级以上，使百万级文档库的私有RAG检索达到实际可用的秒级延迟性能。其私有簇剪枝技术展示了在隐私保护检索中通过可控质量折衷换取显著性能提升的有效路径。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has made dense retrieval over large document collections a standard building block. Organizations increasingly outsource vector indexes to untrusted clouds, exposing proprietary corpora and user queries. Cryptographic protection is challenging because each query searches corpus-scale state, causing computation, correlated randomness, and communication to grow with the corpus. At million-document scale, a naive secure implementation takes minutes and about 90 GB of communication per query. Even recent optimized systems require 10--22 seconds.
  We propose Spruce (Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings), which co-designs representations with the cryptographic protocol. Spruce learns compact binary codes that preserve candidates for full-precision reranking, replacing corpus-wide embedding scoring with efficient Hamming-distance computation under two-server multi-party computation (MPC). A corpus-calibrated fixed-radius protocol avoids multi-round candidate selection while preserving retrieval quality. Spruce also provides private cluster pruning, which trades minor quality loss for substantially less computation, and a one-core owner-operated dealer that removes cloud OT preprocessing bottlenecks. Across four corpora containing 383K--5.42M documents, Spruce preserves the original search quality with median candidate sets of only 382--1,952. At 10 Gbps inter-server bandwidth, full scans take 0.21--2.97 seconds, $4.8$--$6.7\times$ faster than the closest measured prior work. Private pruning takes 0.06--1.09 seconds, achieves $13.1$--$22.9\times$ speedups, and retains $93.9\%$--$97.3\%$ of full-float NDCG. On the largest corpus, pruning and the dealer jointly improve sustained throughput by $31.5\times$ at 1 Gbps per link.

</details>


### [411] [Privacy, Robustness, and Fairness Trade-offs in Federated Intrusion Detection: Geometric Indistinguishability at the Aggregation Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03420)
*Adrita Rahman Tory,ABM Shawkat Ali,Md Abu Layek,Khondokar Fida Hasan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究联邦网络入侵检测（NIDS）中正式差分隐私、拜占庭鲁棒性和不平衡攻击类别检测覆盖率三者之间的相互作用，发现它们并非独立可组合，隐私噪声与鲁棒聚合的联合使用会不成比例地损害少数类攻击检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦NIDS文献将差分隐私、拜占庭鲁棒性和不平衡类别覆盖视为独立可组合的性質，但这种假设未被验证。在真实部署中这三者需要同时满足，作者质疑其独立可组合性并试图从理论和实证角度揭示它们之间的交互作用。

Method: 引入几何不可区分性作为概念框架，解释隐私引起的客户端更新离散化/扰动为何使少数类信号更难被鲁棒聚合保留。以UNSW-NB15数据集为例，在标签翻转和模型投毒攻击下，评估DP-SGD与坐标中位数（coordinate-wise median）聚合的组合，按攻击类别评估威胁覆盖率。

Result: 实验提供了初步证据表明：联合使用隐私噪声与鲁棒聚合可能不成比例地降低罕见攻击相对于多数类的检测能力。在强隐私约束下的部分性能崩塌源于训练校准不当，而对超稀有类别即使在依赖epsilon的调优后仍可能存在残余性能下限。

Conclusion: 研究结论呼吁将隐私、鲁棒性和罕见攻击覆盖作为联合问题而非独立可组合属性来研究，并指出聚合感知建模和样本感知评估是构建可信联邦NIDS的有前景方向。

Abstract: Federated learning enables privacy-conscious collaboration for network intrusion detection without centralizing sensitive traffic data, yet its deployment in operational environments must simultaneously satisfy three competing requirements: formal differential privacy guaranties, tolerance to Byzantine-adversarial participants, and reliable detection coverage across severely imbalanced attack categories. Existing literature treats these properties as independently composable, an assumption that this paper challenges both theoretically and empirically. In this paper, we study how these requirements interact in class-imbalanced federated NIDS and introduce geometric indistinguishability as a conceptual lens for a regime in which privacy-induced dispersion in client updates can make minority-class signals harder for robust aggregation to preserve. Using UNSW-NB15 as a case study, we evaluate DP-SGD combined with coordinate-wise median under label-flip and model-poisoning attacks, with threat coverage assessed across attack categories. Our results provide initial evidence that the joint use of privacy noise and robust aggregation can disproportionately degrade detection of rare attacks relative to majority classes. We also show that part of the observed collapse under strong privacy can arise from training miscalibration, while a residual performance floor may remain for ultra-rare categories even after epsilon-dependent tuning. These findings motivate studying privacy, robustness, and rare-attack coverage jointly rather than as independently composable properties, and suggest that aggregation-aware modeling and sample-aware evaluation are promising directions for trustworthy federated NIDS.

</details>
